advanced-filter-description: Sefe se se tseneletseng se go letla go kwala mokwalo o o nang le diopereitara tse: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sekgala se kgaoganya diopereitara. O ka sefa mabala otlhe a a rulagantsweng ka maina le boleng jwa one. Sekai: Field1 == Value1. Fa mabala kgotsa boleng di na le dikgala, di tsenye mo matshwaong a nopolo a le mangwe. Sekai: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Dirisa backslash go tlola tlhaka e e laolang. Sekai: Field1 == I'm. O ka kopanya maemo a mantsi. Sekai: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Diopereitara di tlhalosiwa go tswa molemeng go ya mojeng; fetola thulaganyo ka masakana. Sekai: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka batla mabala a mokwalo ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

Lebaka: __note__

Sengwe le sengwe se se dirilweng ka nako eo se mo Phanele ya motsamaisi / Batho / Rekoto ya tlhatlhobo le Mathata / Pego ya go Itira.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Manega JSON ya thomelo ya Kanboard: sedirwa se se nang le "columns" (kgotsa ditiro tse di nang le column_name) le lenaane la "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Dikholomo di nna manane, ditiro di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-deck: Manega JSON ya boto ya NextCloud Deck (boto e e nang le "stacks", nngwe le nngwe e na le "cards"). Ditlhopha di nna manane, dikarata di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Manega JSON ya pokello ya diphuthelwana tsa tiro ya OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Maemo a nna manane, diphuthelwana tsa tiro di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-issues: Manega lenaane la JSON la dikgang tsa __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Dikgang di nna dikarata tse di kgaogantsweng ka manane a Bulegile / Tswetswe.
import-board-instruction-asana: Manega JSON ya thomelo ya ditiro tsa Asana ({ "data": [...] } go tswa thomelong ya Asana kgotsa GET /tasks). Ditiro di kgaoganngwa ka dikarolo (memberships); ditiro tse di weditsweng di ya kwa Feditswe.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Manega JSON ya thomelo ya lenaane la ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Dikgato di nna manane, dintlha di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kgomaretsa lenaane la ditiro tsa markdown (mokgwa o o dirisiwang ke didiriswa tsa markdown-kanban tse di jaaka Obsidian Kanban): ditlhogo tsa "## Leina la lenaane", ka dilo tsa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ka fa tlase. Ditlhogo di nna manane mme dilo di nna dikarata.
import-board-instruction-leo: Kgomaretsa sebopego sa Leo (faele ya .leo). Dikarolo tsa maemo a a kwa godimo di nna manaane, dikarolo tse di leng ka fa tlase ga tsona ka tlhamalalo di nna dikarata, mme mokwalo wa karolo o nna tlhaloso ya karata. Dikarolo tsa maemo a a kwa teng go feta di nna manaane a tlhatlhobo. Dikarolo tse di tshwailweng di tsenngwa e le tse di weditsweng.
import-board-instruction-opml: Kgomaretsa thulaganyo ya OPML, jaaka Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq le di-outliner tse dingwe di e ntsha. Dintlha tsa maemo a a kwa godimo di nna manaane, bana ba tsona ba nna dikarata tse kitsiso e leng tlhaloso, mme dintlha tse di kwa tlase thata di nna manaane a tlhatlhobo. Dintlha tse di weditsweng di tsenngwa di feditswe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Kgomaretsa faele ya Org mode, jaaka Emacs, Orgzly kgotsa Beorg di e kwala. Ditlhogo tsa maemo a ntlha di nna manaane mme ditlhogo tsa maemo a bobedi di nna dikarata. TODO le DONE, maemo a botlhokwa, ditshwao, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE le CLOSED di a bolokwa, mme mabokose a tshwao le ditlhogo tse di kwa tlase thata di nna manaane a tlhatlhobo.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Kgomaretsa faele ya todo.txt: tiro e le nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe, jaaka tiriso ya todo.txt le ditiriso tse di tsamaelanang le yone di kwala. Ditiro tse di weditsweng ("x") di ya kwa karolong e e weditsweng, +project le @context di nna dileibole, (A) e nna leibole ya botlhokwa, mme due: le t: di nna matlha a bofelo le a tshimologo.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Kgomaretsa dipholo tsa task export: lenaane la JSON kgotsa tiro e le nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe. Ditiro tse di weditsweng di ya kwa Done, project le priority di fetoga ditshwao, annotations e fetoga ditshwaelo, mme depends e fetoga go ikaega ka ditiro tse di thibelang.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ntsha faele ya .boardarchive mo polokelong e e gateletsweng mme o kgomaretse diteng tsa board.jsonl ya boto, ka mola wa mofuta kgotsa ntle le one. Karolo ya go kgaoganya ka ditlhopha mo ponong ya boto e fetoga manaane, dikarolo tse dingwe tsa tlhopho di fetoga ditshwao, dikarolo tsa mokwalo le mabokose a go tshwaya di fetoga tlhaloso le lenaane la tlhatlhobo, mme ditshwaelo di a bolokwa. Ditshwantsho le difaele tse di mametleletsweng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Mo Azure DevOps, bula Boards, morago Queries, tsamaisa query e e bontshang dikholomo tse o di batlang, mme o tlhophe Export to CSV; tlhopha faele eo ya .csv. Board Column (kgotsa State) e nna manaane mme Board Lane e nna ditsela; work items di nna dikarata le mofuta wa tsona le di-tag jaaka ditshwao, Assigned To, malatsi, tlhaloso le motsadi, mme dikholomo tse dingwe di nna masimo a a ikgethileng.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Mo Microsoft Lists, bula lenaane, tlhopha Export, morago Export to CSV, mme o tlhophe faele eo ya .csv. Kholomo ya Status (kgotsa Progress) e nna manaane mme selo sengwe le sengwe se nna karata, le setlhogo sa sona, tlhaloso, batho, malatsi le di-tag; dikholomo tse dingwe di nna masimo a a ikgethileng.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Mo Microsoft Project, tlhopha File, morago Save As, ka mofuta wa XML Format (*.xml), mme o tlhophe faele eo. Ditiro tsa kakaretso di nna ditsela mme ditiro di nna dikarata mo Not started, In progress kgotsa Completed, le malatsi a tsona, dintlha, metswedi, ditiro-potlana le tse di di etelelang pele.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Mo Outlook, goga melaetsa go ya kwa foltareng mo khomputareng ya gago, kgotsa o e boloke ka File, morago Save As, jaaka Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Tlhopha faele e le nngwe ya .msg, kgotsa .zip ya difaele tsa .msg le .eml. Puisano nngwe le nngwe e nna karata mo Board View / Email, dikarabo tsa yona jaaka dikakgelo mme tse di tshwaraganeng jaaka difaele.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Mo MeisterTask, tobetsa leina la porojeke, tlhopha Export project mme o ntshe CSV, go tswa foo o e kgomaretse. Dikarolo di nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le dikitsiso tsa tsona, letlha la bofelo, moabelwa le ditshwao; ditiro tse di weditsweng di boloka letlha la go wediwa. CSV e e kwaletsweng go tsenngwa ga MeisterTask le yona e a dira.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Mo Obsidian, bula faele ya boto ya Kanban jaaka Markdown (kgotsa bula faele ya .md mo mokwaleng wa mafoko), go tswa foo o e kgomaretse yotlhe. Ditsela di nna manaane le ditekanyetso tsa tsona tsa dikarata, dikarata di boloka ditshwao, matlha, botlhokwa, mafelo le lenaane la tlhatlhobo, mme Archive e nna dikarata tse di isitsweng kwa polokelong.
import-board-instruction-linear: Mo Linear, ntsha mathata jaaka CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kgotsa go ntsha ga ponelo), go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Maemo a nna manaane, ditlhopha di nna ditsela, mme mathata a nna dikarata le moabelwa, ditshwao, matlha, bothata jwa motsadi, botlhokwa, kakanyetso, porojeke le potologo.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Mo TickTick, bula Settings, Account, Backup & Import mme o dire kopi ya polokelo, go tswa foo o kgomaretse faele ya CSV. Lenaane lengwe le lengwe la TickTick le nna tsela mme dikholomo tsa lona di nna manaane; ditiro di boloka ditshwao, matlha, lenaane la tlhatlhobo, botlhokwa le ditiro-potlana.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Mo ClickUp, ntsha ditiro jaaka CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kgotsa go ntsha ga ponelo ya List kgotsa Table le dikholomo tsotlhe), go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Maemo a nna manaane, manaane a ClickUp a nna ditsela, mme ditiro di nna dikarata le ditiro-potlana, baabelwa, ditshwao, matlha, botlhokwa le nako.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Mo Nullboard, bula boto, tlhopha Export this board... mo lenaaneng la ditlhopho, bula faele ya .nbx mo mokwaleng wa mafoko mme o kgomaretse diteng tsa yona. Manaane a nna manaane mme dikitsiso di nna dikarata: mola wa ntlha wa kitsiso ke setlhogo sa karata mme o o setseng ke tlhaloso ya yona. Kitsiso e e tala e newa leibole raw. Faele e e nang le diboto di le mmalwa e tsenya boto ya yona ya ntlha.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Mo Kanri, bula Import & Export mme o tlhophe Export individual board (kgotsa Export all data), go tswa foo o kgomaretse faele ya .json. Dikholomo di nna manaane mme dikarata di nna dikarata, le tlhaloso ya tsona, letlha la bofelo, ditshwao le mebala; ditiro tsa karata di nna lenaane la tlhatlhobo. Go tswa mo go ntsheng ga data yotlhe, boto ya ntlha e a tsenngwa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Kwala aterese ya Planka ya gago (sekao https://planka.example.com), leina la modirisi le lefoko la sephiri la Planka, morago o tobetse "Bontsha lenaane". Di dirisiwa fela go tsaya boto mme ga di bolokwe. Tlhopha boto mme o tobetse "Tsaya": WeKan e e bala go tswa mo API ya Planka, le manaane a yone, dikarata, ditlhaloso, malatsi a bofelo, dileibole, maloko, manaane a ditiro le dikakgelo, morago o tswelele go tsenya jaaka tlwaelo. Dikarata tse di mo polokelong ya Planka di tsenngwa di le mo polokelong; dikgomaretso le dikarata tse di mo matlakaleng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Mo Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), tsena, dumela tetla ya Tasks.Read mme o kopolole token go tswa mo tab ya Access token. E kgomaretse fano mme o tobetse "Bontsha lenaane"; token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga e bolokwe. Tlhopha manaane otlhe kgotsa lenaane le le lengwe mme o tobetse "Tsaya". Lenaane lengwe le lengwe la To Do le nna lenaane mme tiro nngwe le nngwe e nna karata, le dintlha, malatsi a bofelo le a go simolola, dikgato jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo, ditlhopha jaaka dileibole, botlhokwa jo bogolo le maemo jaaka dileibole; ditiro tse di weditsweng di isiwa kwa polokelong. Dikgakololo le dipoeletso ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Mo Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), tsena, dumela tetla ya Notes.Read mme o kopolole token go tswa mo tab ya Access token. E kgomaretse fano mme o tobetse "Bontsha lenaane"; token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga e bolokwe. Tlhopha notebook mme o tobetse "Tsaya". Dikarolo di nna manaane mme ditsebe di nna dikarata, le mokwalo wa tsona, mabokoso a ditiro jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo le ditsebe-potlana jaaka ditiro-potlana.
import-board-instruction-teams: Kgomaretsa token ya phitlhelelo ya Microsoft Graph e e nang le Chat.Read (go tswa mo Graph Explorer, akhaonto ya tiro kgotsa ya sekolo) mme o tobetse "Bontsha lenaane", morago o tlhophe chat kgotsa channel mme o tobetse "Tsaya"; token ga e bolokwe. Kgotsa tlhopha faele: .tar ya export ya gago ya poraefete go tswa mo teams.live.com/dataexport, kgotsa .json ya melaetsa ya chat. Chat nngwe le nngwe e nna karata mo Board View / Chat, melaetsa ya yona e nna dikakgelo.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Mo Sandstorm, bula grain ya __app__, tlhopha "Download backup" mo bareng e e kwa godimo ya grain, mme o tlhophe faele eo ya .zip. Diteng tsa grain di nna boto, dilo tsa yone e nna dikarata le se app e se bolokang ka tsone. Tlhopha app e grain e leng ya yone: grain ya app e nngwe e a ganwa, mme e bolela gore ke app efe.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Mo KanbanFlow, bula menu ya boto, tlhopha Settings → API & Webhooks mme o kopolole token ya API ya boto. Kgomaretsa token fano, tobetsa "Bontsha lenaane", tlhopha boto mme o tobetse "Tsaya"; token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya moo mme ga e bolokwe. Dikholomo di nna manaane mme ditsela di nna ditsela; ditiro di boloka tlhaloso, mmala, dileibole, letsatsi la bofelo, ditironnyane jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo, nako e e dirisitsweng, khakanyo, batho le dikakgelo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Kwala ID ya akhaonto ya gago ya Basecamp (nomoro e e latelang basecamp.com/ mo atereseng) le token ya phitlhelelo (go tswa mo app ya OAuth 2 e e kwadisitsweng kwa launchpad.37signals.com, kgotsa e kopanyo e e leng teng e setseng e na le yone), tobetsa "Bontsha lenaane", tlhopha porojeke mme o tobetse "Tsaya". Token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya moo mme ga e bolokwe. Tafole nngwe le nngwe ya dikarata e nna tsela e dikholomo tsa yone e le manaane, mme manaane a dilo tse di tshwanetseng go dirwa a nna tsela ya "To-dos"; dikarata le dilo tse di tshwanetseng go dirwa di boloka mokwalo, malatsi, ba ba abetsweng le dikakgelo, dikgato tsa karata di nna lenaane la tlhatlhobo, mme tse di weditsweng di isiwa kwa polokelong.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Bona token ya phitlhelelo go tswa mo OAuth 2.0 Playground: ka fa tlase ga Tasks API v1 tlhopha tasks.readonly, tobetsa Authorize APIs, morago Exchange authorization code for tokens, mme o kopolole access token. E kgomaretse fano mme o tobetse "Bontsha lenaane", tlhopha manaane otlhe a ditiro kgotsa le le lengwe, morago "Tsaya". Token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga e bolokwe. Manaane a ditiro a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le dintlha, dikgolagano le letsatsi la bofelo; ditironnyane di nna lenaane la tlhatlhobo mme ditiro tse di weditsweng di tsenngwa di le mo polokelong.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ke ya diakhaonto tsa Google Workspace fela. Bona token ya phitlhelelo ya OAuth 2.0 e e nang le scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (mo OAuth 2.0 Playground fa motsamaisi wa Workspace a letla, kgotsa go tswa mo service account e e nang le thomelo ya domain yotlhe), e kgomaretse, tobetsa "Bontsha lenaane" mme morago "Tsaya". Token e dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga e bolokwe. Dintlha tsa mokwalo di nna dikarata mo lenaaneng la "Notes", mme dintlha tsa lenaane la tlhatlhobo di nna dikarata mo lenaaneng la "Lists" le dilo tsa tsone jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo. Dintlha tse di mo matlakaleng, dikgomaretso le go abelana ga di tsenngwe.
api-import-desc: E tsee mo tirelong ka akhaonto ya gago. Se o se kwalang fano se dirisiwa fela go tsaya mo mme ga se bolokwe.
api-import-fetched: E tsere. Tlhatlhoba maloko a a fa tlase mme o tsenye.
api-import-nothing: Ga go na sepe se se ka tsenngwang ka akhaonto e.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Mo Pivotal Tracker, bula tsebe ya MORE ya porojeke mme o tlhophe Export CSV (kgotsa tlhopha dikgang mme o tlhophe Bulk Actions, CSV), go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Boemo bongwe le bongwe jwa kgang bo nna lenaane mme dikgang di nna dikarata, le mofuta wa tsona le ditshwao, beng, mokopi, matlha, ditshwaelo, ditiro le dikgoreletsi; Estimate e nna Story points mme dipoeletso di nna di-sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Mo Tasks.org, bula Settings, Backups mme o tlhophe Export tasks, go tswa foo o kgomaretse diteng tsa faele eo ya .json. Manaane a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le dikitsiso tsa tsona, ditshwao, matlha, ditshwaelo le ditiro-potlana; ditiro tse di weditsweng di boloka letlha la go wediwa, mme botlhokwa bo nna lebala le le rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-monday: Mo monday.com, bula lenaane la ditlhopho la boto, tlhopha More actions le Export board to Excel (le dintšhwafatso le dintlha-potlana fa o rata), go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo ya .xlsx. Kholomo ya Status e nna manaane mme ditlhopha di nna ditsela; batho, matlha, molelwane wa nako le ditshwao di boloka mafelo a tsona, dikholomo tse dingwe di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng mme dintšhwafatso di nna ditshwaelo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Mo Super Productivity, bula Settings, go tswa foo Sync & Backup, tlhopha Export Data mme o kgomaretse diteng tsa faele ya sp-backup .json. Porojeke nngwe le nngwe e nna tsela mme ditiro di nna dikarata mo To Do, In Progress, Backlog kgotsa Done, le dikitsiso tsa tsona, ditshwao, letlha la bofelo, nako e e dirisitsweng le ditiro-potlana; ditiro tse di isitsweng kwa polokelong di nna dikarata tse di isitsweng kwa polokelong.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Mo Taiga, bula Admin > Project > Export mme o folose kopi ya porojeke (bula faele ya .json.gz pele), go tswa foo o kgomaretse JSON ya yona. Maemo a dikgang tsa badirisi a nna manaane, dikgang tsa badirisi di nna dikarata le ditiro tsa tsona jaaka ditiro-potlana, di-epic le mathata di newa ditsela tsa tsona, mme di-sprint, ditshwao, ditshwaelo le dinonofi tse di rulagantsweng di tla le tsona. Tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Mo Vikunja, bula Settings, tlhopha Data Export mme o folose faele ya .zip e e go e romelang, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo, kgotsa o kgomaretse data.json e e mo teng ga yona. Mabekere a Kanban a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le ditshwao tsa tsona, baabelwa, matlha, tlhaloso, manaane a ditiro jaaka manaane a tlhatlhobo le ditshwaelo; botlhokwa, phesente e e weditsweng le go wediwa di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng. Tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-quire: Mo Quire, bula lenaane la ditlhopho la porojeke mme o tlhophe Export CSV, go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Maemo a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le ditiro-potlana tsa tsona jaaka dikarata tsa bana, baabelwa, ditshwao jaaka dileibole, matlha a go simolola, a bofelo le a go wediwa, tlhaloso le botlhokwa jaaka lebala le le rulagantsweng. Ditshwaelo le tse di tshwaraganeng ga di mo CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Mo Wrike, ntsha porojeke kgotsa foltara kwa Excel, kgotsa tlatsa sekao sa Excel sa go tsenya sa Wrike, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo ya .xlsx. Mela ya foltara le porojeke e nna ditsela, Status e nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata, le Key ya tsona, tiro ya motsadi, baabelwa, matlha a go simolola le a bofelo, dikgolagano le tlhaloso; Priority, Duration le dikholomo tse dingwe di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Mo Teamwork.com, tlatsa sekao sa Excel sa go tsenya ditiro (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) mme o se boloke jaaka .xlsx, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo. Manaane a ditiro a nna manaane mme ditiro di nna dikarata; tiro e e simololang ka -, # kgotsa > e nna tiro-potlana ya tiro e e kwa godimo ga yona (--, ## kgotsa >> legato le le lengwe kwa tlase). Baabelwa, matlha le ditshwao di boloka mafelo a tsona; Priority, Estimated time le Complete di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Mo Businessmap (pele e ne e le Kanbanize), bula Advanced Search, tlhopha Configure results go tlhopha dikholomo, folosa faele ya Excel, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo ya .xlsx. Dikholomo di balwa ka maina a tsona a Seesemane (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): fa akhaonto ya gago e dirisa puo e nngwe, fetola maina a mola wa ditlhogo go nna Seesemane pele. Column e nna manaane mme Lane e nna ditsela; beng, ditshwao, mmala, matlha, ditshwaelo le dikgokagano tsa batsadi di boloka mafelo a tsona, mme Priority, Size, Type le dikholomo tse dingwe di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Mo Redmine, bula Issues ya porojeke, tlhopha Also available in: CSV kwa tlase ga lenaane, tlhopha dikholomo (All columns, le Description) mme o ntshe, go tswa foo o kgomaretse CSV. Redmine e fa dikholomo maina ka puo ya gago, ka jalo baya puo ya gago go nna Seesemane mo My account pele o ntsha. Boemo bongwe le bongwe bo nna lenaane mme mathata a nna dikarata, le tracker jaaka leibole, moabelwa, mokwadi, matlha, tiro ya motsadi le mathata a a amanang; botlhokwa, setlhopha, bešene e e lebeletsweng, nako e e akanyeditsweng, % Done le mafelo a a rulagantsweng di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng.
import-board-instruction-notion: Mo Notion, bula database jaaka tsebe e e tletseng, tlhopha ••• le Export, tlhopha Markdown & CSV, mme o tlhophe faele ya .zip e e e folosang, kgotsa CSV e le nngwe ya database go tswa mo go yona, kgotsa o kgomaretse CSV eo. Kholomo e e bidiwang Status e nna manaane (fa e seyo, kholomo ya ntlha e e lebegang e le select e a dira, mme pego ya go tsenya e bolela gore ke efe); mela e nna dikarata le setlhogo sa tsona, ditshwao jaaka dileibole, batho jaaka maloko, matlha, le mokwalo wa tsebe jaaka tlhaloso; dikholomo tse dingwe di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng. Dikamano, ditshwantsho le tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-plane: Mo Plane, bula Workspace Settings, tlhopha Exports, ntsha diporojeke jaaka JSON, CSV kgotsa Excel mme o folose faele ya .zip, go tswa foo o tlhophe faele eo, kgotsa faele e le nngwe e e mo teng ga yona, kgotsa o kgomaretse JSON kgotsa CSV. Maemo a nna manaane, diporojeke di nna ditsela, mme mathata a nna dikarata le setshupi sa tsona, motsadi, baabelwa, ditshwao, matlha, dikgokagano le ditshwaelo; botlhokwa, kakanyetso, potologo le karolo di nna mafelo a a rulagantsweng. Go ntsha ga Plane ga go na ditlhaloso kgotsa tse di tshwaraganeng, ka jalo ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Mo Fizzy, romela akhaonto kwa ntle mo "Account settings", kgotsa dikarata tsa gago ka "Download my data", mme o tlhophe faele ya .zip e Fizzy e go e romelang, kgotsa faele ya .json ya karata e le nngwe. Diboto di nna ditsela mme dikholomo di nna manaane, le "Maybe?", "Not now" le "Done" jaaka mo Fizzy; dikarata di boloka tlhaloso ya tsone, ditshwao, ba ba neetsweng tiro, dikgato jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo, dikakgelo le difaele.
import-board-instruction-mail: Tlhopha faele ya .mbox, jaaka Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt kgotsa Gmail ka Google Takeout di e boloka, kgotsa molaetsa o le mongwe wa .eml, kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa one. Puisano nngwe le nngwe e nna karata e le nngwe mo lenaaneng la Inbox, le moromedi, baamogedi le setlhogo sa yone, gore e bonale mo ponong ya Email; dikarabo di nna dikakgelo tsa yone. Ditshwao tsa Gmail di nna ditshwao. Tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-ical: Tlhopha faele ya khalendara ya .ics, jaaka Google Calendar, Apple Calendar kgotsa Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud kgotsa Outlook di e romela kwa ntle, kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa yone. Ditiro di ya kwa To Do, In Progress, Done kgotsa Cancelled go ya ka seemo sa tsone, mme ditiragalo di ya kwa Events, le matlha a tsone a go simolola le a bofelo, gore di bonale mo dipononong tsa Calendar le Gantt. Ditlhopha le botlhokwa di nna ditshwao. Dilo tse di boelelang di tsenngwa ga nngwe.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Kwa takeout.google.com, tlhopha Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar le Google Chat, dira thomelo kwa ntle mme o folose faele ya .zip, morago o e tlhophe fano. Setlhagiswa sengwe le sengwe se nna tsela: poso ya pono ya Email, manaane a ditiro le dintlha le manaane a tsone a tlhatlhobo, ditiragalo tsa khalendara le ditiro tse di nang le matlha, le mafelo a puisano a melaetsa ya one e leng dikakgelo tsa pono ya Chat. Ditlhagiswa tse dingwe le tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-slack: Mo Slack, bula dithulaganyo tsa lefelo la tiro, tlhopha Import/Export Data, romela lefelo la tiro kwa ntle mme o folose faele ya .zip, morago o e tlhophe fano. Kanale nngwe le nngwe e nna karata mo Channels, Groups kgotsa Direct messages, mme melaetsa ya yone le dikarabo tsa dikgole di nna dikakgelo tsa karata, ka mokwadi wa tsone, gore pono ya Chat e bontshe kanale. Difaele ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Romela kwa ntle ka mmctl export create, folosa thomelo mme o tlhophe faele ya yone ya .jsonl, kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa yone. Kanale nngwe le nngwe le molaetsa o o tlhamaletseng di nna karata, mme dikwalo le dikarabo tsa yone di nna dikakgelo tsa karata, gore pono ya Chat e bontshe kanale. Ditlhopha di nna ditsela. Difaele ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Mo Telegram Desktop, bula Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, tlhopha sebopego sa JSON mme o romele kwa ntle, morago o tlhophe faele ya result.json, kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa yone. Puisano nngwe le nngwe e nna karata mo Direct messages, Groups kgotsa Channels, mme melaetsa ya yone e nna dikakgelo tsa karata, gore pono ya Chat e bontshe puisano. Ditshwantsho le difaele ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Mo WhatsApp, bula puisano, tlhopha Export chat kwa ntle ga bobegakgang, mme o tlhophe faele ya .txt fano, kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa yone. Puisano e nna karata e melaetsa ya yone e leng dikakgelo tsa yone, ka moromedi le nako, gore pono ya Chat e e bontshe. Bobegakgang le melaetsa ya tsamaiso ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-discord: Romela kanale ya Discord kwa ntle ka DiscordChatExporter ka sebopego sa JSON mme o tlhophe faele ya .json, kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa yone. Kanale e nna karata mo setlhopheng sa yone, mme melaetsa ya yone e nna dikakgelo tsa karata, gore pono ya Chat e bontshe kanale. Seva e nna tsela. Tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Mo Rocket.Chat, romela data ya gago kwa ntle jaaka JSON mo "My Data" mme o tlhophe faele ya .zip e e go e romelang, kgotsa faele ya .json e e romeletsweng kwa ntle ya phaposi e le nngwe. Phaposi nngwe le nngwe e nna karata mme melaetsa ya yone e nna dikakgelo tsa karata, gore pono ya Chat e bontshe phaposi. Le .zip e WeKan e e romelang kwa ntle gore Rocket.Chat e e tsenye ka CSV e a balwa.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Mo Evernote, romela dintlha kgotsa buka ya dintlha kwa ntle jaaka faele ya .enex mme o e tlhophe fano, kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa yone. Ntlha nngwe le nngwe e nna karata e e nang le mokwalo wa yone, mabokose a yone a ditiro jaaka lenaane la tlhatlhobo, dithegi tsa yone jaaka ditshwao le kgopotso ya yone jaaka letlha la bofelo; dintlha tse kgopotso ya tsone e weditsweng di ya kwa Done. Ditshwantsho le difaele tse di tshwaraganeng ga di tsenngwe.
tool-group-issues: Ditshekatsheko tsa mathata le taolo ya diphetolelo
tool-group-tasks: Diapo tsa ditiro le tse di tshwanetseng go dirwa
report-no-due-date: Ga go na letlha la bofelo
report-average-days-late: Palogare ya malatsi a go diega
import-board-instruction-trello: Mo botong ya gago ya Trello, ya kwa 'Menu', morago 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', mme o kopise mokwalo o o tlhagelelang.
import-board-instruction-csv: Manega Boleng jo bo Kgaogantsweng ka Dikoma (CSV) / Boleng jo bo Kgaogantsweng ka Dithabole (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Manega JSON go tswa patlong ya dikgang ya Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), kgotsa sedirwa se se tshwanang { "issues": [...] }. Maemo a Jira a nna manane, dikgang di nna dikarata. O ka tsenya lenaane la "automationRules" go tlisetsa melao.
import-board-instruction-excel: Tlhopha letlhare la .xlsx la mokgwa wa WeKan (dikholomo tse di tshwanang le thomelo ya Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Mola wa ntlha ke setlhogo.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Mo botong ya gago, ya kwa 'Menu', morago 'Export board', mme o kopise mokwalo mo faeleng e e folotsweng.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Fa o bona diphoso fa o tlisetsa boto, ka dinako dingwe tliso e sa ntse e dira mme boto e kwa tsebeng ya Diboto tsotlhe.
import-without-mapping-members: Tlisetsa ntle le go amanya maloko (amanya moragonyana)
import-members-mode-map: Tlhopha modirisi yo o leng teng mo go mongwe le mongwe wa bona
import-members-mode-placeholder: Ba boloke jaaka badirisi ba boemedi ka maina a bona, go ba amanya le badirisi ba nnete moragonyana
import-members-mode-me: Ba dire botlhe go nna nna
csv-mapping-description: Tlhopha kholomo ya faele e e nang le lebala lengwe le lengwe la karata. Ditlhopho di dirilwe go tswa mo maineng a dikholomo; fetola tse di phoso, mme o tlhophe (ga e mo faeleng) mo lebaleng le faele e se nang lona.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Faele ga e na kholomo ya lenaane. Tlhopha nngwe kwa godimo, kgotsa kwala leina la lenaane le le lengwe le karata nngwe le nngwe e yang mo go lona.
csv-mapping-list-name: Lenaane la karata nngwe le nngwe
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Dikholomo tse dingwe tse di tla tsenngwang jaaka mafelo a a rulagantsweng a mokwalo:
csv-mapping-boards: Letlhare lengwe le lengwe le nna boto ya lona:
csv-mapping-title-required: Tlhopha kholomo e e nang le ditlhogo tsa dikarata.
csv-mapping-list-required: Kwala leina la lenaane le karata nngwe le nngwe e yang mo go lona, kgotsa tlhopha kholomo e e nang le lenaane.
invalid-import-mapping: Thulaganyo ya dikholomo ga e dumalane le faele.
import-many-boards-hint: Tlhopha difaele di le mmalwa tse di ntshitsweng ke sedirisiwa se, kgotsa .zip e le nngwe e e nang le tsona: faele nngwe le nngwe e nna boto ya yona, e tsenngwa kwa ntle ga thulaganyo ya maloko. .zip e ka boyona e leng go ntsha go le gongwe (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, kgotsa WeKan le tse di tshwaraganeng) ke boto e le nngwe. Fa difaele di tlhophilwe fano, Import e di tsenya go na le lebala le le kwa godimo.
import-one-board-per-project: Boto e le nngwe ka porojeke
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Tsela nngwe le nngwe e go tsenya go neng go tla e dira (porojeke, foltara kgotsa lenaane la sedirisiwa) e nna boto ya yona. Dikarata tsa batsadi le dikgolagano magareng ga diboto tseo di kwadilwe mo pegong ya go tsenya.
export-all-boards-hint: Boto nngwe le nngwe e o ka e ntshang, mo go foloseng go le gongwe: Excel jaaka buka e le nngwe ya tiro e e nang le letlhare ka boto le le bidiwang ka leina la yona, mofuta mongwe le mongwe o mongwe jaaka .zip e e nang le faele ka boto.
import-json-placeholder: Manega tshedimosetso ya gago ya JSON e e siameng fano
import-csv-placeholder: Manega tshedimosetso ya gago ya CSV/TSV e e siameng fano
import-json-file: Kgotsa tlhopha faele ya JSON ya Trello

Go ntsha go kwala manaane a boto e jaaka phatlalo e le nngwe, e e bidiwang ka leina la boto, mo JSON e API ya Wrike e e busetsang mo diphatlalong tsa tiro: dira phatlalo eo mo Wrike pele o tsenya go ntsha ga Excel ga Wrike ga boto, gore maemo a yona a dirisiwe. Go tsenya go bala JSON eo e e kgomareditsweng kwa godimo, go tswa mo WeKan kgotsa mo GET /workflows ya Wrike, mo botong e e tlhophilweng: boemo jo bo se nang lenaane bo nna lenaane, mme molao o tshwaya karata e weditswe fa e sutisediwa mo boemong jwa Completed kgotsa Cancelled mme ga e a wediwa mo go Active kgotsa Deferred. Melao ya Wrike ka boyona ya tiriso ya boitiriso ga e kgone go ntshiwa mo Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - dikarata mo manane e e tsamaelanang e tlhalositswe *<title>*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - dikarata belonging go e boto e abetswe go mokgatlho *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - dikarata belonging go e boto e abetswe go setlhopha *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - dikarata e leng di bofelo up go *<n>* malatsi go tswa jaanong. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ manane dikarata tsotlhe past tsa bone letlha la bofelo.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - dikarata e leng were e dirilwe *<n>* malatsi ago kgotsa less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - dikarata e leng were e fetotswe *<n>* malatsi ago kgotsa less
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - tsotlhe e bolokilweng le unarchived dikarata
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - dikarata ka e letlha la bofelo
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - dikarata fela mo ya botlhe diboto
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - kwa *<field>* ke nngwe ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kgotsa `__predicate_member__`. Placing e `-` mo front ya *<field>* dipatlisiso go absence ya e boleng mo seo lefelo (e.g. `e na le:-bofelo` dipatlisiso go dikarata ntle le e letlha la bofelo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - kwa *<sort-name>* ke nngwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kgotsa `__predicate_modified__`. Go e descending rulaganya, place e `-` mo front ya rulaganya leina.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - kwa *<n>* ke e e siameng integer expressing palo ya dikarata go nna displayed ka nngwe tsebe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Multiple badiri ka nna e tlhalositswe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar badiri di *OR*ed together. Dikarata seo tshwantsha le fa e le efe ya conditions tla nna returned.
`__operator_list__:E teng __operator_list__:E thibetswe` would return dikarata contained mo le fa e le efe lenaane named *E thibetswe* kgotsa *E teng*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing badiri di *AND*ed together. Fela dikarata seo tshwantsha tsotlhe ya differing badiri di returned. `__operator_list__:E teng __operator_label__:red` returns fela dikarata mo lenaane *E teng* ka e *red* letshwao.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Malatsi ka kgona nna e tlhalositswe jaaka e e siameng kgotsa negative integer kgotsa using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kgotsa `__predicate_year__` go ya jaanong period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ka ya tlwaelo e bolokilweng dikarata di ga searched.

filesystem-enabled: Tsamaiso ya difaele Polokelo E tshubilwe
filesystem-disabled: Tsamaiso ya difaele Polokelo E timilwe
filesystem-enabled-description: Dirisa local tsamaiso ya difaele go faele polokelo
s3-minio-storage-description: Polokelo ya dilo e e tsamaisanang le S3: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces le tse dingwe.
s3-force-path-style-description: Required ka MinIO le most non-AWS S3-compatible servers.
s3-sse: Go fitlha ka khoutu ka fa go seva
s3-sse-none: Ga go se se kopilweng (tlwaelo ya bucket)
s3-sse-description: S3 e fitlha ka khoutu se se tshwaraganeng sengwe le sengwe, setshwantsho sa motho le bekapo e WeKan e e kwalang, mme e e bula ka ntlha ya WeKan fa e balwa.
s3-sse-kms-key-id: ID ya senotlolo sa KMS sa SSE-KMS (lolea = senotlolo sa tlwaelo sa akhaonto)
azure-connection-string-description: Boikgethelo: dirisa e tletse kgokagano mokwalwa instead ya akhaonto leina le senotlolo.
database-migration-description: Hudusa text-based tshedimosetso (everything except dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le ditshwantsho tsa batho, e leng stay mo tsamaiso ya difaele) magareng MongoDB le FerretDB v1 (SQLite). nngwe polokelotshedimosetso tshwanetse nna e a tsamaya le reachable (ya tlwaelo ports: FerretDB MongoDB://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB MongoDB://127.0.0.1:27019; override ka WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Morago sona finishes, point MONGO_URL kwa nngwe polokelotshedimosetso le restart WeKan (mo Snap: snap beakanya wekan polokelotshedimosetso=ferretdb kgotsa =MongoDB).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Hudusa mokwalwa tshedimosetso go FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Kopolola tsotlhe text-based dikgobokanyo go __db__? Dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le ditshwantsho tsa batho mo tsamaiso ya difaele di ga affected. target polokelotshedimosetso tshwanetse nna e a tsamaya.
sandstorm-migration-description: Fa WeKan runs mo teng e Sandstorm grain, ya sona kgale MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso ke e hudusitswe go FerretDB v1 (SQLite) mo ntlha launch, le dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le ditshwantsho tsa batho di e sutisitswe go tswa polokelotshedimosetso go grain's difaele/dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le difaele/ditshwantsho tsa batho directories. Eno bontsha whether seo khuduso succeeded le how much disiki sebaka kgale e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB polokelotshedimosetso difaele sa ntse dirisa mo teng grain, le lets wena phimola tseo e e sa baakanngwang difaele go mahala sebaka.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: E e sa baakanngwang MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso difaele
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Phimola e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB polokelotshedimosetso difaele
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Morago e successful khuduso tshedimosetso lives mo FerretDB le mo tsamaiso ya difaele, jalo kgale e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso difaele ka kgona nna e phimotswe go mahala grain disiki sebaka. Seno ga se ka ke sa dirololwa.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Phimola e e sa baakanngwang MongoDB 3 polokelotshedimosetso difaele go mahala disiki sebaka? tshedimosetso e na le setse nnile e hudusitswe go FerretDB le tsamaiso ya difaele. Seno ga se ka ke sa dirololwa.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: E e sa baakanngwang MongoDB polokelotshedimosetso difaele e phimotswe, freed
features-desc: Dikarolo tsa boitlhophelo tse WeKan eno e di neelang. Karolo e e sa tshwaiwang e fitlhwa mo ponagalong ya mongwe le mongwe. Tshedimosetso ya yone e a bolokwa mme ditetla ga di fetoge.
feature-views-table-desc: Boto jaaka tafole ya dikarata tse di ka rulaganngwang.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khalendara le khalendara ya diboto tse dintsi.
feature-views-overview-desc: Dipalopalo, go kgaoganya ka ditlhopha go ya ka motho yo o abetsweng, thulaganyo ya tsela, boto ya taolo le boto e kgolo.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Diponagalo tse tharo tsa tšhate ya Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Lenaane la ditiro tsa sedirisiwa, dipaka tse dikhutshwane tsa tiro, pego ya paka ya tiro le lebelo.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Tiro e e setseng le e e weditsweng, kelelo e e kgobokaneng, nako ya modikologo le ya go isa, selekanyo sa tiro e e weditsweng, nako e tiro e ntseng e le teng, dikgoreletsi, Monte Carlo le dilekanyo tse dingwe tsa kelelo.
feature-views-map-desc: Dikarata jaaka matshwao mo setshwantshong se se tsentsweng.
feature-approval-required: Tlogela dikarolo tse dintšhafatso tsa WeKan di di tsenyang di timilwe go fitlha motsamaisi a di bulela
feature-preview-admins: Batsamaisi ba bona dikarolo tse di timilweng gore ba di leke pele
feature-pilot-users: Badirisi ba teko ba ba bonang le dikarolo tse di timilweng
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Maina a badirisi, a kgaogantswe ka dikhoma
feature-profiles-desc: Porofaele e fitlha dikarolo tse di tshwailweng mo badirising, ditlhopheng le ditheong tse e di abetsweng. Modirisi o bolelelwa gore o na le porofaele efe. Ga go ope yo o senang porofaele yo o amegang, ga go data e e phimolwang mme ga go tetla e e fetogang.
feature-profile-teams: Ditlhopha, se le sengwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe
feature-profile-orgs: Ditheo, se le sengwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe
feature-profile-unknown: E bolokilwe. Ga e a bonwa:
feature-profile-notice: Porofaele ya gago ya dikarolo __name__ e fitlha dikarolo di le __count__. Botsa motsamaisi fa o tlhoka nngwe ya tsone.
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Di bolokilwe. Maina ano a badirisi ga a bonwa:
card-field-visibility-desc: Mafelo a Dipeakanyo tsa Boto / Karata a diboto di ka a bontshang. Lebala le le sa tshwaiwang le fitlhiwa mo karateng nngwe le nngwe, karateng-potlana le mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Karata tsa boto nngwe le nngwe. Ga go data ya karata kgotsa peakanyo ya boto e e fetogang, mme go le tshwaya gape go bontsha boto nngwe le nngwe jaaka e ne e beilwe. Thulaganyo ya mafelo ke ya boto nngwe le nngwe.
cards-loading-auto: Ya boitiriso (bonya fela go big diboto)
cards-loading-description: WeKan loads boto dikarata ka boitiriso: e big boto (over bogolo threshold) loads fela dikarata currently bonalang (infinite scroll) plus e live palo, jalo sona stays fast le e dirisa less segopotso le bandwidth, fa smaller diboto laisa nngwe le nngwe karata go simplest, fully featured experience. Foo ke ga go sepe go configure. Badiri ka kgona sa ntse pateletsa e mokgwa ka CARDS_LOADING (tsotlhe/bonya/auto) le CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Bonya karata e a laisa ke experimental: karata counters le WIP ditekanyetso di accurate, but Calendar/Table/Gantt views le multi-select reflect fela dikarata loaded jalo far. Reload bula diboto morago changing eno.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe dikgokagano (both Markdown dikgokagano jaaka [letshwao](url) le e e sa baakanngwang HTML <a href> ditshwao) di ka metlha bontshitswe jaaka tlwaelegileng, non-clickable mokwalwa mo nngwe le nngwe rich mokwalwa lefelo (boto le karata ditlhogo, ditlhaloso, ditlhaloso, checklists, etc.). Eno prevents misleading e e ka tobetswang dikgokagano. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe, jalo dikgokagano stay e e ka tobetswang.
always-show-code-as-text: Ka metlha bontsha tsotlhe khoutu jaaka tlwaelegileng mokwalwa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Fa e tshubilwe, rich mokwalwa ke le ka motlha rendered jaaka Markdown kgotsa HTML: entire motswedi ke ka metlha bontshitswe jaaka tlwaelegileng mokwalwa mo nngwe le nngwe rich mokwalwa lefelo (boto le karata ditlhogo, ditlhaloso, ditlhaloso, checklists, etc.). Eno reveals e fitlhilwe diteng — HTML ditlhaloso (<!-- -->), target ya Markdown dikgokagano, JavaScript le le fa e le efe nngwe khoutu — jalo tsotlhe khoutu ke ka metlha bonalang, ga e e ka tobetswang, le ga e a tsamaya. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe, jalo Markdown ke rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe tlisa features di turned timilwe: go tlisa e boto go tswa WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le Forgejo, jaaka well jaaka cloning e boto. tlisa menu options di e fitlhilwe le seabi rejects le fa e le efe tlisa kopo. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
import-max-megabytes: Go tsenya mo teng go gologolo (MB)
import-max-megabytes-description: Faele e kgolo go gaisa e tsebe ya go tsenya mo teng e e amogelang, ka dimegabyte. Fa go se na sepe go raya gore ga go na tekanyetso: faele e ka nna kgolo fela jaaka sebaka se se gololesegileng mo diskeng se letlelela go tsenya go fela. Go laisa gongwe le gongwe go kwalwa mo diskeng ya seva karolo ka karolo, mme go tsenya go go ka tlatsang diske go a ganwa.
import-disk-full: Ga go na sebaka se se lekaneng se se gololesegileng mo diskeng ya seva sa go tsenya mo.
import-upload-not-found: Faele e e laisitsweng ga e tlhole e le teng. E tlhophe gape.
import-upload-failed: Faele ga e a kgona go laisiwa.
disable-all-export-description: Fa e tshubilwe, tsotlhe romelela kwa ntle features di turned timilwe: go romelela kwa ntle e boto jaaka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kgotsa go NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, le single-attachment romelela kwa ntle. romelela kwa ntle menu options di e fitlhilwe le seabi rejects le fa e le efe romelela kwa ntle kopo. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Fa e tshubilwe, ditshwantsho tsa batho (modirisi profile pictures) di le ka motlha e tlisitswe. Eno covers WeKan JSON tlisa, Trello tlisa, le setshwantsho sa motho rulaganya mmogo go tswa external identity providers mo go tsena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names le nngwe tshedimosetso di sa ntse e tlisitswe; fela ditshwantsho tsa batho di skipped. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-export-avatars: Tima romelela kwa ntle ditshwantsho tsa batho
disable-export-avatars-description: Fa e tshubilwe, ditshwantsho tsa batho (modirisi profile pictures) di le ka motlha included fa go romelela kwa ntle e boto (WeKan JSON le CSV romelela kwa ntle). Usernames le nngwe tshedimosetso di sa ntse e rometswe kwa ntle; fela ditshwantsho tsa batho di omitted. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
anonymize-import-users-description: Fa e tshubilwe, go tlisa e WeKan JSON boto emisetsa nngwe le nngwe e tlisitswe user's leina la modirisi, tletse leina le initials ka sebaledi placeholders (modirisi1, modirisi2,...), drops tsa bone setshwantsho sa motho, le rewrites @leina la modirisi mentions (le requested-by / assigned-by mafelo) mo teng e tlisitswe karata le tlhaloso diteng. Nnyaa real modirisi identity go tswa motswedi boto ke e bolokilwe. word "modirisi" e latela puo ya motho go tlisa. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
anonymize-export-users-description: Fa e tshubilwe, go romelela kwa ntle e boto emisetsa nngwe le nngwe e rometswe kwa ntle user's leina la modirisi, tletse leina le initials ka sebaledi placeholders (modirisi1, modirisi2,...), drops tsa bone setshwantsho sa motho, le rewrites @leina la modirisi mentions (le requested-by / assigned-by mafelo) mo teng karata le tlhaloso diteng. e rometswe kwa ntle faele carries nnyaa real modirisi identity. word "modirisi" e latela puo ya motho go romelela kwa ntle. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Fa e tshubilwe, go romelela kwa ntle e boto emisetsa nngwe le nngwe e rometswe kwa ntle user's leina la modirisi, tletse leina le initials ka sebaledi placeholders (modirisi1, modirisi2,...), drops tsa bone setshwantsho sa motho, le rewrites @leina la modirisi mentions (le requested-by / assigned-by mafelo) mo teng karata le tlhaloso diteng. e rometswe kwa ntle faele carries nnyaa real modirisi identity. word "modirisi" e latela puo ya motho go romelela kwa ntle. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-activities-description: Fa e tshubilwe, activity-feed entries di le ka motlha rekotilwe le le ka motlha bontshitswe anywhere (boto bara ya letlhakore le karata tiragalo tab). Nnyaa hisetori ya who did eng ke kept. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-notifications-description: Fa e tshubilwe, WeKan le ka motlha sends lebelela dikitsiso (in-app, imeile kgotsa nngwe services) go le fa e le efe tiragalo. Ditiragalo ka kgona sa ntse nna rekotilwe (unless also e timilwe fa godimo); fela dikitsiso di suppressed. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
disable-watch-description: Fa e tshubilwe, lebelela feature ke turned timilwe — badirisi ga e kgone subscribe go diboto, manane kgotsa dikarata go amogela dikitsiso, le le fa e le efe attempt go fetola e lebelela level ke rejected. Ya tlwaelo ke timilwe.
backup-description: Dira bekapo ya difaele tse di kgomareditsweng, ditshwantsho tsa badirisi le/kgotsa tshedimosetso (dikgobokanyo tsotlhe tsa mokwalo tse e seng difaele tse di kgomareditsweng kgotsa ditshwantsho tsa badirisi). Faele ya .zip e romelwa ka tlhamalalo kwa polokelong e e tlhophilweng, ntle le faele ya nakwana, jaaka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e e nang le YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le /data. Mabolokelo a leru (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) a dirisa dintlha tsa tetla tse di rulagantsweng mo dithebeng tsa one tsa polokelo.
backup-scope-description: whole tiragalo, kgotsa nngwe Mokgatlho. E Organization's bekapo e na le ya sona diboto le everything mo bone, including dilo tse di tshwaraganeng ya tseo diboto — but nnyaa modirisi diakhaonto le nnyaa tiragalo dithulaganyo, because tseo di aroganetswe ka nngwe le nngwe Mokgatlho. Restoring e Organization's bekapo fela ever writes go diboto seo Mokgatlho owns.
theme-override-all-tenants: Override seo applies go tsotlhe tenants
continuous-backup-description: E romela phetogo nngwe le nngwe ya polokelotshedimosetso, difaele tse di kgomareditsweng, ditshwantsho tsa badirisi le direkoto kwa foldareng mo metsotswaneng e se kae, gore go busediwe seemo sa nako nngwe le nngwe. E dira mmogo le bekapo e e rulaganyeditsweng nako, e e dirang mabolokelo a a feletseng.
continuous-backup-enabled: Dirisa bekapo e e tswelelang mo sefareng seno
continuous-backup-target: Foldara e go yang kwa go yone (tsela e e feletseng mo disiking e nngwe, mo lefelong le le abelanwang la netweke kgotsa mo lefelong le le golagantsweng ka rclone)
wekan-data-no-database: Ga go a bonwa polokelotshedimosetso ya WeKan e e balegang.
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (ka nako ya nnete, phetogo nngwe le nngwe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Ditsebe tsa SQLite (ditsebe tse di fetogileng mo pakeng nngwe le nngwe)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (lenaneo le o ka tlhophang go le tsenya)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Ga go na enjene ya polokelotshedimosetso e e ka dirang mo sefareng seno
continuous-backup-sqlite-interval: Nako magareng ga ditlhatlhobo tsa SQLite (metsotswana)
continuous-backup-base-every: Dira bekapo ya motheo e ntšha morago ga (diura)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faele ya selotlolo sa go fitlha ka khoutu (tsela e e feletseng kwa ntle ga foldara e go yang kwa go yone; ditlhaka tse 64 tsa thulaganyo ya dipalo e e ikaegileng ka 16 kgotsa polelwana ya sephiri e e nang le bonnye ditlhaka tse 16). Boloka kopi: ntle le faele eno bekapo ga e ka ke ya busediwa.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Ga go na lefelo (mo foldareng e go yang kwa go yone fela)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Foldara mo teng ga setshodi sa polokelo
continuous-backup-fetched: Difaele di tserwe go tswa mo lerung
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Faele e e ka tsamaisiwang ya Litestream (tsela e e feletseng)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faele ya polokelotshedimosetso ya SQLite (e dirwa fa thoko ga bekapo, ga e ke e kwala mo godimo ga faele e e dirisiwang)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Dirisa polokelotshedimosetso ya SQLite e e agilweng sesha fa tsamaiso e simolola gape mo nakong e e tlang (polokelotshedimosetso ya bogologolo e e emisediwang e tla bolokwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Busetsa kokomana e e tlhophilweng mo seemong sa nako e e tlhophilweng? Bekapo e e tswelelang e tla ema nakwana fa go ntse go busediwa.
continuous-backup-saved: Dithulaganyo tsa bekapo e e tswelelang di bolokilwe
backup-restore-select-first: Tlhopha e bekapo go tswa lenaane ntlha.
backup-restore-confirm: A go busediwe bekapo e e tlhophilweng? Difaele tse di kgomareditsweng le ditshwantsho tsa badirisi di tla kwalwa mo tsamaisong ya difaele, mme tshedimosetso e tla kwalwa mo polokelotshedimosetsong go ya ka mokgwa o o tlhophilweng.
gcs-key-filename-description: Boikgethelo: tsela go e tirelo akhaonto JSON senotlolo faele mo seabi.
gcs-credentials-description: Boikgethelo: kgomaretsa tirelo akhaonto JSON senotlolo. Tlogela e lolea go dirisa senotlolo faele kgotsa ya tlwaelo dintlha tsa tetla.
gcs-permissions-note: Give WeKan's tirelo akhaonto bala/write tetla go setshelo: Google Leru Console → Leru Polokelo → Buckets → ya gago setshelo → Permissions → Grant tetla. Mo "Ntšhwa principals", kgomaretsa tirelo akhaonto imeile — "client_imeile" boleng go tswa ya gago JSON senotlolo — morago foo tlhopha maikarabelo "Polokelo Object Molaodi" le Boloka.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Tlogela e lolea go keep ya jaanong boleng.
azure-account-name-description: leina ya ya gago Azure Polokelo akhaonto.
azure-container-description: blob container go store difaele mo.
gcs-project-id-description: Ya gago Google Leru porojeke id.
gcs-bucket-description: leina ya Leru Polokelo setshelo go store difaele mo.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: tlogela e lolea (e dirisa region endpoint). S3-compatible: Endpoint URL go tswa ya gago MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Dibaka console.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ya gago setshelo → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ya gago setshelo leina (kgotsa Dira setshelo → Setshelo leina).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Badirisi → ya gago modirisi → Tshireletso dintlha tsa tetla → Tetla dinotlolo → Dira tetla senotlolo → tlhopha dirisa case 'Application e a tsamaya outside AWS' → Dira tetla senotlolo. Bontshitswe jaaka 'Tetla senotlolo ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Tshwana screen jaaka Tetla senotlolo ID; 'Secret tetla key' ke bontshitswe fela gangwe fa senotlolo ke e dirilwe — kopolola sona morago foo (kgotsa Kopololela.csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Kgoro → Polokelo diakhaonto → ya gago akhaonto → leina bontshitswe kwa godimo (also fa tlase ga Tshireletso + networking → Tetla dinotlolo → Polokelo akhaonto leina).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Kgoro → Polokelo diakhaonto → ya gago akhaonto → Tshireletso + networking → Tetla dinotlolo → senotlolo1 → Bontsha → Senotlolo.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Kgoro → Polokelo diakhaonto → ya gago akhaonto → Tshireletso + networking → Tetla dinotlolo → senotlolo1 → Kgokagano mokwalwa → Bontsha.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Kgoro → Polokelo diakhaonto → ya gago akhaonto → Tshedimosetso polokelo → Containers → ya gago container (kgotsa + Container go dira nngwe).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Leru Console → porojeke selector kwa godimo → ya gago project's ID (Leru overview → Dashboard → Porojeke tshedimosetso → Porojeke ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Leru Console → Leru Polokelo → Buckets → ya gago setshelo leina (kgotsa Dira go make nngwe).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Tsela mo WeKan seabi go downloaded tirelo akhaonto JSON senotlolo faele (e dirilwe fa tlase). Dirisa eno OR kgomaretsa JSON into lefelo fa tlase.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Leru Console → IAM & Molaodi → Tirelo diakhaonto → ya gago tirelo akhaonto → Dinotlolo → Tsenya senotlolo → Dira ntšhwa senotlolo → JSON → Dira (downloads faele). Kgomaretsa ya sona contents fano, kgotsa boloka faele le beakanya ya sona tsela fa godimo.
cloud-secret-set: (e bolokilwe — tlogela e lolea go keep)
cloud-settings-desc: Ka WeKan mo Weddy, Cloud Panel e direla di-domain di le dintsi tsa WeKan go tswa mo seveng e le nngwe, nngwe le nngwe e na le data ya yone. Mo domain ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin o laola di-domain le CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ke ya SuperAdmin fela, mo domain ya Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ka selotlolo sa CloudFlare API, domain e zone ya yone e leng mo akhaontong ya gago ya CloudFlare e bona rekoto ya DNS e e fetang ka proxy le setifikeiti sa CloudFlare Origin. Di-domain tse dingwe di bona setifikeiti sa Let's Encrypt. Selotlolo se bolokwa mo seveng mme ga se kitla se bontshiwa gape.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Selotlolo sa CloudFlare API se bolokilwe.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Ga go na selotlolo sa CloudFlare API se se bolokilweng: domain nngwe le nngwe e bona setifikeiti sa Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Sutisa se se tshwaraganeng go Azure Blob Polokelo
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Sutisa se se tshwaraganeng go Google Leru Polokelo
gridfs-enabled-description: Dirisa MongoDB GridFS go faele polokelo
migration-stop-confirm: E o tlhomamisegile wena batla go emisa tsotlhe dikhuduso?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Go na le dilo tse di tshwaraganeng le ditshwantsho tsa batho bonalang, sutisa bone go tswa CollectionFS go le fa e le efe nngwe Polokelo.
s3-access-key-description: AWS S3 tetla senotlolo go netefatso
s3-bucket-description: Leina la bekere ya S3 la go boloka difaele
s3-enabled-description: Dirisa AWS S3 kgotsa MinIO go faele polokelo
s3-endpoint-description: URL ya bofelo jwa S3 (ka sekai, s3.amazonaws.com kgotsa minio.example.com)
s3-port-description: Nomoro ya kou ya bofelo jwa S3
s3-secret-key-description: AWS S3 secret senotlolo go netefatso
s3-secret-key-required: Senotlolo sa sephiri sa S3 se a tlhokega
s3-settings-saved: Dipeakanyo tsa S3 di bolokilwe sentle
writable-path-description: Base directory tsela go faele polokelo
card-show-lists-on-minicard: Bontsha Manane mo Karata e nnye

fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Detects le dipaakanyo e tlhaela kgotsa corrupted manane mo boto sebopego.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Dintšhwafatso setshwantsho sa motho URLs go boto maloko go dirisa siameng polokelo karolo ya morago le dipaakanyo broken setshwantsho sa motho references.

Fela truly redundant ga e na sepe manane tla nna e tlositswe. Tswelela?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Eno tla dira e 'Latlhegile Cards' tsela le busetsa dikarata tsotlhe le manane ka e tlhaela swimlaneId kgotsa listId. Eno fela affects non-archived dilo. Tswelela?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Eno tla busetsa ALL e bolokilweng ditsela, manane, le dikarata, making bone bonalang gape. Le fa e le efe dilo ka e tlhaela IDs tla nna ka boitiriso e baakantswe. Eno ga e kgone nna easily undone. Tswelela?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Eno tla lemoga le baakanya e tlhaela kgotsa corrupted manane mo boto sebopego. Tswelela?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Eno tla ntšhwafatsa setshwantsho sa motho URLs go boto maloko go dirisa siameng polokelo karolo ya morago. Tswelela?

email-recovery-description: Mola o le mongwe wa moamogedi mongwe le mongwe. Batla ka ID ya modirisi. Diteng tsa molaetsa le dikarolo tsa imeile tsa moamogedi ga di bontshiwe. Go ema nakwana go tshwara melaetsa e e leng teng le e e tlang; Go tswelela go leka gape go romela melaetsa e e mo moleng gone jaanong. Go khansela go tlosa melaetsa e e tsentsweng mo moleng go fitlha ka nako ya kopo. Fa go romela go tshwaregile, leka gape morago ga nakwana. Molaetsa o o setseng o simolotse go romelwa ga o ka ke wa busediwa morago, mme go romela mo go nang le dipholo tse di sa tlhomamang go ka boelediwa. Go palelwa ga leruri le melaetsa e e fitlheletseng tekanyetso ya maiteko di sala gore di sekasekiwe. Go leka gape melaetsa e e paletsweng go simolola modikologo o mosha wa maiteko mme go boloka go ema nakwana mo go setseng go le teng.
email-recovery-saving: Mola wa diimeile o a ntšhafadiwa…
email-recovery-attempts: Palo e e kwa godimo thata ya go leka gape
email-recovery-oldest: Nako ya ntlha ya go tsenngwa mo moleng
email-recovery-changed: Phetogo ya bofelo ya motsamaisi wa tiro
email-recovery-cancel: Khansela melaetsa e e mo moleng
email-recovery-pending: E emetse kgotsa e lekiwa gape
email-recovery-empty: Ga go melaetsa mo moleng e bile ga go baamogedi ba go romela go emisitsweng nakwana mo go bone.
email-recovery-unavailable: Ga go kgonege go buisa mola wa diimeile. Lekola ditshwanelo tsa motsamaisi le go nna teng ga sefepi.
email-recovery-busy: Go romela kgotsa tiro e nngwe ya mola e a tswelela. Ntšhafatsa mme o leke gape morago ga nakwana.
email-recovery-failed: Tiro ga e a kgona go netefadiwa. Ntšhafatsa mola mme o leke tiro e e tshwanang gape fa go tlhokega.
email-recovery-superseded: Tiro e ntšha ya motsamaisi e tsere maemo a kopo eno. Go bontshiwa seemo sa jaanong sa mola.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela melaetsa yotlhe e e mo moleng gone jaanong ya moamogedi yono? Diteng tsa yona di tla tlosiwa mme di ka se busediwe. Melaetsa e mesha e e bopilweng morago ga kopo eno e tla bolokwa.
email-recovery-stopped: Melaetsa e e emisitsweng go romelwa
email-recovery-retry: Leka gape go romela melaetsa e e paletsweng
email-failure-smtp-authentication: Netefatso ya poso e tlhoka tlhokomelo
email-failure-smtp-configuration: Dipeakanyo tsa poso di tlhoka tlhokomelo
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Moamogedi ga a yo kgotsa akhaonto e tswetswe
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Go romela ga go a kgona go netefadiwa; sekaseka pele o leka gape
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Netefatso ya kamogelo ga e a kgona go bolokwa
email-failure-delivery-failed: Go romela kgotsa go baakanya go paletswe
email-failure-retry-limit: Tekanyetso ya maiteko a boitiriso e fitlheletswe
sync-remaining-time: Kakanyetso ya nako e e setseng (diura)
sync-time-estimate-hint: Dikakanyetso tsa nako di dirisa mafelo a dinomoro a nako ya ntlha/e e setseng a a dirilweng ke go tsenya ga Jira. Go tshwanetse go nna le lebala le le lengwe fela le le tsamaisanang mo botong e. Diphetogo tsa selegae di sekasekwa jaaka dikgotlhang; maboleng a motswedi a a seyong a a tlhokomologiwa mme null e e tlhamaletseng e phimola boleng.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint le diphatlalatso di tsamaisanngwa fela fa Scrum e bulegile mo botong e. Sprint kgotsa phatlalatso e e seyong e dirwa mo botong e, ka matlha a motswedi o a nayang; e e leng teng e tsamaisanngwa ka ID ya motswedi pele, go tswa foo ka leina. Phetogo ya thulaganyo ya selegae e nna go fitlha motswedi o fetola thulaganyo ya bothata joo, mme Sync ya ntlha ga e ke e tlosa thulaganyo.
activity-recovery-heading: Dikitsiso tsa ditiragalo tse di emetseng
activity-recovery-description: Dikitsiso tse di sa fedang di lekwa gape ka boitiriso. Sekaseka ditiragalo tse di seyong kgotsa tse di fetogileng pele o leka gape. Go leka gape ga go ke go dira tiragalo gape.
activity-recovery-empty: Ga go na dikitsiso tsa ditiragalo tse di emetseng.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Ga go a kgonega go tsenya dikitsiso tsa ditiragalo tse di emetseng.
activity-recovery-retrying: Go ntšhwafatsa go romelwa ga dikitsiso…
activity-recovery-status-processing: Peeletso ya go romela e a dira
activity-recovery-status-missing: Tiragalo ya ntlha ga e yo
activity-recovery-status-invalid: Metadata ya pusetso e e sa siamang
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Leano le tiragalo e e emetseng ga di dumalane
activity-recovery-busy: Modiri o mongwe o tshwere kitsiso e. Ntšhwafatsa mme o leke gape.
activity-recovery-denied: Phitlhelelo ya moamogedi kgotsa dikeletso tsa dikitsiso ga di sa letla go romela.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Tiragalo ya ntlha ga e yo kgotsa e fetogile. Ga go sepe se se dirilweng gape.
activity-recovery-failed: Ga go a kgonega go wetsa go romela kitsiso. Tiro e e emetseng e bolokilwe.
activity-recovery-paused: Go romela dikitsiso tsa ditiragalo go emisitswe.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Kitsiso e e fetogile fa e sena go tsenngwa. Sekaseka boemo jo bo ntšhwafaditsweng pele o leka gape.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Ga go a kgonega go netefatsa peakanyo ya go romela. Ntšhwafatsa mme o sekaseke boemo jwa yona jwa jaanong.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: Go romela dikitsiso tsa ditiragalo go khanseletswe.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Khansela ka ruri go romela go go setseng ga tiragalo e? Se ga se kgone go tswelediwa. Imeile e e setseng e le mo moleng le dikitsiso tse di setseng di romilwe ga di busediwe.
rule-email-recovery-heading: Go goroga ga diimeile tsa melao
rule-email-recovery-description: Sekaseka maiteko a a kwadilweng a go romela diimeile tsa melao. Maiteko a a sa netefadiwang a ka tswa a sa ntse a romela kgotsa a kgoreleditswe. Bula lengwe ka "Sekaseka" go le romela gape, go le tshwaya le rometswe kgotsa go le khansela.
rule-email-recovery-sent: E amogetswe ke seva ya imeile
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Tshedimosetso e e tlhalosang teko ga e a siama
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ga go na maiteko a go romela diimeile tsa melao a a tsamaelanang le patlo eno.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Ga go a kgonega go tsenya maiteko a imeile a melao. Ntšhwafatsa go leka gape.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ga e ke e romela gape ka boyone imeile e e sa netefadiwang. Go romela gape go ya fela kwa baamogeding ba ba sa netefadiwang. E tshwaye e rometswe fa o itse gore e gorogile, kgotsa o khansele go romela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Go romela ga ntlha go ka tswa go sa ntse go tsweletse. O ka dira tshwetso morago ga __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Romela gape kwa baamogeding ba ba sa netefadiwang
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Romela imeile eno gape kwa baamogeding ba ba sa netefadiwang? Motho yo seva ya gagwe ya imeile e amogetseng molaetsa mme ya se ka ya itsise WeKan o tla o amogela gabedi.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Tshwaya imeile eno e rometswe kwa go botlhe? Dira seno fela fa o itse gore e gorogile.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Khansela go romela imeile eno? Ga e kitla e romelwa kwa baamogeding ba ba sa netefadiwang.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Go romela ga ntlha go ka tswa go sa ntse go tsweletse. Leka gape moragonyana.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Imeile eno e setse e rarabolotswe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Go romela gape ga pele go ka tswa go sa ntse go tsweletse. Leka gape moragonyana.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Baamogedi botlhe ba setse ba netefaditswe. Mo boemong jwa go romela gape, e tshwaye e rometswe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva ya imeile ga e a araba. Molaetsa o o rometsweng gape o ka tswa o gorogile kgotsa o sa goroga; o bontshiwa o sa ntse o tsweletse.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Motsamaisi yo mongwe o rarabolola imeile eno. Leka gape mo nakong e khutshwane.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeile e e bolokilweng ga e tlhole e tsamaelana le teko eno, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya rarabololwa fano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Rekoto e e bolokilweng ya teko eno ga e a siama, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya rarabololwa fano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Imeile eno ga e a kgona go rarabololwa. Tsosolosa tsebe mme o leke gape.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Diimeile tsa melawana tse di emetseng tshekatsheko
rule-email-legacy-description: Diimeile tseno tsa melawana di baakantswe ke mofuta wa pele wa WeKan o o neng o sa kwale gore diteng tsa tsone di tswa kae, ka jalo WeKan ga e kitla e di romela ka boyone. Morago ga go netefatsa gore mokwadi wa molawana o sa ntse a na le tetla ya phitlhelelo, golaganya imeile gape gore e baakanngwe go ya ka seemo sa karata sa jaanong, kgotsa o e latlhe.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Dintlha tsa karata tsa mofuta wa bogologolo
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Baakanya imeile eno gape go ya ka seemo sa karata sa jaanong? Diteng tsa yone di ka farologana le tse di baakantsweng pele.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Latlha imeile eno? Ga e kitla e romelwa le ka motlha.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Ga go na diimeile tsa melawana tse di emetseng tshekatsheko.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Diimeile tsa melawana tse di emetseng tshekatsheko ga di a kgona go laisiwa. Tsosolosa tsebe go leka gape.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Mokwadi wa molawana ga a tlhole a na le tetla ya go fitlhelela karata eno, kgotsa molawana o fetogile, ka jalo imeile ga e ka ke ya golaganngwa gape. O ka e latlha.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Tiragalo e e bakileng imeile eno e fetogile, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya golaganngwa gape. O ka e latlha.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Karata e imeile eno e tswang mo go yone ga e tlhole e le teng, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya golaganngwa gape. O ka e latlha.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Tiragatso ya molawana e e baakantseng imeile eno ga e tlhole e bolokilwe, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya golaganngwa gape. O ka e latlha.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imeile eno e setse e rometswe, go lekilwe go e romela, kgotsa e latlhilwe.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Imeile eno e setse e golagantswe gape.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Tiro eno ga e a kgona go wediwa. Tsosolosa tsebe mme o leke gape.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Ditiro tsa List Sync tse di sa kgoneng go boeletswa
stuck-sync-operation-description: Tiro nngwe le nngwe ya List Sync e e bolokilweng e emile fa gare mme ga e sa kgone go wediwa, ka gonne lenaane la yona le tlositswe, le dirilwe gape kgotsa le baakantswe gape, kgotsa modirisi yo o e simolotseng o latlhegetswe ke phitlhelelo ya go kwala. Fa nngwe e sa ntse e emetse, lenaane leo ga le kgone go dira Sync. E latlhe go letla lenaane go dira Sync gape: diphetogo tse di setseng di dirisitswe di a nna, diphetogo tse di setseng tse di bolokilweng ga di ke di kwalwa, mme Sync e e latelang e bapisa lenaane le motswedi wa lona gape.
stuck-sync-operation-applied: diphetogo di le __applied__ tsa __total__ di dirisitswe
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Lenaane le tlositswe, le dirilwe gape kgotsa dipeakanyo tsa lona tsa Sync di fetogile
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Modirisi yo o e simolotseng ga a sa na phitlhelelo ya go kwala mo lenaaneng lotlhe
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: E bolokilwe ke bešene ya pele ya WeKan kwa ntle ga se se e simolotseng
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Rekoto ya gore ke mang yo o e simolotseng ga e yo
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: Ga e a kgona go tlhatlhobiwa jaanong
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: E ka boeletswa gape jaanong mme e tla fela ka boyona, ka jalo ga e kgone go latlhiwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Latlha tiro e ya List Sync e e bolokilweng? Diphetogo tse e setseng e di dirisitse di a nna; tse di setseng ga di ke di kwalwa. Lenaane le ka dira Sync gape morago ga foo.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Ga go na ditiro tsa List Sync tse di emetseng tshekatsheko.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Ke tse di le 50 tse di kgologolo fela tse di bontshiwang. Latlha dingwe mme o ntšhwafatse go bona tse dingwe.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Ga go a kgonega go tsenya ditiro tsa List Sync. Ntšhwafatsa go leka gape.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: Tiro e ga e sa emetse.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Tiro e ga e a fitlhelwa e kgomaretse, ka jalo ga e kgone go latlhiwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Tiro e e ka boeletswa gape jaanong mme e tla fela ka boyona, ka jalo ga e a latlhiwa.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Lenaane le le dira Sync jaanong. Leka gape morago ga nakwana.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Tiro eno ga e a kgona go wediwa. Tsosolosa tsebe mme o leke gape.
interrupted-import-heading: Go tsenya diboto go go emeng pele go fela
interrupted-import-description: Go tsenya boto nngwe le nngwe ga tse go emile fa gare - seva e simolotse gape, kgotsa go tsenya go paletswe - mme ga tlogela boto e e sa feleletsang. Go tsenya ga go kgone go tswelediwa, ka gonne faele ya motswedi wa gona ga e a bolokwa. Boloka boto jaaka e ntse, kgotsa e latlhe mme o tsenye faele gape. Go latlha go tlosa boto e go tsenya go go e dirileng le sengwe le sengwe se se mo go yona, go akaretsa sengwe le sengwe se se tsentsweng mo go yona fa e sena go dirwa.
interrupted-import-created: Tse di dirilweng go fitlha jaanong
interrupted-import-state-stopped: E emile e sa fela, kwa __stage__
interrupted-import-state-discarding: E a latlhiwa; latlha gape go wetsa
interrupted-import-scrum: Legato la yona la Scrum le na le ntlha ya lona ya tlhatlhobo (__state__, __next__ ya dikgato di le __total__). Fa o boloka boto, e wetse kgotsa e latlhe go tswa mo pusetsong ya go tsenya Scrum ya boto.
interrupted-import-counts: ditsela di le __swimlanes__, manaane a le __lists__, dikarata di le __cards__, manaane a tlhatlhobo a le __checklists__, ditshwaelo di le __comments__, tse di tshwaraganeng di le __attachments__
interrupted-import-no-board: Ga go boto e e dirilweng
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Boloka boto e e sa feleletsang jaaka e ntse? Ga go sepe se se tlosiwang, mme go tsenya ga go sa tlhole go kwadilwe fano.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Latlha go tsenya go? Boto e go e dirileng le sengwe le sengwe se se mo go yona di tlosiwa ka ruri.
interrupted-import-empty: Ga go na go tsenya diboto go go kgoreleditsweng go go emetseng tshekatsheko.
interrupted-import-truncated: Ke tse di le 50 tse di kgologolo fela tse di bontshiwang. Boloka kgotsa latlha dingwe mme o ntšhwafatse go bona tse dingwe.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Ga go a kgonega go tsenya go tsenya diboto go go kgoreleditsweng. Ntšhwafatsa go leka gape.
interrupted-import-missing: Go tsenya go ga go sa tlhole go kwadilwe.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Go tsenya go ga go sa tlhole go emetse tshwetso.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Boto e e nang le id e ga e a dirwa ke go tsenya go, ka jalo ga e a amiwa.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Legato la yona la Scrum le sa ntse le kwalwa kgotsa le busediwa. Leka gape morago ga metsotso e le mmalwa.
interrupted-import-failed: Tiro eno ga e a kgona go wediwa. Tsosolosa tsebe mme o leke gape.
saml-login-not-started: Go tsena gono ka SAML ga go a simololwa mo thebong eno ya sebatli. Tsweetswee tsena gape.
history-request-pending-undo: Seva ga e ise e tlhomamise go dirolola phetogo ya gago ya bofelo.
history-request-pending-redo: Seva ga e ise e tlhomamise go dira phetogo ya gago ya bofelo gape.
history-request-hint: Go leka gape go boeletsa kopo e e tshwanang, ka jalo go ka se dirolole phetogo ya bobedi.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Go dirolola, go dira gape kgotsa go busetsa diphetogo tsa Scrum go emile ka ntlha ya kgotlhang. Diphetogo tsa Scrum mo botong e di thibetswe go fitlha e rarabololwa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: diphetogo di le __applied__ tsa __total__ di kwadilwe, __pending__ ga di a kwalwa, mme __conflicted__ di fetotswe ke mongwe fa e sena go nna jalo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Go busetsa morago go baya rekoto nngwe le nngwe e e fetotsweng jaaka e ne e ntse pele; go neelwa fela fa go se ope o sele yo o fetotseng direkoto tseo fa e sena go nna jalo. Go boloka boto jaaka e ntse go tlosa tiro e e emeng mme ga go fetole direkoto dipe. Ka tsela epe, go kwalwa mo Phaneleng ya Motsamaisi, Mathata, Pusetso.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Boloka rekoto nngwe le nngwe jaaka e ntse jaanong, go akaretsa diphetogo tse tiro e e emeng e setseng e di kwadile?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Motsamaisi wa boto a ka e busetsa morago kgotsa a boloka boto jaaka e ntse.
header-login: Go tsena ka ditlhogo tsa HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Tlosa boleng jo bo bolokilweng mo phaneleng ya motsamaisi
login-setting-after-restart: E simolola go dira fa WeKan e sena go simololwa gape
login-setting-env-only: Ke tikologo ya seva fela e e bayang tse. Di bontshiwa fano go bala fela.
email-to-card-description: Imeile e e romelwang kwa atereseng ya boto ya gago e nna karata mo botong eo.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook e e tsenang ya motlamedi wa imeile (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark kgotsa MIME relay e e tala)
email-to-card-secret-saved: E bolokilwe - tlogela go se na sepe go e boloka
email-to-card-clear-secret: Tlosa sephiri sa webhook se se bolokilweng
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Mabokose a imeile a IMAP a a tshwanetseng go balwa
email-to-card-add-imap: Tsenya lebokose la imeile la IMAP
email-to-card-sandstorm-address: Aterese ya imeile ya grain e
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Boto e imeile e yang kwa grain e e yang kwa go yone
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Ga go na - fela diimeile tse di nang le tokene ya boto mo setlhogong
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Tsenya se mo setlhogong go fitlha kwa botong e jaaka wena:
email-to-card-parts: Dikarolo tsa imeile tse di tla dirisiwang
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Tlogela melaetsa ya pele e e nopotsweng
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Mola wa moromedi kwa godimo ga tlhaloso
email-to-card-your-address: Aterese ya gago ya imeile ya boto e
email-to-card-address-private: E boloke e le sephiri: mongwe le mongwe yo o nang le yone a ka tsenya dikarata jaaka wena.
email-to-card-new-address: Aterese e ntšhwa (e e kgologolo e emisa go dira)
email-to-card-member-enabled: Diaterese tsa me tsa boto di a dira
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Go amogela imeile ga go a rulaganngwa mo Phaneleng ya motsamaisi.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Motsamaisi wa boto ga a ise a bulele imeile mo botong e.
email-to-card-off-member-off: O timile diaterese tsa gago tsa boto mo Dipeakanyong tsa Leloko.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ga e ise e nne le aterese ya yone ya imeile. Laolela tsebe gape.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: O tlhoka tetla ya go kwala mo botong e.
inbound-domain-invalid: Eo ga se leina le le siameng la domeini.
inbound-domain-required: Naya domeini ya diaterese tsa boto.
inbound-account-invalid: Lebokose la imeile la IMAP le tlhoka leina le le siameng la sefaga.
feature-views-email-desc: Boto jaaka lebokose la poso: lenaane la imeile ke Lebokose la tse di tsenang, manaane ke difoldara, ditshwao ke ditshwao, mme maloko a kwala le go araba imeile go tswa mo atereseng ya boto.
email-view-not-receiving: Boto e ga e ise e amogele imeile. E bulele mo Dithulaganyong tsa Dikitsiso tsa boto → Imeile go karata.
email-view-invalid-address: Nngwe ya diaterese ga se aterese ya imeile e e siameng.
email-view-no-recipient: Tsenya bonnye moamogedi a le mongwe.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Bontsi ke baamogedi ba le 20 mo molaetseng.
email-view-too-many: Diimeile di le dintsi thata di rometswe mo oureng e e fetileng. Leka gape moragonyana.
email-view-no-list: Boto e tlhoka lenaane la imeile.
email-view-send-failed: Imeile ga e a kgona go romelwa.
feature-views-chat-desc: Boto jaaka lefelo la tiro la puisano: mafelo a tiro, diboto, ditsela, manaane le dikarata jaaka setlhare sa dikanale, karata fa gare le dikakgelo tsa yone jaaka melaetsa ya puisano.
chat-view-message-cards: Bontsha fela dikarata tse di nang le melaetsa
chat-view-pick-card: Tlhopha karata mo dikanaleng go e bona fano.
chat-view-no-messages: Ga go ise go nne le melaetsa. Kwala wa ntlha.
board-view-created-resolved: Tse di dirilweng le tse di rarabolotsweng
board-view-dependency-map: Mmapa wa dilo tse di ikaegileng
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Dikarata tse di tshwanang mo ditlhopheng di le mmalwa tse di nang le maina tsa dikholomo - ka go wediwa, botlhokwa, kgato kgotsa sengwe se sengwe - di sutisiwa magareng ga dikholomo ka go goga.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu ya boto → Melao e tshitshinya melao go tswa mo go se batho ba se dirang ka seatla gantsi.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu ya boto → Tshosobanyo e bontsha se motho mongwe le mongwe a se dirileng mo botong mo letsatsing kgotsa bekeng ya bofelo, le se se fetilweng ke nako.
feature-since-last-visit: Go tloga ketelo ya gago ya bofelo
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu ya boto → Go tloga ketelo ya gago ya bofelo e bontsha se ba bangwe ba se fetotseng mo botong.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Go batla gotlhe go tlhaloganya dipolelwana tse di jaaka "dikarata tsa me tse di fetilweng ke nako".
column-sets-empty: Ga go na ditlhopha tsa dikholomo go fitlha jaanong. Motsamaisi wa boto a ka dira se le sengwe: se fe leina, o bo o oketsa dikholomo tsa sone.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Boto jaaka setshedi sa mathata sa GitHub kgotsa Gitea: dikarata jaaka mathata, ditshwao le maemo a botlhokwa, dikakgelo jaaka puisano, tse di tshwaraganeng jaaka difaele, le hisetori ya boto e e nang le go busetsa.
vcs-sort-updated-desc: Tse di sa tswang go ntšhwafadiwa
vcs-sort-comments-desc: Tse di nang le dikakgelo di le dintsi
vcs-open-issues: Mathata a le %s a a butsweng
vcs-no-due-date: Ga go na letlha la bofelo
vcs-no-issues: Ga go na mathata a a tsamaisanang le patlo e.
vcs-no-milestones: Ga go ise go nne le maemo a botlhokwa. Setshwao se se nang le letlha la bofelo ke maemo a botlhokwa.
vcs-no-labels: Ga go ise go nne le ditshwao.
vcs-no-files: Ga go ise go nne le difaele.
vcs-no-list: Boto e ga e na lenaane kgotsa tsela ya bothata.
card-qr-code-desc: E sekene go bula karata e mo mogaleng kgotsa thebolete.
card-qr-code-too-long: Kgokagano ya karata e e leele thata go khoutu ya QR.
vcs-no-releases: Ga go ise go nne le tse di ntshitsweng.
vcs-no-wiki: Ga go ise go nne le wiki. Go tsenya setheo sa GitHub go tlisa wiki ya polokelo ya khoutu fa.
github-org-import-desc: Polokelo nngwe le nngwe ya setheo kgotsa ya modirisi e nna boto ya yone, e e bulwang mo Pono ya boto / Taolo ya diphetolelo: mathata a yone le dikakgelo, ditshwao le difaele tsa one, tse di ntshitsweng ke yone, ditsamaiso tsa tiro tsa GitHub Actions jaaka Melao, le wiki ya yone.
github-org-import-token-hint: E a tlhokega mo dipolokelong tsa poraefete le moleganong o o kwa godimo wa API. E dirisiwa fela fa go tsenya go ntse go tsamaya mme ga e ke e bolokiwa.
github-org-import-issues: Mathata, le dikakgelo, ditshwao le difaele
github-org-import-release-files: Difaele tse di ntshitsweng (di ka nna dikgolo)
github-org-import-actions: Ditsamaiso tsa tiro tsa GitHub Actions jaaka Melao
github-org-import-result: Mathata a le %s, tse di ntshitsweng di le %s, melao e le %s, ditsebe tsa wiki di le %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Kwala leina la setheo kgotsa la modirisi, kgotsa aterese ya lone ya GitHub.
github-org-import-no-repos: Ga go na dipolokelo tse di ka tsenngwang.
github-org-import-running: Go tsenya setheo go setse go ntse go tsamaya.
