optional-apis-desc: Di-REST API tse di mo sebopegong sa di-API tsa ditshedi tse dingwe, gore diapo le dikripiti tsa tsone di kgone go dirisa WeKan e jaaka bokafamorago jwa tsone: se di se bolokang se bolokwa mo WeKan, mo dibotong tsa WeKan. Nngwe le nngwe e tingwa go fitlha e tshwailwe fano. Ga go na epe e e nang le ditshwanelo tsa yone: moreki o tsena ka token ya WeKan API mme a ka bona le go fetola fela se motho yoo a ka se bonang le go se fetola mo WeKan. Tsotlhe di tlhoka gore WeKan REST API e bo e butswe (WITH_API=true). Aterese e e kwa tlase ga nngwe le nngwe ke e moreki a e dirisang jaaka sefa sa gagwe.
optional-api-trello: API e e dumalanang le Trello
optional-api-trello-desc: Diapo le dikripiti tse di kwaletsweng REST API ya Trello (sekai Trellinator) di dira le WeKan: diboto, manaane, dikarata, ditshwao, maloko, dikakgelo le manaane a tlhatlhobo. Token ya Trello ke token ya WeKan API. Go phimola karata go e isa kwa polokelong mo WeKan.
optional-api-jira: API e e dumalanang le Jira
optional-api-jira-desc: Bareki ba REST API v2 ya Jira ba dira le WeKan: porojeke ke boto (senotlolo sa yone ke senotlolo sa boto), bothata ke karata (DEV-7), maemo ke lenaane, mme phetogo e tsamaisa karata. Patlo e amogela JQL e e motlhofo: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text le ORDER BY. Tsena ka token ya WeKan API jaaka lefoko la sephiri. Go phimola bothata go bo isa kwa polokelong.
optional-api-github: API e e dumalanang le GitHub
optional-api-github-desc: Bareki ba REST API ya GitHub ya mathata ba dira le WeKan: polokelo ya khoutu ke boto, bothata ke karata, le ditshwao, maemo a botlhokwa (ditshwao tse di nang le letlha la bofelo), dikakgelo, le e butswe kgotsa e tswetswe jaaka mo Taolong ya diphetolelo. Token ke token ya WeKan API.
optional-api-gitea: API e e dumalanang le Gitea
optional-api-gitea-desc: Bareki ba REST API ya Gitea le Forgejo ya mathata ba dira le WeKan, ka tsela e e tshwanang le API e e dumalanang le GitHub: polokelo ya khoutu ke boto mme bothata ke karata. Token ke token ya WeKan API.
bots-none: Ga go ise go nne le dibote. Bote ke mmerekisi mo sebeleding sa gago - moemedi wa AI, tiro ya CI, sekripi - yo boto e e mo neelang dikarata.
bots-token: Thokene ya go saena (ga e patelesege)
bots-no-runs: Ga go na bote e e berekang jaanong.
bots-summary: %s di a bereka · %s di go emetse
bot-not-found: Bote eo ga e mo botong e.
bot-option-not-found: Karabo eo ga se nngwe ya tse bote e di neileng.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Dikgokagano tsa webe tse di tswang ga di a letlelelwa go fitlha diaterese mo neteweking ya WeKan ka boyone, gore go se nne ope yo o ka supang kgokagano ya webe ya boto kwa tirelong ya ka fa gare. Kwala fano di-host tse di mo neteweking eo tse dikgokagano tsa webe di letlelelwang go di fitlha - Node-RED, seva ya puisano - nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe, jaaka leina kgotsa aterese, le phoro go letla phoro eo fela. E se nang sepe: ga go ope. Ke batsamaisi ba saete fela ba ba ka fetolang lenane leno.
account-webhook: Webhook ya go tsena le go ikwadisa
account-webhook-desc: Aterese e le nngwe e WeKan e e itsiseng fa mongwe a tsena kgotsa akhaonto e ntšhwa e dirwa. Ga go romelwe sepe go fitlha tiragalo e e kwa tlase e tshwailwe. E rwala tiragalo, leina la modirisi le nako; tshwaya mafelo a mangwe fela fa moamogedi a a tlhoka.
account-webhook-on-register: Fa akhaonto e ntšhwa e dirwa
account-webhook-field-ip: Aterese ya IP e go tsena go tswang kwa go yone
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: Ga se host, ga e a bolokwa:
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Khansela dikitsiso tsotlhe tse di emetseng tsa ditiro tse di feteng malatsi a le kae?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Di khanseletswe %s, di romeletswe %s, %s tsa bogologolo di sa ntse di emetse.
vcs-synced-from: E tsamaisantswe go tswa go %s: e bule o bo o e tswale koo.
vcs-synced-issue: Bothata jono bo tsamaisantswe: bo bule o bo o bo tswale mo setshaloking sa jone.
sync-write-back: Kwala diphetogo morago kwa GitLab: setlhogo, tlhaloso, dikakgelo, go tswala le go bula gape
sync-write-back-error: Go kwala morago kwa GitLab go paletswe
email-bounces-description: Se WeKan e se dirang ka imeile e e boang: aterese e e kwadilweng phoso, lebokoso la poso le le tletseng, karabo ya go se nne kwa ofising, ngongorego ya spam. Mofuta mongwe le mongwe o na le ditiro tsa one, tse di dirwang fa o sena go boa makgetlo a le kalo.
email-bounces-enabled: Laola di-imeile tse di boileng mo WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Emisa go romela imeile kwa atereseng
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Aterese ga e yo: phoso ya go kwala, akhaonto e e phimotsweng, domeine e e sa itsiweng.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ga e a romelwa ga jaana: lebokoso le tletse, sebereka se tshwaregile. Fela tse dintsi di latelana di na le bokao.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Dikarabo tsa go se nne kwa ofising, malatsi a boikhutso kgotsa tsa thulaganyo ya ditekete. Imeile e gorositswe.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Moamogedi o tshwaile imeile e le spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Mo Amazon SES, romela dikitsiso tsa Bounce le Complaint, le molao wa kamogelo wa aterese e WeKan e romelang go tswa go yone, kwa setlhogong sa SNS, mme o kwadise aterese e go sone ka HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Di-ARN tsa ditlhogo tsa SNS tse di amogelwang, nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe
email-bounces-stopped-only: Fela diaterese tse WeKan e sa tlholeng e di romelela imeile
email-bounces-clear-hint: Lebala go boa ga aterese e mme o e romelele imeile gape
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Seo ga se ARN ya setlhogo sa SNS.
email-bounces-providers: Ditirelo tse dingwe tsa go romela
email-bounces-providers-description: Fa WeKan e romela ka nngwe ya ditirelo tse, e tshube, o neye tirelo aterese eno ya webhook ya ditiragalo tsa yone tsa di-imeile tse di boileng le dingongorego tsa spam, mme o kgomaretse fano senotlolo se e di saenang ka sone, kgotsa lefoko la sephiri le o le tsentseng mo atereseng jaaka https://user:password@… kgotsa ?secret=…
email-bounces-provider-key: Senotlolo sa go saena sa webhook
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Tirelo e e tshubilweng e tlhoka senotlolo sa yone sa go saena kgotsa lefoko la sephiri.
activity-pub-enabled: Diboto tsa phatlhalatsa di phasalatsa ditiro tsa dikarata tsa tsone mo fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: E timilwe ka tlwaelo. Fa e tshubilwe, boto nngwe le nngwe ya phatlhalatsa e ka latelwa go tswa kwa Mastodon le diseva tse dingwe tsa fediverse jaaka @board-<id> mo atereseng ya WeKan eno, mme ditiro tse dintšhwa tsa dikarata di fitlha kwa balateding ba yone. Ke ya go bala fela: ga go sepe se seva ya fediverse e se romelang se fetolang boto, mme diboto tsa sephiri ga di ke di phasalatswa.
caldav-sync-desc: Tsenya matlha a bofelo a dikarata tsa boto eno mo khalendareng - Nextcloud Calendar kgotsa khalendara epe fela ya CalDAV. Letlha la bofelo le le sutisitsweng mo khalendareng le boela mo karateng. Dirisa lefoko la sephiri la tiriso, e seng la gago.
caldav-enabled: Tsamaisa matlha a bofelo le khalendara eno
caldav-invalid-url: Aterese ya khalendara e tshwanetse go nna aterese ya http:// kgotsa https://, e se na leina la modirisi kgotsa lefoko la sephiri mo go yone.
caldav-not-linked: Pele, boloka aterese ya khalendara mme o tshube go tsamaisana.
webdav-storage-description: Boloka tse di tshwaraganeng mo foltareng mo seveng ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud kgotsa epe fela e nngwe. Dirisa lefoko la sephiri la tiriso le le diretsweng WeKan. Seva e e mo neteweking ya WeKan ka boyone e ka dirisiwa fano, ka gonne ke motsamaisi wa saete fela yo o tlhomang aterese eno.
sqrl-desc: E timilwe ka tlwaelo. Fa e tshubilwe, tsebe ya go tsena e neela SQRL, mme maloko a simolola ka go tsenya boitshupo jwa bona jwa SQRL mo Dipeakanyong tsa leloko. SQRL e tlhoka gore WeKan e nne mo atereseng ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Sekena khoutu ka app ya gago ya SQRL, kgotsa o bule moreki wa gago wa SQRL mo sedirisiweng se.
sqrl-expired: Khoutu e ya SQRL e fetile nako. Simolola sešwa.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: Go tsena ka SQRL go paletswe.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL e tlhoka gore WeKan e nne mo atereseng ya https://.
sqrl-description: Tsena ka boitshupo jwa gago jwa SQRL go na le lefoko la sephiri. Bo tsenye fano gangwe ka moreki wa gago wa SQRL; o ka bo tlosa fano nako nngwe le nngwe.
sqrl-add: Tsenya boitshupo jwa me jwa SQRL
sqrl-added: Boitshupo jwa gago jwa SQRL bo tsentswe.
sqrl-none: Ga go na boitshupo jwa SQRL jo bo tsentsweng.
sqrl-remove: Tlosa boitshupo jwa me jwa SQRL
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Go tsena ka SQRL go thibetswe mo akhaontong e go tswa mo morekeng wa gago wa SQRL. Go bulele gape koo ka khoutu ya gago ya pholoso.
sqrl-only-on: Moreki wa gago wa SQRL o notlelele akhaonto e mo SQRL fela: ditsela tsotlhe tse dingwe tsa go tsena di a ganwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Moreki wa gago wa SQRL o notlelele akhaonto e ka thata: go baakanya lefoko la sephiri sešwa le go fetola imeile go a ganwa.
sqrl-only: Akhaonto e e tsena ka SQRL fela.
sqrl-hardlock: Akhaonto e e notleletswe mo SQRL: ga e kake ya busediwa kgotsa ya fetolwa ka tsela epe e nngwe.
windows-sso-failed: Go tsena ka Windows go paletse. Akhaonto ya gago ya Windows e ka tswa e sa letlelelwe fano.
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: Ga go a bonwa dipoloko tse di tshwanang
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_RESULT_COUNT_ONE: Poloko e le 1 e e tshwanang
enrollment-password-instructions: Netefatsa lefoko la sephiri la gago go simolola. Se ga se go tsenye. Selo se se dirang se se leng teng ga se kake sa emisetswa fa.
enrollment-setup-denied: Ga go kgonege go simolola go baakanya. Tlhola dintlha tsa gago tsa go tsena le gore a dikhoutu tsa nako e le nngwe di setse di bulegile.
enrollment-code-instructions: Dirisa dikhoutu tse di theilweng mo nakong: SHA1, dinomoro di le thataro, metsotswana e le 30. Boloka sephiri se le sa gago. Go baakanya mono go fela mo metsotsong e le metlhano.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: Khoutu ya netefatso e setse e dirisitswe. Leta khoutu e ntšha mo sekgonnamaemong sa gago pele o tsena.
registration-first-admin: Akhaonto e ya ntlha e tla nna Motsamaisi wa Lefatshe wa Domeine.
auth-too-many-attempts: Go leka go tsena go gontsi thata. Leka gape moragonyana.
enrollment-setup-failed: Ga go a kgonega go simolola go baakanya
registration-global-admin-disabled: Diakhaonto tsa Motsamaisi wa Lefatshe di simololwa mo lefelong. Kwadiso ya botlhe e thibetswe.
auth-session-create-failed: Ga go a kgonega go dira sešene
registration-password-unavailable: Kwadiso ka lefoko la sephiri ga e yo.
card-blocked-since: E thibetswe go tloga ka __date__ ke __user__
expedite-limit: Ke karata e le nngwe fela e e buleditsweng ya boto e e ka nnang Potlako ka nako e le nngwe.
list-policy-placeholder: Karata e ka tsena mo lenaaneng leno leng, mme e wediwa fano leng?
commitment-point-hint: Tiro e itlamelwa go simolola mo lenaaneng leno; manaane a pele ga lone ke ditlhopho.
person-wip-over: __user__ o na le dikarata di le __count__ tse di butsweng; tekanyetso ya WIP ka motho ke __limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: Pholisi ya lenaane lengwe le lengwe - fa karata e ka tsena le fa e wediwa teng - mo tlhogong ya lenaane. E bulwa ka boto nngwe le nngwe mo Dipeakanyo tsa boto / Lenaane.
feature-commitment-point-desc: Lenaane le tiro e itlamelwang go simolola go lone, le tshwailwe mo tlhogong ya lone. Le tlhophiwa ka boto nngwe le nngwe mo Dipeakanyo tsa boto / Lenaane.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Gore motho a le mongwe a ka tshwara dikarata di le kae tse di butsweng mo botong; karata e e butsweng e tlhagisa ka mongwe le mongwe yo o e fetang. E beiwa ka boto nngwe le nngwe mo Dipeakanyo tsa boto / Lenaane.
feature-standup-timer: Sebadi sa nako sa kopano ya letsatsi le letsatsi
feature-standup-timer-desc: Kopano ya letsatsi le letsatsi mo menung ya boto: maloko a boto ka thulaganyo e e tlhakantsweng, mongwe le mongwe ka nako e e lekanang. E timiwa ka boto mo Dipeakanyong tsa Scrum tsa yone.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Boto ya go lebelela morago mo menung ya boto: boto e ntšha ya sephiri e e nang le manaane a Simolola go dira, Emisa go dira, Tswelela go dira le Dilo tse di tshwanetseng go dirwa. E timiwa ka boto mo Dipeakanyong tsa Scrum tsa yone.
show-split-lists: Letla manaane go kgaoganngwa ka Di a dirwa le Go fedile
list-split: Kgaoganya ka Di a dirwa le Go fedile
split-done: Go fedile fano, e emetse go gogelwa pele
feature-split-lists-desc: Lenaane le le kgaogantsweng ka Di a dirwa le Go fedile: karata e e tshwailweng jaaka e fedile koo e a leta, e fifaditswe, go gogelwa mo lenaaneng le le latelang, mme setlhogo sa lenaane se bala tsotlhe tse pedi. Go letlelelwa boto nngwe le nngwe mo Dipeakanyo tsa boto / Lenaane, morago go bulwa mo menyung ya lenaane lengwe le lengwe.
workload-intro: Diura tse di fopholetsweng le dintlha tsa kgang tsa dikarata tse di abetsweng motho mongwe le mongwe, beke ka beke, go bapisiwa le diura tse a nang le tsone: nako ya gagwe ya tiro, go seyong le malatsi a boikhutso a setšhaba. Tobetsa beke go bona dikarata tsa yone.
workload-truncated: Go ntsi thata go bontshiwa gangwe fela: pegelo e bontsha batho le dikarata tsa ntlha fela. Tlhopha dibeke di le mmalwa kgotsa diboto di le mmalwa.
workload-legend-under: Ka fa tlase ga halofo ya bokgoni
workload-unestimated: Dikarata tse di se nang fopholetso
workload-no-cards: Ga go na dikarata beke eno.
workload-allocations-intro: Gore nako e kae ya motho e ya kwa botong, kgotsa ke dikarolo dife tse boto e tla di tlhokang pele ga ope a ka bolelwa ka leina.
workload-no-holidays: Ga go na malatsi a boikhutso a setšhaba.
workload-add-holiday: Tsenya letsatsi la boikhutso la setšhaba
workload-invalid-estimate: Fopholetso e tshwanetse go nna magareng ga 0 le diura di le 10000.
feature-workload-desc: Morwalo wa tiro le bokgoni mo lenaneong la modirisi: diura tse di fopholetsweng le dintlha tsa kgang tsa dikarata tsa motho mongwe le mongwe, beke ka beke, go bapisiwa le nako ya gagwe ya tiro, go seyong le malatsi a boikhutso a setšhaba, le dikabo kwa dibotong le dikarolo tsa nakwana.
billing-intro: Diboto tse o leng motsamaisi wa tsone: tekanyetsokabo ya tsone, se tiro ya tsone e se jeleng le se e tla se jang ka dituelo tsa ura tse o di beang, le diinboise tsa diura tse di dirisitsweng. Ke batsamaisi ba boto fela ba ba bonang se.
billing-no-boards: Ga o motsamaisi wa boto epe.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h ga di na tuelo ya ura e bile ga di a tlhwatlhwa. Baya tuelo ya boto kgotsa ya batho bao.
billing-draft-summary: E siametse go kwalelwa inboise: __hours__ h, __amount__.
billing-nothing-to-invoice: Ura nngwe le nngwe e e duelelwang e setse e kwaletswe inboise.
billing-set-rate-first: Pele baya tuelo ya ura ya boto e.
feature-billing-desc: Tekanyetsokabo le dikoloto tsa lenaane la modirisi: tekanyetsokabo ya boto ka madi kgotsa diura, dituelo tsa ura, ditshenyegelo le ponelopele ya tiro ya yone, le diinboise tsa diura tse di duelelwang tse di dirisitsweng. Ke batsamaisi ba boto fela ba ba e bonang.
billing-amount-due: Tlhwatlhwa e e tshwanetseng go duelwa
billing-include-undated: Akaretsa nako e e kwadilweng pele matlha a bolokwa
billing-method-link: Kgolagano ya tuelo (karata, sepaki, tuelo ya inthanete)
billing-pay-by-scanning: Duela ka go sekena ka tirisano ya gago ya banka kgotsa ya tuelo
billing-reference-none: Ga go na tshupiso ya tuelo
billing-reverse-charge: Tuelo e e boelang morago: VAT e duelwa ke moreki
billing-undated-included: E akaretsa diura di le __hours__ tse di kwadilweng pele matlha a bolokwa.
billing-method-zbp: Khoutu ya QR ya banka ya Poland
billing-method-mnb: Khoutu ya QR ya phetisetso ya ka bonako ya Hungary
billing-field-promptpay-target: Nomoro ya mogala, ID ya bosetšhaba kgotsa ID ya sepache sa elektroniki
billing-field-proxy: Nomoro ya mogala, UEN, ID ya FPS kgotsa imeile
billing-reference-be: Molaetsa o o rulaganeng wa Belgium
billing-unbilled: Tiro e e iseng e duelelwe
billing-uncosted: __hours__ h ga di na tshenyegelo ya ura e bile ga di mo tshenyegelong ya tiro.
billing-bill-time: Duedisa nako ka ura (e timilwe: tlhwatlhwa e e tsepameng, go duedisiwa fela dituelo le ditshenyegelo)
billing-approve-time: Amogela nako pele e tsenngwa mo inboiseng
billing-quote-valid-days: Ditlhwatlhwa tse di akanyediwang di nna matsatsi a
billing-no-expenses: Ga go na ditshenyegelo gona jaanong.
billing-fees: Dituelo tse di tsepameng le tsa kgwedi
billing-fees-intro: Kgato kgotsa tlhwatlhwa e e tsepameng e duedisiwa gangwe, go simolola ka letsatsi la yone; tuelo ya kgwedi e duedisiwa kgwedi le kgwedi go simolola ka letsatsi la yone go fitlha kwa bofelong.
billing-no-fees: Ga go na dituelo tse di tsepameng.
billing-time-to-approve: Nako e e tshwanetseng go amogelwa
billing-nothing-to-approve: Ga go na nako e e emetseng go amogelwa.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h di emetse go amogelwa e bile ga di mo inboiseng e.
billing-quotes-intro: Tlhwatlhwa e e akanyediwang e baya tlhwatlhwa ya tiro e e setseng - tekanyetso ya karata nngwe le nngwe e e buletsweng go ntshiwa nako e e dirisitsweng - le dituelo tse di iseng di tsenngwe mo inboiseng.
billing-accept-sets-budget: Go amogela tlhwatlhwa e e akanyediwang go e dira tekanyetsokabo ya boto
billing-no-quotes: Ga go na ditlhwatlhwa tse di akanyediwang gona jaanong.
workload-utilization-title: Diura tse di duelelwang tse di kwadilweng go bapisa le nako ya tiro ya dibeke tse
workload-no-candidates: Ga go na ope yo o nang le bokgoni jo
cloud-panel-settings-intro: Mo Domain ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin o tlhokomela didomain tsa bareki, didatabase tsa tsone, DNS ya CloudFlare le ditsela tsa Caddy, mme moreki mongwe le mongwe o bona di-invoice tsa gagwe mme o bua le SuperAdmin. SuperAdmin ke motsamaisi wa WeKan yo o setseng a le teng.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: Aterese e didomain di supang kwa go yone (aterese ya IP kgotsa leina la host)
cloud-panel-cloudflare-proxied: E fetisiwa ka proxy ya CloudFlare
cloud-panel-dns-apply: Tlhama mme o ntšhafatse direkoto tsa DNS
cloud-panel-dns-conflict: __name__ e setse e na le rekoto ya __type__: e tlogelwa jaaka e ntse.
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: Caddy e isa Domain ya Cloud Panel le domain nngwe le nngwe e e abelanwang kwa WeKan eno, mme domain nngwe le nngwe e e nang le database ya yone kwa setshoding sa yone sa WeKan.
cloud-panel-caddy-admin: Aterese ya API ya tsamaiso ya Caddy
cloud-panel-caddy-upstream: WeKan eno, jaaka Caddy e e fitlhelela (host:port)
cloud-panel-caddy-pushed: Caddy e na le ditsela tse dintšhwa.
cloud-panel-mode-own: WeKan ya yone le database ya yone
cloud-panel-database-uri: Mola wa kgolagano (kgotsa dikarolo tse di fa tlase)
cloud-panel-customers: Bareki ba ba tsenang fano (maina a badirisi kgotsa diaterese tsa imeile)
cloud-panel-domain-cloudflare: Boloka rekoto ya yone ya DNS kwa CloudFlare
cloud-panel-test-ok: E golagane: badirisi ba le __users__, diboto di le __boards__, dikarata di le __cards__.
cloud-panel-import-users: Diakhaonte: tse dintšhwa di le __created__, di le __matched__ di setse di le fano.
cloud-panel-import-files: Dikgomaretso di le __count__: kopolola le difaele go tswa kwa polokelong ya difaele ya WeKan ya kgale.
cloud-panel-chat-empty: Ga go na melaetsa ga jaana.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin e teng fela kwa aterese e e bidiwang ke CLOUD environment variable ya seva, mo balaoding ba yone ba Cloud le mo bareding ba di-domain tse e di kwalang.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: Diaterese tsa IPv4 le IPv6, le dikarolo tsa diaterese tse di tshwanang le 203.0.113.0/24, mo molaodi wa Cloud a ka tsenang gone. E le nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe. Lefela: aterese epe fela.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Aterese ya gago __address__ ga e mo lenaneng leno. Go e boloka go tla go notlela kwa ntle, ka jalo ga e a bolokwa.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: Diaterese tsa IPv4 le IPv6 le mefuta ya diaterese, e le nngwe mo moleng mongwe le mongwe, kwa Phanele ya motsamaisi le REST API ya tsamaiso di ka dirisiwang teng. E se nang sepe: aterese nngwe le nngwe.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: Phetogo ya tikologo ya seva ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES ke yone e dirang tshwetso, e seng lenaane leno.
admin-panel-address-refused: Phanele ya motsamaisi e ka se dirisiwe go tswa mo atereseng ya gago __address__.
website-view-empty: Ga go sepe se se phasaladitsweng mo webosaeteng eno ga jaana.
feature-views-website-desc: Boto jaaka webosaete: dikarata tsa lenaane la yone la Published, tsela ya Pages jaaka lenaane la ditlhopho le dikarata tse dingwe jaaka dikwalo, tse dintšhwa pele, le tse di tshwaraganeng tsa tsone. Boto e e phatlalatsang e ka bulega mo go yone, gore baeti ba bone webosaete mo atereseng ya boto.
feature-views-shop-desc: Dikumo tse di mo dikarateng tsa boto jaaka lebenkele la inthanete: karata e e nang le tlhwatlhwa ke kumo, ditshwao tsa yone ke mefuta, mme taelo ke karata mo lenaaneng la Ditaelo. Boto ya phatlalatsa e ka bula mo go lone, gore baeti ba reke kwa aterseng ya boto.
shop-sku-field: Khoutu ya kumo (lesimo le le ikgethileng)
shop-decrement-stock: Ntsha dikumo tse di laetsweng mo polokelong
shop-sale-lists: Manaane a a rekisiwang (fa go sa tshwaiwa sepe: lenaane lengwe le lengwe kwantle ga lenaane la Ditaelo)
shop-category-labels: Ditshwao tse di bontshiwang jaaka mefuta (fa go sa tshwaiwa sepe: setshwao sengwe le sengwe)
shop-orders-private: Ditaelo di kwalwa mo botong ya poraefete, ka gonne boto ya phatlalatsa e bontsha karata nngwe le nngwe mongwe le mongwe.
shop-guest-checkout: Baeti ba ba senang akhaonto ba ka laela
shop-show-on-public: Bontsha Lebenkele go na le boto ya phatlalatsa
shop-show-on-public-note: Boto ya phatlalatsa e bula ka pono e le nngwe fela. Go tlhopha Lebenkele fa go tsaya sebaka sa __view__ mo baeting, mme go tlhopha Webosaete kgotsa pono e nngwe mo Dipeakanyong tsa boto / Pono ya boto go tsaya sebaka sa Lebenkele.
shop-cart-empty: Koloi ya gago ya theko ga e na sepe.
shop-empty: Ga go na dikumo ga jaana. Karata e e nang le tlhwatlhwa mo lenaaneng le le rekisiwang ke kumo.
shop-privacy-note: Leina la gago le dintlha tsa go ikgolaganya le wena di kwalwa mo taelong gore lebenkele le e romele, mme ga di kwalwe gope gape.
shop-price-changed: Tlhwatlhwa e fetogile. Tlhatlhoba palogotlhe e ntšha mme o laele gape.
shop-order-placed: Re a leboga! Taelo ya gago __number__ e amogetswe.
shop-confirmation-email: Romela moreki tiiso ya taelo ka imeile
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Mo WordPress, tlhopha Tools, Export, All content le Download Export File, mme o tlhophe faele eo ya .xml fa, kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa yone. Squarespace, Wix le disaete tse dingwe tse di ntshang faele ya WordPress di dira ka tsela e e tshwanang. Tsebe nngwe le nngwe le sekwalo sengwe le sengwe di fetoga karata mo lenaaneng la maemo a sone, ditsebe mo tseleng ya Pages le dikwalo mo Posts, le diteng tsa sone, dikarolo le dithegi jaaka ditshwao, le dikakgelo tsa sone tse di amogetsweng.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Boloka dikwalo le ditsebe tsa WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts le /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) jaaka faele e le nngwe ya .json, mme o e tlhophe fa kgotsa o e kgomaretse. Tsebe nngwe le nngwe le sekwalo sengwe le sengwe di fetoga karata mo lenaaneng la maemo a sone.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Mo Ghost, tlhopha Settings, Labs, Export your content, mme o tlhophe faele ya .json fa kgotsa o e kgomaretse. Tsebe nngwe le nngwe le sekwalo sengwe le sengwe di fetoga karata mo lenaaneng la maemo a sone, le dithegi tsa sone jaaka ditshwao.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Mo Blogger, tlhopha Settings, Back up content, mme o tlhophe faele ya .xml fa kgotsa o kgomaretse mokwalo wa yone. Sekwalo sengwe le sengwe le tsebe nngwe le nngwe di fetoga karata, thalwa e le mo lenaaneng la Draft, le ditshwao le dikakgelo tsa sone.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Dira zip ya metswedi ya saete e e sa fetogeng ya Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro kgotsa e nngwe - difaele tsa Markdown le front matter ya tsone, le ditshwantsho tsa tsone - mme o tlhophe .zip fa. Faele nngwe le nngwe ya Markdown e fetoga karata: dikwalo go tswa mo diforoutareng tsa posts kgotsa tse di nang le letlha mo leineng la faele, tse dingwe ke ditsebe, dithalwa mo lenaaneng la Draft, mme ditshwantsho tse e di dirisang jaaka tse di tshwaraganeng tsa yone.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Dira zip ya difaele tsa webosaete - ditsebe tsa yone tsa .html le ditshwantsho, jaaka di bolokilwe ka wget kgotsa HTTrack, kgotsa export ya Medium - mme o tlhophe .zip fa. Tsebe nngwe le nngwe e fetoga karata le mokwalo wa yone o mogolo, le ditshwantsho tse e di dirisang jaaka tse di tshwaraganeng; disekripiti, malaneo a ditlhopho le diforomo di a tlogelwa.
import-board-instruction-substack: Mo Substack, tlhopha Settings, Exports, Create new export, mme o tlhophe .zip e e folotsweng fa. Sekwalo sengwe le sengwe se fetoga karata le mokwalo wa sone, se se phasaladitsweng kgotsa thalwa.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Ditsela di kgaoganya boto ka mela e e rapameng, ka jalo karata nngwe le nngwe e nna mo lenaaneng le mo tseleng. Tsela e ka emela setlhopha, motho, moreki kgotsa mofuta wa tiro, fa manaane a ntse a bontsha dikgato tsa tiro.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Tobetsa + mo setlhogong sa tsela, kgotsa tlhopha Oketsa Tsela mo lenaaneng la yone la ditlhopho, kwala leina mme o tlhophe gore e ya kwa godimo kgotsa kwa tlase ga tsela e e tlhophilweng. Go tsenya mela e le mmalwa go ka dira tsela e le nngwe ka mola mongwe le mongwe. Tobetsa leina go le fetola, dirisa motsu go phutha kgotsa go bula tsela, goga setshwaro sa yone go rulaganya ditsela gape, mme o goge ntlha ya yone ya tlase go fetola bogodimo fa e se fa motsamaisi wa boto a lotlelele go fetola bogolo.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Manaane ke dikholomo tse di tshwarang dikarata. Mo botong ya kanban lenaane lengwe le lengwe ke kgato ya tiro, mme karata e tloga mo lenaaneng go ya go le lengwe fa tiro e ntse e tswelela. Mo ponong ya Ditsela lenaane le ka nna la tsela e le nngwe.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Tobetsa letshwao la go oketsa lenaane kwa bofelong jwa setlhogo sa lenaane, kgotsa Oketsa mo lenaaneng la ditlhopho, kwala leina mme o tlhophe gore le tla morago ga lenaane lefe; go tsenya mela e le mmalwa go ka dira lenaane le le lengwe ka mola mongwe le mongwe. Tobetsa setlhogo sa lenaane go se fetola, mme motsu mo setlhogong o le phutha kgotsa o le bula mo go wena fela. Lenaane la ditlhopho le na gape le go kopolola, go sutisa le go isa kwa polokelong, mme o ka goga setshwaro magareng ga manaane go fetola bogolo jwa one fa go letleletswe.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: Pono ya Tafole e bontsha dikarata tsa boto jaaka tafole e e tshwanang le sepreteshiti, mola o le mongwe ka karata nngwe, le lenaane la yone, tsela, batho, ditshwao le matlha. E thusa go leba dikarata di le dintsi ka nako e le nngwe le go oketsa kgotsa go sutisa dikarata kwantle ga go di goga go kgabaganya manaane.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Tobetsa setlhogo sa kholomo go rulaganya, mme o se tobetse gape go fetola tatelano. Kwala mo lebokoseng la go batla go tshwantsha ditlhogo tsa dikarata, manaane, ditsela le ditshwao, mme o dirise Pele le Morago go tsamaya ka mela e le 25 ka nako. Konopo ya Fetola e bula karata mo godimo ga tafole. Phutha ditlhogo le Kopanya ka tsela di fetola thulaganyo mme di gopolwa mo sebatling se. Dikarata tse di mo polokelong ga di bontshiwe, mme Sefa ya lethakore e fokotsa mela.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: Pono ya Khalendara e baya dikarata tsa boto mo khalendareng go ya ka matlha a tsone: karata e e nang le letlha la tshimologo le la bofelo e nna mola magareng ga one, mme matlha a yone a go amogelwa, a bofelo le a go fela a nna ditsenyo tsa one. Dintlha tsa lenaane la tlhatlhobo tse di nang le matlha di bonala le tsone.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Dirisa Gompieno, Pele le Morago go tsamaya, mme o fetole magareng ga letsatsi, beke le kgwedi, nngwe le nngwe jaaka tafole kgotsa lenaane. Goga karata go e naya letlha le lesha la bofelo, kgotsa o e golole go fetola letlha la yone la go fela. Tobetsa letsatsi, kgotsa goga mo diureng tsa beke kgotsa letsatsi, go dira karata e ntšha e e felang ka nako eo; e ya kwa tseleng ya ntlha le lenaaneng la ntlha la boto.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Mokgwa wa Khalendara o bontsha karata nngwe le nngwe mo letsatsing la letlha la yone la bofelo, le ditshwao tsa yone le setlhogo sotlhe, mo tafoleng ya kgwedi kgotsa ya beke. Ke kakaretso ya go bala fela ya se se tshwanetseng go fela leng, e e tshwanang le khalendara ya Trello.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Dirisa Gompieno, Pele le Morago go tsamaya ka kgwedi kgotsa ka beke, mme Beke kgotsa Kgwedi go fetola tafole; tlhopho e gopolwa mo sebatling se. Tobetsa karata go e bula. Dikarata tse di mo polokelong ga di bontshiwe mme Sefa ya lethakore e a dira. Go fetola matlha ka go goga, dirisa pono ya Khalendara boemong jwa yone.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Khalendara ya Diboto Tse Dintsi e bontsha dikarata tse di nang le matlha tsa boto nngwe le nngwe e o leng leloko la yone mo khalendareng e le nngwe, gore o bone sengwe le sengwe se se felang beke eno go sa kgathalesege gore se mo botong efe. Tsenyo nngwe le nngwe e simolola ka setlhogo sa boto ya yone mo masakaneng.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: E bule mo lenaaneng la Pono ya Boto la boto nngwe le nngwe mme o letele go fitlha dikarata tsa diboto tsotlhe tsa gago di tsentswe. Dirisa Gompieno, Pele le Morago le dipono tsa letsatsi, beke le kgwedi, nngwe le nngwe gape jaaka lenaane. Matlha a go amogelwa, a bofelo le a go fela a nna le ditsenyo tsa one. Tobetsa tsenyo go bula karata eo mo botong ya yone. Matlha ga a kgone go gogwa fano.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: Pono ya Nako e kokoanya tlhatlhobo ya nako ya boto mo lefelong le le lengwe: nako e kae e dirisitswe, ke mang le mo dikarateng dife, le gore go setse nako e kae pele dikarata di fela. Nako e tsenngwa mo dikarateng ka bo tsone; pono eno e e bega fela.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Bala kakaretso ya nako e e dirisitsweng kwa godimo, morago ga moo karoganyo ka modiri le ka karata, le dikarata tse di fetileng nako di tshwailwe. Kwa tlase ga yone phetogo nngwe le nngwe ya diura tse di kwadilweng tsa karata e kwadilwe ka motho yo o e dirileng. Tobetsa Ntsha go boloka pego jaaka PDF kgotsa Excel. Maloko a a ka bonang fela dikarata tse ba di abetsweng ba bona kakaretso ya dikarata tsa bone, fa dikarolo tse dingwe di setse di se na sepe.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: Pono ya Tatelano ya Nako e bontsha boto jaaka e ne e ntse ka nako nngwe ya pele, e dirisa hisitori ya boto. E go thusa go bona se se fetogileng le go busetsa karata kwa e neng e ntse ka teng.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Tobetsa ntlha mo moleng go bona karata nngwe le nngwe jaaka e ne e ntse ka nako eo, e kopantswe ka lenaane la yone ka nako eo, le setlhogo, tlhaloso, ditshwao, maloko le letlha la bofelo. Tobetsa Jaanong go boela mo nakong ya jaanong. Mo karateng, Busetsa mo seemong se e busetsa boleng joo morago ga fa o netefaditse. Ga go sepe se se phimolwang: go busetsa go kwalwa jaaka hisitori e ntšha, mme konopo e bontshiwa fela batho ba ba ka fetolang karata eo.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Dipalopalo di bontsha seemo sa boto ka bonako: ka moo dikarata tsa yone di tsenngwang ka teng le gore e na le ditsela, manaane, dikarata, dikarata tse di mo polokelong, ditshwao, maloko le masimo a a ikgethileng a le kae.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Bula Dipalopalo mo setlhopheng sa Kakaretso sa lenaane la Pono ya Boto mme o bale tafole ya Seemo sa boto. Go tsenngwa ga dikarata go bolela gore a boto eno e tsenya dikarata tse di bonalang fela kgotsa dikarata tsotlhe, le gore a seo se tlhophilwe ka bosona ka ntlha ya boto e kgolo. Dipalo di balwa mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo, ka jalo di nepagetse le mo botong e kgolo. Boleng bongwe le bongwe bo ka tlhophiwa mme bo kopololwe, mme go bula pono eno ga go fetole sepe.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Kopanya ka Modiri e baya karata nngwe le nngwe ka fa tlase ga motho yo e mo abetsweng, boemong jwa ka fa tlase ga lenaane la yone, gore o bone gore mang o na le eng kwantle ga go bula lenaane lengwe le lengwe. E siametse kopano ya setlhopha.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: E bule mo lenaaneng la Pono ya Boto. Modiri mongwe le mongwe o bona karolo e e nang le dikarata tsa gagwe, letlha la bofelo fa le beilwe le tšhupanako fa karata e fetile nako; dikarata tse di se nang modiri di ka fa tlase ga Ga go na modiri. Tobetsa setlhogo sa karata go bula karata. Go kopanya go dirisa tshimo ya Modiri ya karata, e seng Maloko a yone. Batho ba seabe sa bone se ba letlang go bona fela dikarata tse ba di abetsweng ga ba bone sepe fano.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: Dipono tsa Gantt di thala dikarata tsa boto mo khalendareng gore o bone se se simololang, se se felang le se se tlhakanang. Gantt ke tafole e e nang le mola o le mongwe ka karata nngwe le letshwao ka letlha lengwe le lengwe la yone, fa Frappe Gantt le DHTMLX Gantt di thala karata nngwe le nngwe jaaka mola go tloga tshimologong go ya bofelong.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Tlhopha Gantt, Frappe Gantt kgotsa DHTMLX Gantt mo setlhopheng sa Khalendara le nako sa lenaane la Pono ya Boto; dikarata di tlhoka bonnye letlha le le lengwe la go amogelwa, tshimologo, bofelo kgotsa go fela. Mo Gantt, beke nngwe le nngwe e e nang le matlha e na le tafole ya yone; tobetsa leina la karata go bula karata kgotsa letshwao la letlha go fetola letlha leo. Mo Frappe Gantt le DHTMLX Gantt, maloko a a nang le tetla ya go kwala a ka goga mola go baya karata gape.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: Lenaane la Tiro e e Emeng ke lenaane le le rulagantsweng la tiro e setlhopha sa Scrum se iseng se e tsenye mo sprint. Le bontsha dikarata tsa boto tse di se nang sprint ya jaanong, di rulagantswe ka maemo a tiro e e emeng, kwantle ga go di ntsha mo manaaneng a tsone.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Batla karata mo tafoleng mme, mo seleng ya yone ya Ditiro, o beye Sprint, Maemo a tiro e e emeng, Kgololo, Mofuta wa tiro le Dipeelo tsa kamogelo, morago o tobetse Boloka. Maemo a a potlana a tla pele. Tshwara Ctrl, kgotsa Cmd mo Mac, go tsenya karata mo dikgololong di le mmalwa. Tobetsa setlhogo sa karata go bula karata, mme Bontsha go feta go tsenya dikarata di le 100 tse di latelang. Go fetola go latela ditetla tse di tlwaelegileng tsa dikarata.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: Sprint ke paka e khutshwane, e e tlhomameng, e setlhopha sa Scrum se fetsang tiro e e tlhophilweng mo go yone go ya kwa maikemisetsong. Pono ya Disprint ke kwa disprint tsa boto di rulaganngwang, di simololwang, di tswalwang kgotsa di khanselwang teng, mmogo le dikgololo tsa yone le ditiragalo tsa Scrum.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: Motsamaisi wa boto pele o bula dipeakanyo tsa Scrum, a tshuba thulaganyo ya Scrum mme a tlhopha motswedi wa kakanyetso, seelo, molao wa go fetsa le malatsi a tiro. Morago o dire sprint e e rulagantsweng ka leina, maikemisetso, tshimologo le bofelo, o e abele dikarata go tswa mo Lenaaneng la Tiro e e Emeng, mme o tobetse Simolola sprint. Go fetsa, tlhopha kwa tiro e e sa fedang e yang teng mme o tobetse Tswala sprint, kgotsa naya lebaka mme o tobetse Khansela sprint. Ke batsamaisi ba boto fela ba ba tsamaisang disprint.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: Pego ya sprint e bolela se se diragetseng mo sprint e le nngwe e e tswetsweng: se se ikanetsweng, se se feditsweng, se se okeditsweng, se se ntshitsweng le se se sa fedang. Lebelo le bontsha diphitlhelelo tseo tsa sprint nngwe le nngwe e e tswetsweng, gore sprint e e latelang e rulaganngwe go ya ka se setlhopha se se dirileng tota.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: Mo Pegong ya Sprint, tlhopha sprint mme o tlhophe Dikarata kgotsa Kakanyetso kwa godimo ga mela, morago o bale bogolo jwa letsatsi le letsatsi le tiro e e setseng le hisitori ya phetogo ka phetogo kwa tlase. Mo Lebelong, bala mola o le mongwe ka sprint e e tswetsweng. Diphitlhelelo di tswa mo ditshwantshong tse di tserweng fa sprint nngwe le nngwe e simolola le fa e tswalwa, ka jalo diphetogo tsa morago tsa dikakanyetso ga di di kwale sešwa. Ntsha e boloka diphitlhelelo jaaka PDF kgotsa Excel, mme Ntšhwafatsa e tsenya pego gape.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: Ditshwantsho tseno tsa Scrum di bontsha kgatelopele ka nako. Burndown e bontsha gore go setse tiro e kae letsatsi le letsatsi mme Burnup gore go dirilwe e kae, Lebelo le bontsha gore sprint nngwe le nngwe e e tswetsweng e feditse bokae, Burndown ya Kgololo e latela tiro e e setseng mo kgololong, mme Kgatelopele ya Epic e bontsha gore dikarata tsa batsadi di gorogile kae.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Tlhopha setshwantsho ka fa tlase ga Scrum mo lenaaneng la Pono ya Boto. Sengwe le sengwe se thala go tswa mo dikarateng le mo disprint tsa boto ka boyone mme se bontsha dipalo mo tafoleng ka fa tlase ga setshwantsho. Lebelo le tlhoka bonnye sprint e le nngwe e e tswetsweng, mme le go letla go tlhopha Dikarata kgotsa Kakanyetso. Tobetsa Ntsha kwa godimo go boloka dipalo tse di tshwanang jaaka PDF kgotsa Excel. Setshwantsho se se iseng se nne le sepe sa go thala se re Ga go na diphitlhelelo.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: Mmapa wa Tsela o kopanya dikarata ka mela go ya ka boleng jwa tshimo e e ikgethileng, jaaka kgololo kgotsa epic, mme o thala dikarata tsa mola mongwe le mongwe mo tatelanong ya nako. O na le mosola mo mmapeng wa kgololo kgotsa wa setlhogo fa kopano eo e setse e bolokilwe mo tshimong e e ikgethileng.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: Boto e tlhoka bonnye tshimo e le nngwe e e ikgethileng ya mokwalo kgotsa ya lenaane le le wang. Tlhopha tshimo mo Kopanya ka kwa godimo; boleng bongwe le bongwe bo bona setshwantsho sa bone se sennye sa Gantt sa dikarata tsa bone, mme dikarata tse di se nang boleng di kopantswe ka fa tlase ga Ga go na boleng. Dikarata di beiwa go ya ka matlha a tsone, ka jalo di neye matlha a tshimologo le a bofelo go di bona mo tatelanong ya nako.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: Ditshwantsho tseno tsa Kakaretso di araba gore boto e tshwaregile go le kae le gore tiro ya yone e anamisitswe jang: Dashboard le Pulse di akaretsa boto, Morwalo wa tiro o bontsha gore mang o na le eng, Kabo gore dikarata di kgaoganngwa jang, Mmapa wa Boikaego gore dikarata di thibela kgotsa di ikaega ka tsone jang, mme Mmapa wa Mogote wa Tiragalo gore batho ba dira mo botong leng.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Tlhopha setshwantsho mo setlhopheng sa Kakaretso sa lenaane la Pono ya Boto. Tsebe nngwe le nngwe e thala setshwantsho go tswa mo dikarateng le mo hisitoring ya boto mme e bontsha tafole ya dipalo tse di kwa morago ga sone. Tobetsa Ntsha kwa godimo go boloka data e e tshwanang jaaka PDF kgotsa Excel. Fa go se na sepe sa go thala, setshwantsho se re Ga go na diphitlhelelo.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Boto e Kgolo e baya boto nngwe le nngwe e o leng leloko la yone mo tsebeng e le nngwe e e phuthologang, nngwe le nngwe ka manaane le dikarata tsa yone, gore o dire mo dibotong tsotlhe tsa gago ka nako e le nngwe.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Bula Boto e Kgolo mo lenaaneng la Pono ya Boto mme o letele fa dikarata tsa boto nngwe le nngwe di tsenngwa. Karolo nngwe le nngwe ya boto e dira jaaka boto e e tlwaelegileng: goga dikarata magareng ga manaane, bula dikarata mme o fetole manaane. O ka goga gape karata go e isa mo lenaaneng la boto e nngwe mo tsebeng, mme seo se e sutisetsa kwa botong eo. Manaane a ka gogwa fela mo teng ga boto ya one. Tobetsa setlhogo sa boto go e bula e le nosi.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: Ditshwantsho tsa phologo ya Kanban di bontsha ka moo tiro e tsamayang ka teng mo botong: phologo e e kokoanyang, taolo le nako ya modikologo, nako ya go goroga, bokgoni jwa phologo, palo ya tiro e e feditsweng, tiro e e simolotsweng, tiro e e godileng, dikgoreletsi, dikakanyetso tsa gore tiro e tla fela leng, maitsholo a tirego le gore a dikakanyetso tse dikgolo di tsaya nako e telele. Di go thusa go bona kwa tiro e kokoanang teng le gore e tsaya nako e kae tota.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Tlhopha setshwantsho mo setlhopheng sa phologo ya Kanban sa lenaane la Pono ya Boto. Bala kaelo ka fa tlase ga setlhogo, e e bolelang ka moo se lekanyang ka teng, morago setshwantsho le tafole ka fa tlase ga sone. Ditsebe dingwe di tsaya dipeakanyo, jaaka dikarata tse di batlwang le letlha la Dikakanyetso tsa Monte Carlo kgotsa tshimo ya bogolo ya Bogolo jwa Tiro kgatlhanong le Nako ya Modikologo, tse di dirisiwang ka Dirisa. Ntsha kwa godimo e boloka ditafole jaaka PDF kgotsa Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: Dipego tseno di bontsha ka moo tiro e tsamayang ka teng mo botong beke le beke: dikarata tse di dirilweng le tse di feditsweng, phologo e e setseng, gore dikarata di nna nako e kae mo lenaaneng lengwe le lengwe, dingwaga tse di fa gare tsa dikarata tse di buduleng, palo ya tiro e e feditsweng ka beke le gore matlha a bofelo a fitlhelelwa ga kae.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Tlhopha pego mo setlhopheng sa phologo ya Kanban sa lenaane la Pono ya Boto: Tse di Dirilweng kgatlhanong le Tse di Rarabolotsweng, Phologo e e Setseng, Nako mo Lenaaneng, Dingwaga tse di Fa Gare, Setshwantsho sa Palo ya Tiro kgotsa Tiragatso ya Matlha a Bofelo. Nngwe le nngwe e bontsha setshwantsho mme, ka fa tlase ga sone, tafole ya dipalo tse se thadilweng go tswa mo go tsone. Tobetsa Ntsha kwa godimo go boloka tafole eo jaaka PDF kgotsa Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: Pono ya Mmapa e bontsha dikarata tsa boto jaaka matshwao mo setshwantshong se motsamaisi wa boto a se tsenyang, jaaka thulaganyo ya mokgatlho kgotsa mmapa wa lefelo. E siametse tiro e e diragalang mo mafelong, jaaka dikamore, metšhine kgotsa ditsha.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: Motsamaisi wa boto o tobetsa Tsenya setshwantsho sa mmapa mme a tlhophe faele ya PNG, JPEG, GIF kgotsa WebP, mme a ka e tlosa morago kwantle ga go latlhegelwa ke mafelo a dikarata. Batho ba ba ka fetolang boto ba bona dikarata tse di iseng di nne mo mmapeng; goga nngwe mo setshwantshong, kgotsa e tlhophe mme o tobetse kwa e leng teng, mme o goge letshwao go le sutisa. Letshwao le tsaya mmala wa letshwao la ntlha la karata, mme go le tobetsa go bula karata.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: Pono ya Imeile e bontsha boto jaaka lebokose la makwalo: dikarata ke melaetsa, manaane ke diforoltara mme ditshwao ke ditshwao. O ka kwala le go araba imeile go tswa mo atereseng ya boto ka boyone, ka jalo dikarabo di boela kwa botong jaaka dikarata le dikakgelo.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Tobetsa Tse di Tsenang, Tse di Romilweng, Imeile tsotlhe, lenaane kgotsa letshwao go tlhopha se se bontshiwang, kwala mo lebokoseng la go batla go fokotsa mela, mme o tobetse mola go bula karata, e dikakgelo tsa yone e leng puisano. Kwala e kwala imeile e ntšha mme motsu wa karabo o araba nngwe, e romelwa go tswa mo atereseng ya boto. Boto pele e tshwanetse go amogela imeile, e e tshubiwang mo Dipeakanyong tsa Dikitsiso tsa boto ka fa tlase ga Imeile go ya karateng.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: Pono ya Puisano e bontsha boto jaaka lefelo la tiro la puisano: karata nngwe le nngwe e e nang le puisano ke kanale mme dikakgelo tsa yone ke melaetsa. Setlhare sa dikanale se akaretsa boto nngwe le nngwe e o ka e bonang, le palo ya melaetsa e o iseng o e bale.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Bula lefelo la tiro le boto mo Dikanale mme o tobetse karata; e bulega mo karolong e e fa gare mme melaetsa ya yone mo karolong ya puisano. Kwala molaetsa mme o tobetse Enter kgotsa Romela; Shift+Enter e simolola mola o mosha. Go simolola puisano mo karateng e e se nang melaetsa, tobetsa Bontsha dikarata tsotlhe tsa boto eo mme o tlhophe karata. Dikarolo di fetolwa ka fa morago go dipuo tse di kwalwang go tswa mojeng go ya molemeng.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: Pono ya Taolo ya Diphetolelo e bontsha boto jaaka setlhatlhobi sa mathata sa polokelo ya khoutu: dikarata ke mathata, ditshwao ke ditshwao, ditshwao tse di nang le letlha la bofelo ke dikgato tse dikgolo, dikakgelo ke puisano mme tse di tshwaraganeng ke difaele. E tsenya gape le go tsamaisana le mathata go tswa kwa GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Lebelela mathata a a buduleng le a a tswetsweng, sefa ka letshwao kgotsa ka kgato e kgolo, mme o bule bothata go bala le go oketsa mo puisanong ya bone. Karata e balwa e tswetswe fa e le mo polokelong kgotsa e le mo lenaaneng le le jaaka Go Tswetswe kgotsa Go Feditswe. Mathata a masha a nna dikarata mo lenaaneng le le buduleng la boto, mme Tswala kgotsa Bula gape e sutisa karata magareng ga manaane a a buduleng le a a tswetsweng. Sengwe le sengwe ke data e e tlwaelegileng ya karata, ka jalo diphetogo di bolokwa mo hisitoring ya boto.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Ditlhopha tsa dikholomo di go letla go rulaganya dikarata tse di tshwanang ka ditsela tse dingwe, jaaka ka botlhokwa, kgato e kgolo kgotsa bogolo, kwantle ga go ntsha karata epe mo lenaaneng la yone. Setlhopha sengwe le sengwe se na le dikholomo tsa sone tse di nang le mebala.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: Motsamaisi wa boto o kwala leina mo Setlhopha se sesha sa dikholomo mme a tobetse Oketsa, morago a oketse dikholomo ka leina le mmala. Tlhopha setlhopha kwa godimo; karata nngwe le nngwe e mo go nngwe ya dikholomo tsa sone kgotsa mo Ga e a bewa. Goga karata go ya kholomong e nngwe go fetola lefelo la yone mo setlhopheng seno fela; lenaane, tsela, ditshwao le maloko a yone di nna di ntse jalo. Karata nngwe le nngwe e bontsha gape ditshwao tse dinnye tsa kholomo ya yone mo ditlhopheng tse dingwe.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: Pono ya Webosaete e bontsha boto jaaka webosaete e e agilweng go tswa mo dikarateng le mo go tse di tshwaraganeng tsa yone, sekao webosaete e e tsentsweng go tswa kwa WordPress, Ghost, Blogger kgotsa webosaete e e sa fetogeng. Boto ya botlhe e ka bulega mo ponong eno, ka jalo baeti ba bona webosaete mo atereseng ya boto.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Dikarata tse di mo lenaaneng le le bidiwang Published di mo webosaeteng, kgotsa dikarata tsa lenaane lengwe le lengwe fa go se na lenaane le le jalo; dikarata tse di mo polokelong ga di ke di bonala. Dikarata tse di mo tseleng e e bidiwang Pages di dira lenaane la ditlhopho, le ditiro-potlana jaaka ditsebe-potlana, mme dikarata tse dingwe ke dikwalo mo tsebeng ya ntlha, tse dintšha pele. Tlhaloso ya karata ke mokwalo wa tsebe mme tse di tshwaraganeng le yone ke ditshwantsho le difaele tsa yone. Go e dirisa jaaka pono ya boto ya botlhe, e tlhophe mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Pono ya Boto.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: Pono ya Lebenkele e bontsha ditlhagiswa tse di mo dikarateng tsa boto jaaka lebenkele la inthanete, le ditshwantsho, ditlhwatlhwa, magoro, tsebe ya setlhagiswa, kariki le go duela. Karata e e mo lenaaneng le le rekisiwang e nna setlhagiswa fa tshimo ya yone ya tlhwatlhwa e na le palo, mme ditshwao tsa yone di nna magoro.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: Motsamaisi wa boto o baakanya lebenkele mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Lebenkele: masimo a tlhwatlhwa, khoutu ya setlhagiswa le setoko, lenaane la poraefete la Ditaelo, madi, VAT, mekgwa ya go duela, manaane a a rekisiwang le ditshwao tse di bontshiwang jaaka magoro, morago a tshwaye Lebenkele le bulegile. Bareki ba sefa ka legoro, ba oketsa ditlhagiswa mo karikeng mme ba duela. Taelo nngwe le nngwe e nna karata e ntšha mo lenaaneng la Ditaelo, mme moreki o amogela imeile ya netefatso.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: Sefa e bontsha fela dikarata tse di tshwanang le se o se tlhophang, jaaka ditshwao, maloko, badiri, matlha, boleng jwa masimo a a ikgethileng, mokwalo wa karata kgotsa gore dikarata di nnile nako e kae mo lenaaneng. Ga e fetole karata epe kgotsa tetla ya ope, mme motswako wa disefa o ka bolokwa ka leina mme wa dirisiwa gape.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Tlhopha ditshwao, batho, matlha kgotsa dipeelo tse dingwe mo lethakoreng, mme boto e bontsha fela dikarata tse di tshwanang. Ka fa tlase ga Ditshwao, KGOTSA e tshwantsha letshwao lengwe le le tlhophilweng mme LE e tlhoka otlhe; go tobetsa letshwao le le tlhophilweng gape go le tlosa. Mokwalo wa karata o dira fa o ntse o kwala. Go tswala karolo go tlogela sefa e tshubilwe go fitlha o e phimola. Patlo ya Lefatshe, le yone e le fano, e batla dikarata mo dibotong tsotlhe tsa gago.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Batla e bona dikarata le manaane a boto eno a mokwalo wa one o nang le se o se kwalang, mme e bontsha karata nngwe le nngwe e e bonweng mo botong ka boyone. Mo Diboto Tsotlhe konopo e e tshwanang e fokotsa lenaane la gago la diboto ka setlhogo.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Kwala mo tshimong mme o tobetse Enter. Lethakore le bontsha manaane le dikarata tse di tshwanang, mme karata ya ntlha e bulega mo botong le palo ka fa tlase ga tshimo. Tobetsa Enter gape go bona karata e e latelang kgotsa Shift+Enter go bona e e fetileng; metsu e dira se se tshwanang mme e boela kwa tshimologong. Tobetsa karata kgotsa lenaane mo diphitlhelelong go le bontsha mo botong, mme o tobetse Batla gape go tswala lethakore.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Go Tlhopha Tse Dintsi go go letla go tshwaya dikarata di le mmalwa mme morago o dire selo se le sengwe mo go tsotlhe ka nako e le nngwe: go baya letshwao kgotsa leloko, go fetola mmala, go sutisa, go kopolola kgotsa go di isa kwa polokelong. Mo Diboto Tsotlhe go tlhopha diboto boemong jwa moo.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Tshuba Go Tlhopha Tse Dintsi mo setlhogong sa boto, morago o tshwaye mabokose a dikarata, kgotsa o dirise Sefa go ya go tlhopho mo lethakoreng la Sefa go tlhopha karata nngwe le nngwe e sefa e e bontshang. Tlhopha tiro mo lethakoreng, jaaka Baya letshwao mo tlhophong, Sutisa tlhopho kgotsa Isa tlhopho kwa polokelong. Tobetsa Tima Go Tlhopha Tse Dintsi, X fa thoko ga konopo ya setlhogo, fa o feditse. O tlhoka tetla ya go fetola boto.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Masimo a a ikgethileng ke masimo a mangwe a boto ka boyone a dikarata, jaaka phetolelo, tekanyetso ya madi, moreki, lebokose la go tshwaya kgotsa tlhopho go tswa mo lenaaneng. Tshimo e tlhalosiwa gangwe fela mo botong, mme karata nngwe le nngwe e ka tshwara boleng jwa yone jwa tshimo eo.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Tobetsa + go dira tshimo, e neye leina le mofuta (mokwalo, palo, letlha, lenaane le le wang, lenaane le le wang la ditlhopho di le dintsi, lebokose la go tshwaya, madi kgotsa sekao sa mokwalo) mme o tlhophe kwa e bontshiwang teng: mo karateng, mo karateng e nnye, mo dikarateng tse dintšha kgotsa mo karateng nngwe le nngwe. Mofuta ga o kgone go fetolwa morago. Masimo a palo le a madi a ka bontsha palogotlhe ya one kwa godimo ga lenaane lengwe le lengwe. Boleng jwa karata bo tlatswa morago mo karateng e e buduleng.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: Polokelo e tshwara dikarata, manaane le ditsela tse di isitsweng kwa Polokelong. Go isa kwa polokelong go fitlha sengwe kwantle ga go se latlha, ka jalo se ka busediwa morago, fa go phimola go se tlosa ka gale.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Tlhopha tsebana ya Dikarata, Manaane kgotsa Ditsela mme o tobetse Busetsa fa thoko ga selo, kgotsa Busetsa tsotlhe. Karata e ka nna ya se busediwe fa lenaane la yone le le mo polokelong kgotsa le tletse go ya ka moedi wa WIP, mme Polokelo e bolela jalo. Batsamaisi ba boto ba bona gape Phimola le Phimola tsotlhe, tse di sa kgoneng go boelediwa. Diboto tse di mo polokelong di busediwa go tswa mo tsebeng ya Polokelo ya Diboto Tsotlhe boemong jwa moo.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Mafelo a ntlha a bontsha kwa tsela nngwe le nngwe, lenaane le karata di neng di beilwe teng fa di dirwa, le gore ke dife tse di sutileng fa e sa le jalo. A na le mosola morago ga thulaganyo e kgolo sešwa, kgotsa go bona setlhogo se karata e dirilweng ka sone.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Bala ditlhopha tse tharo, Ditsela, Manaane le Dikarata. Selo sengwe le sengwe se bontsha leina la sone la jaanong, Se sutile fa se se tlhole se le kwa se neng se beilwe teng, lefelo le se dirilweng mo go lone, setlhogo sa sone sa ntlha fa se fetogile, le gore se dirilwe leng. Tobetsa Ntšhwafatsa go bala hisitori ya boto gape. Dilo tse di dirilweng pele mafelo a kwalwa ga di na mola.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Kakaretso ke pego ya kopano ya letsatsi le letsatsi ya se se diragetseng mo botong, motho ka motho, e tserwe go tswa mo dikwalong tsa boto ka boyone. E araba gore mongwe le mongwe wa rona o dirile eng mo letsatsing kgotsa mo bekeng e e fetileng, le gore ke eng se se fetileng nako.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Tlhopha Letsatsi le le fetileng kgotsa Beke e e fetileng. Leloko lengwe le lengwe le le dirileng sengwe kgotsa le le nang le dikarata tse di fetileng nako le bona ditlhopha tsa dikarata tse di Feditsweng, tse di Sutisitsweng, tse di Okeditsweng le tse go Kgadilweng mo go tsone, mmogo le dikarata tsa lone tse di Fetileng nako, mme karata nngwe le nngwe e bulega go tswa mo kgolaganong ya yone. Tobetsa Kopolola jaaka mokwalo go kopolola kakaretso yotlhe, e e siametseng go tsenngwa mo puisanong kgotsa mo imeileng.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Esale o etela la bofelo e bontsha se batho ba bangwe ba se fetotseng mo botong eno esale o e bula la bofelo: dikarata tse dintšha, metsamao, dikakgelo, diphetogo tsa matlha a bofelo le maloko a a okeditsweng. Tsenyo ya lenaane la ditlhopho e bontsha palo ya diphetogo.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Go bula boto go kwala ketelo ya gago. Bula pono eno go bona diphetogo di kopantswe ka karata, tse dintšha pele, mme o tobetse mola go bula karata eo. Diphetogo tsa gago ga di bontshiwe. Motsamaisi a ka fitlha tirelo eno mo Phaneleng ya motsamaisi / Dipeakanyo / Ditirelo.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Ponagalo e swetsa gore ke mang yo o ka bonang boto: batho fela ba ba okeditsweng mo go yone (Poraefete), modirisi mongwe le mongwe yo o tsenyeng mo WeKan eno (Badirisi ba ba tsentseng), kgotsa mongwe le mongwe yo o nang le kgolagano (Botlhe). Go fetola go nna le maloko a boto fa e se fa motsamaisi wa boto a letla ka tsela e nngwe.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: Motsamaisi wa boto o tobetsa konopo ya ponagalo mo setlhogong sa boto mme a tlhophe Poraefete, Badirisi ba ba tsentseng kgotsa Botlhe; tlhopho ya jaanong e na le letshwao la netefatso mme konopo morago e bontsha peakanyo e ntšha. Mo botong ya Badirisi ba ba tsentseng kgotsa ya Botlhe, fa motsamaisi a letla, motsamaisi wa boto a ka tshwaya gape Mongwe le mongwe yo o tsentseng a ka fetola. Mo bathong ba bangwe konopo e bontsha fela peakanyo.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Lebelela e baya gore o utlwa go le kae ka boto eno: Go lebelela go go itsise ka phetogo nngwe le nngwe, Go latela ka diphetogo tsa dikarata tse o di dirileng kgotsa o leng leloko la tsone fela, mme Go didimatsa ga go go itsise ka sepe. Peakanyo ke ya gago; maloko a mangwe a tlhopha ya bone.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Tobetsa konopo ya go lebelela mo setlhogong sa boto mme o tlhophe Go lebelela, Go latela kgotsa Go didimatsa; seemo sa gago sa jaanong se na le letshwao la netefatso mme konopo e bontsha seemo se sesha. Fa phetogo e ganwa, molaetsa o bolela lebaka mme ga go sepe se se fetogang. Konopo e fitlhilwe fa motsamaisi a timile go lebelela.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Rulaganya Dikarata e fetola tatelano e dikarata di bontshiwang ka yone mo lenaaneng lengwe le lengwe: ka letlha la bofelo, setlhogo, nako ya go dirwa, ditlhopho kgotsa tatelano ya ditshwao ya boto. E fetola fela se o se bonang, mme ga go karata e e sutisiwang.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Tobetsa Rulaganya Dikarata mo setlhogong sa boto mme o tlhophe tatelano; dikarata mo lenaaneng lengwe le lengwe di e latela mme konopo e re Thulaganyo e tshubilwe. Tobetsa X fa thoko ga yone go tlosa thulaganyo mme o boele kwa tatelanong e dikarata di neng di gogetswe mo go yone. Tlhopho e bolokwa mo sebatling sa gago le fa o tsenya tsebe gape. Mo tatelanong ya Ditshwao, motsamaisi wa boto a ka fetola tatelano ya ditshwao ka Sutisetsa godimo le Sutisetsa tlase fa a fetola letshwao.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Dipeakanyo tsa Boto di kokoanya sengwe le sengwe se se beetsweng boto eno e le nngwe: melao ya yone, thulaganyo, mmala le bokamorago, matlha, dipono, ditsela, manaane le dikarata, go ntsha le go tsenya, dikitsiso, diwebhuku le polokelo. Ditsenyo di le dintsi ke tsa batsamaisi ba boto; seabe sa gago le dipeakanyo tsa saete di swetsa gore o bona dife.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Bula lethakore la moja la boto ka lenaane la ditlhopho la mela e meraro mme o tobetse Dipeakanyo tsa Boto. Tlhopha tsenyo mme lebokose kgotsa tsebe ya yone e bulega. Ditsenyo di kopantswe: melao pele, morago ponalo ya boto, morago ka moo e thadiwang ka teng, morago se se tsenang le se se tswang mo go yone, mme kwa bofelong polokelo.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Fetola mmala e baya setlhogo sa mebala sa boto eno ka boyone, se leloko lengwe le lengwe le se bonang mo botong eno. Ke tsela ya go farologanya diboto ka bonako. Ke batsamaisi ba boto fela ba ba ka se fetolang.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Tobetsa sekao sa mmala sa setlhogo; se dirisiwa ka bonako, kwantle ga konopo ya Boloka. Mo ditlhogong tse di bataletseng le tse di phepa o ka tlhopha gape mebala ya gago ka maotwana a mebala mme o e lekole mo ponelopeleng. Mmala o o o beetseng wena mo Dipeakanyong tsa Leloko o sa ntse o tla pele ga mmala wa boto mo go wena.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: Kitsiso ya boto ke molaetsa o motsamaisi wa boto a o kwalelang mongwe le mongwe mo botong eno, o o bontshiwang mo moleng kwa godimo ga manaane a boto. O dirise go kwala dikaelo tse leloko lengwe le lengwe le tshwanetseng go di bona, jaaka letlha la bofelo kgotsa phetogo mo tsamaisong ya boto.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Kwala mokwalo, go fitlha ditlhaka di le 2000 tsa mokwalo o o tlwaelegileng, tshwaya Bontsha mongwe le mongwe mo botong eno, mme o tobetse Boloka. Maloko a bona mola go fitlha ba o tswala ka X ya one, e e o fitlhang mo go bone fela. Fa kitsiso e fetolwa, e bontshiwa gape mongwe le mongwe.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: Setshwantsho sa bokamorago ke setshwantsho se se bontshiwang kwa morago ga manaane a boto, le gape jaaka setshwantshonyana sa boto mo tsebeng ya Diboto Tsotlhe. E ka nna aterese ya setshwantsho mo inthaneteng kgotsa setshwantsho se se tsentsweng mme sa bolokwa mo WeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Kwala aterese ya setshwantsho mo URL ya Setshwantsho sa Bokamorago mme o tobetse Boloka, kgotsa dirisa Tlosa Setshwantsho sa Bokamorago go se phimola. Go boloka setshwantsho, tobetsa Tsenya setshwantsho sa bokamorago mme o tlhophe faele; ditshwantsho tse di tsentsweng di bontshiwa kwa tlase, kwa go tobetsa nngwe go e dirang bokamorago jwa boto, mme matshwao a a e folosa kgotsa a e phimola.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Letlha le letla motsamaisi wa boto go tlhopha sebopego se le sengwe sa letlha sa mongwe le mongwe mo botong eno, boemong jwa sebopego se se beetsweng saete yotlhe. Lebokose le le tshwanang le na le konopo ya gago ya palo ya beke mme, mo batsamaising ba boto, go tsamaisana ga khalendara go go tsenyang matlha a bofelo a dikarata mo khalendareng ya CalDAV jaaka Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Tshwaya Sebopego sa Letlha sa boto, tlhopha sebopego mme o tobetse Boloka; tlosa letshwao go latela peakanyo ya saete gape. Sebopego sa leloko ka bolone se se tshubilweng mo Dipeakanyong tsa Leloko se sa ntse se fenya. Bontsha beke ya ngwaga e tshuba kgotsa e tima dipalo tsa beke mo go wena ka bonako. Go tsamaisana ga khalendara, tsenya aterese ya khalendara, leina la modirisi le lefoko la sephiri la tiriso, tshwaya lebokose la go tsamaisana mme o Boloke.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: Dipeakanyo tsa Diboto Tsotlhe di swetsa gore setshwantshonyana sa boto eno se bontsha eng mo tsebeng ya Diboto Tsotlhe, jaaka palo ya dikarata tsa lenaane lengwe le lengwe le ditshwantsho tsa maloko. Di baya gape go tsofala ga dikarata, go isa ka bosona kwa polokelong dikarata tse di sa amiwang, le gore a bophara jwa manaane ke jwa motho ka esi kgotsa bo abelanwa.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Tshwaya kgotsa tlosa letshwao mo moleng mme o bolokwa ka bonako. Fa go tsofala ga dikarata go tshubilwe, kwala dipalo tse tharo tsa malatsi morago ga one dikarata di fifalang ka dikgato. Go isa kwa polokelong ka bosona, kwala gore karata e ka nna malatsi a le kae kwantle ga tiragalo pele e isiwa kwa polokelong, kgotsa o go tlogele go se na sepe go go tima. Disekao ga di ke di isiwa kwa polokelong.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Pono ya Boto e tlhopha gore ke dipono dife, jaaka Ditsela, Manaane, Tafole, Khalendara, Gantt kgotsa ditshwantsho, tse di neelwang mo lenaaneng la Pono ya Boto la boto eno, le gore boto e bulega ka efe. E beiwa ka go farologana fa boto e le ya botlhe le fa e le ya poraefete.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: Lebokose le na le mola o le mongwe ka pono nngwe le mabokose a le mane a go tshwaya: pono ya tlwaelo le dipono tse di bontshiwang tsa boto ya botlhe, le tse pedi tse di tshwanang tsa boto ya poraefete. Tshwaya lebokose la Bontsha la pono go e neela mo lenaaneng mme lebokose la yone la Tlwaelo go bula boto ka yone.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Tsela e tshwara dipeakanyo tsa ditsela tsa boto yotlhe: gore a ditsela di ka gogwa, gore a bogodimo jwa tsone bo ka fetolwa, gore a ditsela tsotlhe di abelana mola o le mongwe wa ditlhogo tsa manaane, le gore tsela e bontsha masimo afe a Scrum. Ditlhopha tsa Moedi wa WIP, meedi e e abelanwang ya tiro e e tswelelang mo manaaneng a le mmalwa, di fano gape.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Tshwaya mabokose a o a batlang; lebokose la Go ka gogwa le mo tafoleng kwa godimo. Mola o le mongwe o o abelanwang wa ditlhogo tsa manaane o bontsha tsela nngwe le nngwe le manaane otlhe a boto ka fa tlase ga mola o le mongwe wa ditlhogo o o nnang kwa godimo, kwantle ga go fetola manaane. Tobetsa Ditlhopha tsa Moedi wa WIP kwa tlase go oketsa kgotsa go fetola meedi e e abelanwang.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: Lenaane le tshwara dipeakanyo tsa manaane tsa boto yotlhe: gore a manaane a ka gogwa, gore a bophara jwa one bo ka fetolwa, gore a lenaane lengwe le lengwe le na le bophara jo bo tshwanang, le tshimo ya Scrum e lenaane le e bontshang. Gape di tshuba melawana ya phologo ya Kanban: melawana ya manaane, manaane a a kgaoganngwang go nna A a Dirwang le A a Feditsweng, ntlha ya boitlamo le moedi wa WIP ka motho.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Tshwaya dikonopo tse o di tlhokang; lebokose la Go ka gogwa le mo tafoleng kwa godimo. Fa go fetola bogolo go letleletswe, goga setshwaro magareng ga manaane go fetola bophara. Mola wa molawana wa phologo o bonala fela fa tirelo eo e tshubilwe mo saeteng, mme fa e tshubilwe, dintlha tsa yone di beiwa go tswa mo lenaaneng la ditlhopho la lenaane lengwe le lengwe.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: Lebenkele le fetola dikarata tsa boto go nna lebenkele la inthanete le le bontshiwang mo ponong ya boto ya Lebenkele. Motsamaisi wa boto o tlhopha gore ke masimo afe a a ikgethileng e leng tlhwatlhwa, khoutu ya setlhagiswa le setoko, gore ke manaane afe a a rekisiwang, gore ke ditshwao dife e leng magoro, gore ditaelo di kwalwa kae le gore ke mekgwa efe ya go duela e e neelwang.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Baya mela mme o tobetse Boloka; sengwe le sengwe se bolokwa mmogo mme se tlhatlhobiwa gape ke sefatlhego sa tirelo. Karata e e nang le tlhwatlhwa mo lenaaneng le le rekisiwang e nna setlhagiswa. Ditaelo di kwalwa jaaka dikarata mo lenaaneng la Ditaelo, le le tshwanetseng go nna mo botong ya poraefete, mme moreki a ka amogela imeile ya netefatso. O ka dira gape gore Lebenkele e nne se baeti ba boto ya botlhe ba se bonang.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: Karata e swetsa gore dikarata tse dinnye le dikarata tse di buduleng tsa boto eno di bontsha eng, le ka tatelano efe, nngwe le nngwe ka esi. E dirise fa boto e ikaegile ka masimo a mmalwa, sekao go baya tlhaloso kgotsa masimo a a ikgethileng pele, kgotsa go bontsha letlha la bofelo pele mo dikarateng tse dinnye.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: Lebokose le na le dikarolo tse pedi, Bontsha mo Karateng e Nnye le Bontsha mo Karateng. Tshwaya kgotsa tlosa letshwao mo karolong kgotsa mo tshimong go e bontsha kgotsa go e fitlha, mme o goge mela go fetola tatelano ya yone. Dikarolo di le mmalwa di na le lenaane la tsone la ditlhopho le le nang le dipeakanyo tse dingwe, jaaka Ditiro-potlana le ditlhopho tsa go goga karata.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: Ntsha e kwala boto eno, kgotsa karolo ya yone, mo faeleng: dibopego tsa WeKan ka boyone, disepreteshiti, PDF, HTML, difaele tsa khalendara le dibopego tsa didirisiwa tse dingwe di le dintsi. Tsenya mo teng e oketsa diteng go tswa mo faeleng e e ntshitsweng ya WeKan mo botong eno. Go ntsha boto ga se polokelo ya tshireletso ya saete yotlhe.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: Mo Ntsha, tlhopha pele se o batlang go se akaretsa, morago o tobetse sebopego mme faele e a folosiwa. Mo Tsenya mo teng, tlhopha faele e e ntshitsweng ya WeKan ka sebopego sa json kgotsa zip mme diteng tsa yone di okediwa mo botong eno. Go tsenya go tlhoka tetla ya go kwala mo botong, mme nngwe le nngwe ya tsone e ka timiwa ke motsamaisi wa saete.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: Dikitsiso di baya ditlwaelo tsa boto eno tsa dikitsiso tsa imeile le tsa mo tirisong, dikgakololo tsa yone tsa letlha la bofelo, imeile go ya karateng, le ka moo dikitsiso di romelwang ka teng. Tlhopho e e tlhamaletseng ya leloko ka bolone e sa ntse e ka feta tlwaelo ya boto.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: Mo lebokoseng la mo tirisong le mo imeileng, tlhopha Tlwaelo go latela peakanyo ya saete, kgotsa Ee kgotsa Nnyaa go e feta mo botong eno. Ka fa tlase ga Dikgakololo tsa letlha la bofelo, kwala malatsi a go gakolola, a kgaogantswe ka dikhoma, kwa 0 e leng letsatsi la bofelo mme dipalo tse di kwa tlase ga lefela e le malatsi morago ga lone, morago o tobetse Boloka. Dikarolo tsa go romela kwa tlase di baya se kitsiso e se rwalang, go kopanya le nako.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: Diwebhuku tse di Tswang di romela ditiragalo tsa boto eno kwa tirelong e nngwe, jaaka sedirisiwa sa puisano kgotsa kopanyo ya gago, fa di ntse di diragala. Webhuku nngwe le nngwe e romela mokwalo wa tiragalo mmogo le maina le dikgolagano tsa boto, lenaane, tsela, karata le batho ba ba amegang.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Kwala leina, aterese e tirelo e e amogelang e go neileng yone mme, fa e batla, thokene, tlhopha mofuta mme o tobetse Dira. Webhuku e e bolokilweng e bontsha ditlhopho tse dingwe: gore e romela ditiragalo dife, melaetsa e e tlhamaletseng kwa malokong a karata mo Mattermost, le ka moo melaetsa ya yone e kopanngwang le go beelwa nako ka teng. E Fetole mme o e Boloke gape, kgotsa dirisa Tima Webhuku Eno go e emisa.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Dithuso tse pedi tsa dikopano tsa Scrum, tse di leng teng mo lelokong lengwe le lengwe la boto. Kopano ya letsatsi le letsatsi ke tšhupanako e e nayang leloko lengwe le lengwe nako e e tshwanang, mme Boto ya go Itshekatsheka e dira boto e ntšha ya go itshekatsheka ya Simolola, Emisa, Tswelela.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-how-i: Kopano ya letsatsi le letsatsi e bontsha maloko a boto ka tatelano e e tlhakantsweng; Simolola e bala nako ya motho wa ntlha go ya kwa tlase, e e nnang khibidu fa e feta, mme E e latelang e fetisetsa go fitlha mo go wa bofelo. Tšhupanako e dira mo sebatling sa gago fela. Boto ya go Itshekatsheka e dira mme e bula boto e ntšha ya poraefete e e nang le manaane a Simolola go dira, Emisa go dira, Tswelela go dira le Dintlha tsa tiro.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-wha: Setlhopha sa moedi wa WIP ke moedi o le mongwe wa tiro e e tswelelang o o abelanwang ke manaane a mabedi kgotsa go feta mmogo, godimo ga moedi wa lenaane lengwe le lengwe ka bolone. O na le mosola fa tiro e e tswelelang e anamela mo manaaneng a le mmalwa, jaaka A a Dirwang, Tshekatsheko le Teko, kgotsa fa o batla go lekanyetsa tsela yotlhe.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-how: Ka fa tlase ga Oketsa setlhopha sa moedi wa WIP, tshwaya manaane a a tshwanetseng go balwa mmogo, kgotsa tlhopha tsela mme o tobetse Dirisa mo tseleng go tshwaya manaane a yone. Baya moedi mme o tobetse Oketsa setlhopha sa moedi wa WIP. Setlhopha se se leng teng se ka fetolwa ka Dirisa, sa tshubiwa kgotsa sa timiwa ka Tshuba Moedi wa WIP, kgotsa sa tlosiwa ka Phimola.
help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: Ditiro-potlana di kgaoganya karata e kgolo go nna dikarata tse dinnye tse nngwe le nngwe e ka abelwang, ya beelwa nako mme ya sutisiwa e le nosi, fa karata ya motsadi e di bontsha mme e bala gore di le kae di feditswe. Dipeakanyo tseno di swetsa gore ditiro-potlana tse dintšha di dirwa kae le gore tiro-potlana e bontsha motsadi wa yone jang.
help-board-settings-subtasks-how-it-work: Tlhopha gore karata e nnye ya tiro-potlana e bitsa motsadi wa yone jang, gore a dikarata tsa boto di na le karolo ya Ditiro-potlana, le boto, lenaane le tsela tse ditiro-potlana tse dintšha di dirwang mo go tsone. Ka tlwaelo di ya kwa botong ya tsone. Ditiro-potlana ka bo tsone di okediwa go tswa mo karolong ya Ditiro-potlana ya karata e e buduleng.
help-rules-what-it-is-description: Melao e dira boto ka bosona: fa sengwe se diragala, sesusumetsi, WeKan e dira sengwe, tiro. Sekao, fa karata e sutisetswa kwa Go Feditswe, e tshwaye e feditswe. Melao e dirwa ke batsamaisi ba boto, mme boto e ka letla maloko a yone go e bala.
help-rules-how-it-works-description: Kwala setlhogo, tlhopha sesusumetsi mme o tlatse masimo a sone, morago o tlhophe tiro; molao o a bolokwa mme o dira go tloga foo fa e se fa o timilwe. Mo ponong ya Tsamaiso ya Tiro o ka aga melao ka go goga sesusumetsi le tiro. Melao e ka fiwa maina a masha, ya phimolwa, ya ntshiwa le go tsenngwa, mme molao o ka nna le disusumetsi le ditiro tse dingwe mo dintlheng tsa one.
help-member-settings-what-it-is-descript: Dipeakanyo tsa Leloko ke lenaane la gago la ditlhopho, le le bulwang go tswa mo leineng la gago la modirisi kgotsa setshwantsho kwa godimo mojeng. Le na le ditsebe tsa gago jaaka Dikarata tsa me, Dikarata tse di Felang le Tse di Tshwailweng ka Naledi, dikakaretso tsa diboto, le dipeakanyo tsotlhe tsa gago, go tloga mo porofaeleng le lefoko la sephiri go ya kwa puong le mehuta ya ditlhaka.
help-member-settings-how-it-works-descri: Tobetsa leina la gago la modirisi kgotsa setshwantsho mme o tlhophe tsenyo; tsebe kgotsa lebokose la yone le a bulega. Se o se bonang se ikaegile ka mofuta wa akhaonto ya gago, seabe sa gago le dipeakanyo tsa saete. Fa porofaele ya ditirelo ya motsamaisi wa saete e go fitlhela ditirelo dingwe, lenaane le bolela gore di le kae di fitlhilwe.
help-member-edit-profile-what-it-is-desc: Fetola Porofaele e fetola ka moo batho ba bangwe ba go bonang ka teng mo WeKan: leina la gago lotlhe le ditlhaka tsa ntlha tsa maina, mme, fa saete e letla, leina la gago la modirisi le aterese ya imeile. Fa saete e letla, o ka phimola gape kgotsa wa fitlha boitshupo jwa akhaonto ya gago fano.
help-member-edit-profile-how-it-works-de: Fetola masimo mme o tobetse Boloka; lebokose le a tswala fa go dirile mme le bontsha phoso fa go sa dira. Leina la modirisi kgotsa aterese ya imeile e e setseng e dirisiwa ke akhaonto e nngwe e a ganwa, mme aterese ya imeile e e fetotsweng e tshwaiwa e sa netefadiwa. Phimola e tlosa akhaonto ya gago kwantle ga go boelela, fa Fitlha boitshupo jwa akhaonto e boloka hisitori ya gago mme e emisetsa leina la gago.
help-member-change-settings-what-it-is-d: Fetola Dipeakanyo di tshwara ditlhopho tsa gago tsa go fetola le tsa go bontsha, jaaka ditshwaro tsa go goga, go tshwaya dikarata tse di fetogileng esale o di bula la bofelo, mola wa tlhomo, go boloka dikwalo ka Enter, go bula dikarata di le dintsi ka nako e le nngwe le modumo wa lenaane la tlhatlhobo. Di dira mo go wena fela, mo botong nngwe le nngwe.
help-member-change-settings-how-it-works: Tobetsa konopo go e tshuba kgotsa go e tima; letshwao la netefatso le bontsha gore e tshubilwe mme e bolokwa ka bonako. Mo Bontsha palo ya dikarata fa lenaane le na le go feta, kwala palo mme o tobetse Boloka. Sebopego sa letlha, tshimologo ya beke le dikitsiso di na le ditsenyo tsa tsone mo Dipeakanyong tsa Leloko.
help-member-change-color-what-it-is-desc: Fetola mmala e baya setlhogo sa gago sa mebala sa WeKan. Se feta setlhogo sa saete gongwe le gongwe le gape mmala wa boto ka boyone mo ditsebeng tsa boto, mme mo go wena fela.
help-member-change-color-how-it-works-de: Tobetsa sekao sa mmala sa setlhogo; se dirisiwa ka bonako. Mo ditlhogong tse di bataletseng le tse di phepa o ka tlhopha mebala ya gago ka maotwana a mebala mme wa e bona mo ponelopeleng. Tlhopha Setlhogo sa tlwaelo go tlosa tlhopho ya gago mme o bone mebala ya boto kgotsa ya saete gape.
help-member-change-font-what-it-is-descr: Mofuta wa ditlhaka o go letla go itlhophela mofuta wa ditlhaka, bogolo jwa mokwalo le mmala wa mokwalo wa sebopego sotlhe sa WeKan. O thusa go bala, sekao ka bogolo jo bo fetang kgotsa mmala o o siametseng matlho a gago.
help-member-change-font-how-it-works-des: Tobetsa Tlwaelo kgotsa nngwe ya dikonopo tsa mefuta ya ditlhaka; go neelwa fela mefuta ya ditlhaka e e tsentsweng mo sebatling sa gago. Tlhopha bogolo mme o tlhophe mmala wa mokwalo mo maotwaneng a mebala, kgotsa tobetsa Tlosa go boela kwa mmaleng wa setlhogo. Diphetogo di dira ka bonako mme di bolokwa mo porofaeleng ya gago, mme mola wa ponelopele o bontsha phitlhelelo.
help-member-change-avatar-what-it-is-des: Setshwantsho sa gago ke setshwantsho se sennye se se bontshiwang sa gago mo dikarateng, mo manaaneng a maloko, mo dikakgelong le mo setlhogong. Fetola Setshwantsho se go letla go tsenya ditshwantsho, go tlhopha gore ke sefe se se dirisiwang, go di phimola, kgotsa go boela kwa ditlhakeng tsa ntlha tsa maina a gago.
help-member-change-avatar-how-it-works-d: Tobetsa Tsenya setshwantsho mme o tlhophe setshwantsho; se okediwa mo lenaaneng, mme go tobetsa mola wa sone go se dira setshwantsho sa gago, se tshwailwe ka letshwao la netefatso. Tobetsa Ditlhaka tsa ntlha go bontsha ditlhaka tsa ntlha tsa maina a gago boemong jwa moo. Letshwao la setshwaro sa matlakala le phimola setshwantsho morago ga fa o netefaditse. Lebokose le bontsha meedi ya bogolo le ya mofuta wa faele fa saete e e beile.
help-member-change-password-what-it-is-d: Fetola Lefoko la Sephiri le emisetsa lefoko la sephiri le o tsenang ka lone mo WeKan. Ke la diakhaonto tse di nang le lefoko la sephiri la WeKan; diakhaonto tse di tsenang ka tirelo e nngwe di fetola lefoko la tsone la sephiri koo.
help-member-change-password-how-it-works: Tsenya lefoko la gago la sephiri la jaanong, morago lefoko le lesha la sephiri gabedi, mme o le romele. Saete e ka tlhoka boleele jo bo kwa tlase mme ya gana mafoko a sephiri a a gaufi thata le leina la gago la modirisi kgotsa imeile, kgotsa a a fitlhetsweng mo ditshenyegong tse di itsegeng tsa data. Morago ga phetogo kopano nngwe le nngwe ya akhaonto ya gago e a tswalwa, mme o tsena gape ka lefoko le lesha la sephiri.
help-member-passkeys-what-it-is-descript: Senotlolo sa go tsena se go letla go tsena ka monwana, sefatlhego, loko ya sekirini kgotsa senotlolo sa tshireletso sa sedirisiwa seno boemong jwa lefoko la gago la sephiri. Senotlolo se nna mo sedirisiweng sa gago mme WeKan e boloka fela karolo ya sone ya botlhe.
help-member-passkeys-how-it-works-descri: Kwala leina jaaka Mogala wa me mme o tobetse Oketsa senotlolo sa go tsena mo sedirisiweng seno, morago o netefatse ka loko ya sekirini ya gago fa sebatli se botsa. Dinotlolo tsa gago di bontshiwa ka maina le matlha a tsone, mme letshwao la setshwaro sa matlakala le tlosa nngwe. Fa sebatli se sa kgone go dira dinotlolo, lebokose le bolela jalo.
help-member-sqrl-what-it-is-description: SQRL e go letla go tsena ka go sekena khoutu ya QR ka tiriso ya SQRL, kwantle ga lefoko la sephiri. Fano o oketsa boitshupo jwa gago jwa SQRL mo akhaontong ya gago gangwe, kgotsa o bo tlosa gape.
help-member-sqrl-how-it-works-descriptio: Tobetsa Oketsa boitshupo jwa me jwa SQRL mme khoutu ya QR e a bonala. E sekene ka tiriso ya SQRL, kgotsa tobetsa Bula moreki wa SQRL wa moreki o o mo khomputareng eno; lebokose le go bolelela fa boitshupo bo okeditswe, kgotsa fa khoutu e feletswe ke nako kgotsa e paletswe. Tlosa boitshupo jwa me jwa SQRL bo bo tlosa mo akhaontong ya gago.
help-member-two-factor-what-it-is-descri: Netefatso ya dikgato tse pedi e dira gore go tsena go kope khoutu ya dinomoro di le 6 go tswa mo tirisong ya netefatso mo mogaleng wa gago morago ga lefoko la gago la sephiri, ka jalo lefoko la sephiri le le utswitsweng le le nosi ga le a lekana go tsena mo akhaontong ya gago.
help-member-two-factor-how-it-works-desc: Tobetsa Tshuba Netefatso ya Dikgato tse Pedi, morago o sekene khoutu ya QR ka tiriso ya netefatso kgotsa o kwale khoutu e e bontshiwang ka fa tlase ga yone mo tirisong. Tsenya khoutu ya dinomoro di le 6 e tiriso e e bontshang mme o tobetse Netefatsa mme o Tshube. Go tloga foo go tsena go kopa khoutu, mme lebokose le le tshwanang le ka e tima gape fa e se fa motsamaisi wa gago a e tlhoka.
help-member-hidden-boards-what-it-is-des: Diboto tse di fitlhilweng di bontsha diboto tse o di tlogetseng tse o neng o sa ntse o ka di fitlhelela ka setlhopha, mokgatlho kgotsa lefelo la imeile ya gago, ka jalo WeKan e go di fitlhetse boemong jwa moo. Go tlogela boto e e ntseng jalo ga go fetole boleloko jwa gago jwa setlhopha kgotsa jwa mokgatlho.
help-member-hidden-boards-how-it-works-d: Lebokose le bontsha mola o le mongwe ka boto e e fitlhilweng, kgotsa le bolela gore ga go na epe. Tobetsa Busetsa fa thoko ga boto go e busetsa kwa Diboto Tsotlhe. Seno se e tlosa fela mo lenaaneng la gago la tse di fitlhilweng; gore a o ka bula boto go sa ntse go swediwa ke boto ka boyone.
help-member-change-language-what-it-is-d: Fetola Puo e go tlhophela puo ya sebopego sa WeKan. Tlhopho ya gago e bolokwa mo porofaeleng ya gago, ka jalo e go latela go ya kwa sebatling sengwe le sengwe. Go fitlha o tlhopha, WeKan e latela dipuo tsa sebatli sa gago mme e boela kwa Seesemaneng.
help-member-change-language-how-it-works: Dipuo di bontshiwa ka maina a tsone ka bo tsone, le folaga, mola wa kgaolo wa dipuo tsa dikgaolo, le kaelo ya dipuo tse di kwalwang go tswa mojeng go ya molemeng; e e leng teng jaanong e na le letshwao la netefatso. Tobetsa puo mme sebopego se fetoga ka bonako.
help-member-invite-people-what-it-is-des: Laletsa Batho e romela imeile e e nang le khoutu ya taletso kwa bathong ba ba iseng ba nne le akhaonto, gore ba ikwadise fa go ikwadisa ka bowena go timilwe. E letla maloko a lefelo la imeile la mokgatlho ka bolone go tlisa badirimmogo kwantle ga motsamaisi.
help-member-invite-people-how-it-works-d: Kwala diaterese tsa imeile, nngwe ka mola kgotsa di kgaogantswe ka dikhoma, tshwaya diboto tse ba tshwanetseng go tsena mo go tsone fa ba ikwadisa, mme o tobetse Laletsa. Lebokose le bolela gore a ditaletso di romilwe. O tlhoka seabe sa boto se se ka laletsang mo botong nngwe le nngwe e e tshwailweng, mme aterese e e setseng e na le akhaonto e emisa go romela.
help-member-date-what-it-is-description: Letlha le tlhopha ka moo matlha a kwalwang ka teng mo go wena, jaaka ngwaga-kgwedi-letsatsi kgotsa letsatsi-kgwedi-ngwaga, le nako kgotsa kwantle ga yone.
