Sebopego sa gago ka bosona se se tshubilweng se fenya sa boto le sa saete. Lebokose le le tshwanang le baya letsatsi la ntlha la beke le thulaganyo ya khalendara.
help-member-date-how-it-works-descriptio: Kwa godimo ga lebokose go bontsha dibopego tsa saete le tsa boto ya jaanong, gore o bone se o neng o tla se rua. Tshwaya Dipeakanyo tsa Leloko: Sebopego sa Letlha mme o tlhophe sebopego, baya tshimologo ya beke le thulaganyo ya khalendara fa o rata, mme o tobetse Boloka. Tlosa letshwao mo sebopegong sa gago mme o boloke go latela boto kgotsa saete gape.
help-bookmarks-what-it-is-description: Setlhopha sa naledi mo setlhogong ke lenaane la gago la matshwao a ditsebe: le boloka diboto, ditsebe tse dingwe tsa WeKan, mme go tswa mo manaaneng a tsone a ditlhopho ditsela, manaane le dikarata, di le kgakala ka go tobetsa gangwe fela. Dinaledi tsa gago ke tsa gago fela.
help-bookmarks-how-it-works-description: Tobetsa naledi go tshwaya kgotsa go tlosa naledi mo botong kgotsa mo tsebeng e o leng mo go yone; palo e bontsha gore o na le tse kae. Tobetsa motsu kgotsa palo go bula lenaane mme o tobetse mola go ya koo, kgotsa Bona tsotlhe tse di tshwailweng ka naledi go bona tsebe yotlhe ya Tse di Tshwailweng ka Naledi. Mo Diboto Tsotlhe / Tse di Tshwailweng ka Naledi o ka tlosa dinaledi mo ditshwantshonyaneng mme wa di goga go di rulaganya gape.
help-card-similar-cards-what-it-is-descr: Dikarata tse di tshwanang di bontsha dikarata tsa boto eno tse setlhogo le tlhaloso ya tsone di tshwanang thata le eno, gore kopi ya bobedi ya tiro e e tshwanang e lemogwe pele tiro e dirwa gabedi. Go tshwana go go gaufi thata go tshwaiwa jaaka Go ka nna kopi.
help-card-similar-cards-how-it-works-des: Go bontshiwa fano dikarata tse di tshwanang go fitlha go tse tlhano, nngwe le nngwe le lenaane le e leng mo go lone, mme setlhogo se a di bala. Tobetsa nngwe go e bula. Papiso ke go tshwantsha mokwalo fela go go dirwang ke sefatlhego sa tirelo, kwantle ga tirelo epe ya AI. Karolo e ka fitlhwa mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Karata, mola wa Dikarata tse di tshwanang, Bontsha mo Karateng.
help-card-activities-what-it-is-descript: Ditiragalo ke lenaane la hisitori ya karata ka boyone: gore ke mang yo o e dirileng, yo o fetotseng setlhogo sa yone, yo o okeditseng letshwao, yo o e sutisitseng, yo o kwadileng kakgelo kgotsa yo o tshwaraganyeng faele, le gore leng. Di araba gore go diragetse eng mo karateng eno kwantle ga go botsa ope.
help-card-activities-how-it-works-descri: Ditiragalo tse dintšha di bontshiwa ka tatelano, le ditlhogo, ditshwao, dikarolo tsa dikakgelo le maina a difaele di bopilwe ka tsela e e tshwanang le mo karateng ka boyone. Tobetsa setlhogo se se golaganeng go ya kwa karateng, lenaaneng kgotsa botong eo. Motsamaisi wa saete a ka tlhopha mo Phaneleng ya motsamaisi / Dipeakanyo / Tshireletso go bontsha mokwalo o o humileng jaaka mokwalo o o tlwaelegileng kgotsa kwantle ga dikgolagano tse di tobetsegang.
help-card-labels-what-it-is-description: Ditshwao ke matshwao a boto a a nang le mebala, a a dirisiwang go kopanya le go sefa dikarata ka setlhogo, botlhokwa kgotsa sengwe le sengwe se setlhopha se dumalanang ka sone. Letshwao le ka nna gape le letlha la lone la bofelo, le le le fetolang kgato e kgolo e e bofefo jaaka Sprint 1 kgotsa v2.0 mo karateng nngwe le nngwe e e le rwalang.
help-card-labels-how-it-works-descriptio: Tobetsa letshwao kgotsa konopo ya koketso go bula lebokose la ditshwao, morago o tobetse ditshwao go di baya mo karateng kgotsa go di tlosa; letshwao la netefatso le bontsha tse di tlhophilweng. Phensele fa thoko ga letshwao e fetola leina la lone, mmala le letlha la bofelo, mme letshwao le le nang le letlha la bofelo le bontsha letlha leo fa thoko ga lone. Dikgomaretsi le mafelo di mo karolong e e tshwanang eno.
help-card-dates-what-it-is-description: Karata e na le matlha a mane a a ikgethelwang: La go amogelwa la fa tiro e goroga, La tshimologo la fa tiro e simolola, La bofelo la nako ya bofelo mme La go fela la fa e feditswe. Letshwao la letlha la bofelo le na le mmala go ya ka potlako mme le bala malatsi a a setseng, ka jalo tiro e e tlang morago e bonala sentle mo botong.
help-card-dates-how-it-works-description: Tobetsa koketso fa thoko ga letlha, kgotsa letshwao la letlha, tlhopha letsatsi le nako mme o boloke; letlha la bofelo le le se nang nako e e tlhophilweng le newa 17:00. Bula lebokose le le tshwanang gape go le fetola kgotsa go le phimola. Fa dikhutswafatso tsa khiiboto di tshubilwe, go tobetsa d mo karateng go bula letlha la yone la bofelo. Karata e bala gape gore letlha la yone la bofelo le fetotswe ga kae.
help-card-members-what-it-is-description: Karolo ya Maloko e bolela gore ke mang yo o amegang le karata: maloko a yone, badiri ba yone, yo o e dirileng, yo o kopileng tiro le yo o e abileng. Go Kopilwe ke le Go Abilwe ke di ka tshwara maloko a boto le gape kaelo ya mokwalo o o gololesegileng, sekao leina go tswa mo setlhatlhobing se sengwe.
help-card-members-how-it-works-descripti: Tobetsa koketso e e kgolokwe mo moleng go bula lenaane la maloko a boto mme o tlhophe batho; ba bontshiwa jaaka ditshwantsho kgotsa ditlhaka tsa ntlha, mme go tobetsa setshwantsho gape go ba tlosa. Ka fa tlase ga Go Kopilwe ke le Go Abilwe ke, kgolagano ya Oketsa ka fa tlase ga koketso e kwala mokwalo o o gololesegileng boemong jwa moo. Gore ke mela efe e e bonalang go tlhophiwa mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Karata.
help-card-fields-what-it-is-description: Karolo ya Karata e tshwara masimo a karata ka boyone a tiro, jaaka boikaego jwa yone, seemo sa go thibelwa, legoro la tirelo, dipalo tsa botlhokwa, palo ya yone ya thulaganyo le dikonopo tsa yone tsa karata. Karata e e buduleng e bontsha tshimo nngwe le nngwe e boto e e tlhophileng go e bontsha mo dikarateng, e se na sepe kgotsa nnyaa, e siametse go tlatswa.
help-card-fields-how-it-works-descriptio: Tlatsa kgotsa fetola tshimo ka tlhamalalo mo karolong eno. Se se bonalang fano, mo karolong efe le ka tatelano efe go swediwa mo botong yotlhe mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Karata, mo karolong ya Bontsha mo Karateng: tshwaya kgotsa tlosa letshwao mo moleng, kgotsa o o goge go o rulaganya gape. Karata e nnye e latela karolo ya Bontsha mo Karateng e Nnye ka tsela e e tshwanang.
help-card-time-what-it-is-description: Tlhatlhobo ya nako e kwala gore go dirisitswe diura di le kae mo karateng, le kakanyetso e e ikgethelwang, matshwao a Go ka duelelwa le a Nako e e fetang le lenaane la letsatsi ka letsatsi la gore mang o dirile lobaka lo lo kae. Palogotlhe e tsenya mo dipononeng tsa boto tsa nako, morwalo wa tiro le go duelela, mme ditšhupanako tsa Flowtime le Pomodoro fano di oketsa mo go yone.
help-card-time-how-it-works-description: Tobetsa letshwao la nako kgotsa lenaane la ditlhopho fa thoko ga Nako e e dirisitsweng go bula Fetola nako e e dirisitsweng, tsenya diura (dipalo tsa dintlha di letleletswe), fa o rata kakanyetso le matshwao, mme o Boloke. Ka fa tlase ga Nako ka letsatsi, tlhopha letlha, tsenya diura le kaelo mme o tobetse Kwala nako; o ka tlosa tsenyo ya gago go fitlha e amogelwa kgotsa e kwalelwa tefo. Letshwao le nna khibidu fa Nako e e fetang e tshwailwe.
help-card-custom-fields-what-it-is-descr: Masimo a a ikgethileng ke masimo a mangwe a boto ka boyone a dikarata tsa yone, fa thoko ga a a teng: phetolelo, tekanyetso ya madi, moreki, lebokose la go tshwaya kgotsa tlhopho go tswa mo lenaaneng. A tlhalosiwa gangwe fela mo botong, mme karata nngwe le nngwe morago e ka rwala boleng jwa yone.
help-card-custom-fields-how-it-works-des: Fano o tlhopha gore karata eno e dirisa masimo afe a a ikgethileng a boto mme o tlatse boleng jwa one. Masimo a masha a dirwa mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Karata, mo karolong ya Masimo a a ikgethileng, ka go tlhopha leina le mofuta jaaka Mokwalo, Palo, Letlha, Lenaane le le wang, Lebokose la go tshwaya kgotsa Madi. Tshimo e ka bontshiwa le mo karateng e nnye, mme masimo a dipalo a ka kopanngwa kwa godimo ga lenaane lengwe le lengwe.
help-card-planning-poker-what-it-is-desc: Poker ya Thulaganyo e letla setlhopha go akanyetsa karata mmogo. Mongwe le mongwe o tlhopha boleng go tswa mo dikarateng kwantle ga go bona ditlhopho tsa ba bangwe, mme fa go tlhopha go fela WeKan e bontsha gore mang o tlhophile eng le gore ke boleng bofe jo bo fentseng, ka jalo kakanyetso e dumalanwa ka yone boemong jwa go akanngwa ke motho a le mongwe.
help-card-planning-poker-how-it-works-de: Bula lenaane la ditlhopho la karolo, Fetola Poker ya Thulaganyo, fa o rata letla badirisi botlhe ba ba tsentseng mme o beye nako ya bofelo, mme o Boloke. Mongwe le mongwe yo o tlhophang o tobetsa boleng bo le bongwe; go tobetsa bo bongwe go fetola tlhopho. Motsamaisi wa boto o tobetsa Fetsa go bona diphitlhelelo, a kwala palo mme a tobetse Baya Kakanyetso. Simolola gape e phimola ditlhopho go dira kgato e ntšha.
help-card-scrum-what-it-is-description: Dipeakanyo tsa Scrum di tshwara lefelo la karata mo thulaganyong ya Scrum ya boto: sprint ya yone le disprint tse di fetileng, kgololo, mofuta wa bothata, dipeelo tsa kamogelo le maemo a tiro e e emeng. Karata e ka tshwaiwa gape jaaka Kgang kgotsa Tiro, tse dipono tsa sprint le tsa tiro e e emeng di di dirisang.
help-card-scrum-how-it-works-description: Bula Fetola ka fa tlase ga masimo go a fetola mme o Boloke; ke ba ba ka fetolang karata fela ba ba ka a fetolang. Lenaane la ditlhopho mo setlhogong sa karolo le tlhopha mofuta wa karata: ope, Kgang kgotsa Tiro. Disprint ka bo tsone di rulaganngwa, di simololwa mme di tswalwa mo dipononeng tsa Scrum tsa boto, mme gore ke masimo afe a a bontshiwang go beiwa mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Karata.
help-card-description-what-it-is-descrip: Tlhaloso ke mokwalo o mogolo wa karata: dintlha tsa tiro, dikaelo, dikgolagano kgotsa dikaelo tsa kopano tse di tsentsweng. E kwalwa ka Markdown, ka jalo e ka nna le ditlhogo, manaane, dikgolagano, ditshwantshonyana tsa maikutlo le ditshwantsho fa e ntse e nna mokwalo o o tlwaelegileng go fetolwa.
help-card-description-how-it-works-descr: Tobetsa tlhaloso go e fetola mo lebokoseng la mokwalo o o tlwaelegileng. Kwala letshwao la at le tshimologo ya leina go bona dikakantsho tsa maloko. Boloka, mme mokwalo o bontshiwa o bopilwe. Difaele tse di tsentsweng di nna mo karolong ya Tse di tshwaraganeng mme di ka umakiwa go tswa mo mokwalong.
help-card-checklists-what-it-is-descript: Lenaane la tlhatlhobo ke lenaane la dintlha mo karateng, nngwe le nngwe e tshwaiwa fa e feditswe, ya dikgato, dipeelo tsa kamogelo kgotsa tiro ya ka metlha. Karata e ka nna le a le mmalwa, mme karata e nnye e ka bontsha gore dintlha di le kae di feditswe.
help-card-checklists-how-it-works-descri: Oketsa lenaane la tlhatlhobo ka koketso ya lone, morago o oketse dintlha mme o di tshwaye fa di feditswe. Lenaane la ditlhopho la lenaane lengwe le lengwe la tlhatlhobo le na le ditiro tsa lone: go fetola dintlha tsotlhe ka nako e le nngwe jaaka mokwalo, go ntsha kgotsa go tsenya, go le sutisa kgotsa go le kopolola, go tshwaya kgotsa go tlosa matshwao mo dintlheng tsotlhe, go fitlha dintlha tse di tshwailweng, go baya go simolola gape ka bosona go go tlosang matshwao otlhe ka tsamaiso ya letsatsi le letsatsi, ya beke le beke kgotsa ya kgwedi le kgwedi, kgotsa go le phimola. Lenaane la tlhatlhobo le ka nna gape le letlha la lone la bofelo.
help-card-subtasks-what-it-is-descriptio: Ditiro-potlana di kgaoganya karata e kgolo go nna dikarata tse dinnye tse nngwe le nngwe e ka abelwang, ya beelwa nako mme ya sutisiwa e le nosi, fa karata eno ya motsadi e di bontsha mme e bala gore di le kae di feditswe. Tiro-potlana ke karata e e tlwaelegileng, e e bolokwang mo botong e e tlhophetsweng ditiro-potlana.
help-card-subtasks-how-it-works-descript: Tobetsa koketso, kwala setlhogo mme o Boloke go dira tiro-potlana; tshwaya Rua ditshwao tsa motsadi go kopolola ditshwao tsa karata eno mo go yone. Letshwao la kgolagano le oketsa karata e e leng teng jaaka tiro-potlana boemong jwa moo. Lenaane la ditlhopho la tiro-potlana nngwe le nngwe le na le E Bone, Ya kwa Botong mme, mo batsamaising ba boto, Phimola. Tobetsa setlhogo sa tiro-potlana go e naya leina le lesha.
help-card-attachments-what-it-is-descrip: Tse di tshwaraganeng ke difaele tse di bolokwang le karata: dikwalo, ditshwantsho, dibidio, dikwalo tsa tiragalo kgotsa dipolokelo. Setshwantsho se ka nna gape setshwantsho sa khabara se se bontshiwang mo karateng e nnye.
help-card-attachments-how-it-works-descr: Tobetsa koketso go oketsa difaele go tswa mo khomputareng ya gago, kgomaretsa kgotsa lahlela setshwantsho, tshwaraganya karata e nngwe, kgotsa thala setshwantsho se sesha. Moedi ope wa bogolo le mefuta ya difaele e e letleletsweng di bontshiwa ka fa tlase ga ditlhopho tseno. Tobetsa se se tshwaraganeng go se bula mo pontshong ya ditshwantsho, mme o dirise dikonopo fa thoko ga sone go se folosa, go se naya leina le lesha kgotsa go se phimola; lenaane la sone la ditlhopho le na le ditlhopho tsa setshwantsho sa khabara.
help-card-comments-what-it-is-descriptio: Dikakgelo ke puisano ya karata: dipotso, dikarabo, dintlha tse dintšha le ditshwetso, tse di bolokwang le tiro e di buang ka yone. Kakgelo e ka araba e e fetileng, mme karabo e bontshiwa ka fa tlase ga yone jaaka letlhoa.
help-card-comments-how-it-works-descript: Kwala mo tshimong ya kakgelo, o dirisa Markdown mme o umaka batho ka letshwao la at, mme o e romele. Tobetsa Araba fa thoko ga kakgelo go e araba; folaga ya Go araba e bontsha se o se arabang, mme go e tswala go dira kakgelo e e tlwaelegileng. O ka fetola kgotsa wa phimola dikakgelo tsa gago, mme mo dibotong dingwe ke mokwadi wa kakgelo fela yo o ka e fetolang.
help-card-stickers-what-it-is-descriptio: Dikgomaretsi ke matshwao a mannye a a bewang mo karateng, jaaka monwana o o kwa godimo, sesenyi, tšhupanako kgotsa sekgele, go e tshwaya ka bonako kwantle ga go dirisa letshwao kgotsa mmala. Di bontshiwa mo karateng e nnye le mo karateng e e buduleng.
help-card-stickers-how-it-works-descript: Tobetsa sekgomaretsi mo setlhophing go se oketsa mo karateng; letshwao la netefatso le bontsha gore se mo karateng, mme go se tobetsa gape go se tlosa. Mo karateng, sefapano se sennye fa thoko ga sekgomaretsi se se tlosa. Go oketsa le go tlosa go tlhoka tshwanelo ya go fetola karata.
help-card-locations-what-it-is-descripti: Karata e ka nna le mafelo a le mmalwa, mafelo a tiro e diragalang kwa go one, jaaka kantoro ya moreki, saete kgotsa lefelo la tiragalo. Lengwe le lengwe le na le leina, aterese mme, fa di itsiwe, dikhoordinete le kgolagano ya Bula mo mmapeng.
help-card-locations-how-it-works-descrip: Tlatsa leina la lefelo, aterese, latitude le longitude mme o tobetse Boloka. Go kgomaretsa kgolagano ya mmapa go letla lebokose go go batlela lefelo, ka jalo ga go na ope yo o tshwanetseng go kwala dikhoordinete. Go tobetsa lefelo mo karateng go le bula gape go le fetola kgotsa go le phimola, mme sefapano fa thoko ga lone se le tlosa ka bonako.
help-card-dependencies-what-it-is-descri: Boikaego bo golaganya karata eno le dikarata tse dingwe: e a di thibela, e thibelwa ke tsone, e a di baakanya, e a di kopolola kgotsa e amana le tsone. Fa boikaego bo tshubilwe mo Dipeakanyong tsa Leloko, bo thalwa jaaka mela ya metsu e e nang le mebala go kgabaganya boto, ka jalo tatelano ya tiro e bonala ka bonako.
help-card-dependencies-how-it-works-desc: Tlhopha mofuta wa kamano le mmala, morago o batle mme o tobetse karata e o batlang go golagana le yone. Kgolagano e bontshiwa mo Boikaegong jwa karata le jaaka mola mo botong. Tobetsa mola, kgotsa dirisa Boikaego jwa karata, go fetola mofuta wa jone, mmala kgotsa letshwao, kgotsa go bo tlosa. O ka goga gape setshwaro sa kgolagano sa karata e nnye go se isa mo karateng e nngwe.
help-card-action-items-what-it-is-descri: Dintlha tsa tiro di fetola mela ya se se tshwanetseng go dirwa ya dikaelo tsa kopano tse di tsentsweng go nna dikarata. Mela e e jaaka TODO: Beeletsa lefelo, mola wa tiro o o sa tshwaiwang, kgotsa mola o o simololang ka go umaka di bonwa ka sebopego sa tsone, kwantle ga AI.
help-card-action-items-how-it-works-desc: Lebokose le bontsha dikarata tse di tla dirwang, nngwe le nngwe le letshwao la netefatso le leloko le go umaka go supang kwa go lone. Tlosa letshwao mo go se o sa se batleng mme o tobetse Dira. Dikarata tse dintšha di ya mo lenaaneng le le tshwanang le karata eno mme di golagana le yone. Go umaka go nna leloko fela fa motho yoo e le leloko le le dirang la boto.
help-card-history-what-it-is-description: Hisitori ke lenaane la phetogo nngwe le nngwe e e dirilweng mo karateng eno: gore mang o fetotse eng, leng, le go tswa mo boleng bofe go ya mo bofe. Phetogo nngwe le nngwe e ka tlhophiwa mme ya busediwa, ka jalo phoso e ka phimolwa le morago.
help-card-history-how-it-works-descripti: Kwala mo Batla go fokotsa mela, kgotsa tobetsa setshwantsho sa motho go bona diphetogo tsa gagwe fela. Tsamaya ka ditsebe ka metsu. Tshwaya mola o le mongwe kgotsa go feta mme o tobetse Busetsa; mela e le mmalwa e busediwa e e tsofetseng pele jaaka phetogo e le nngwe, e le yone e ka phimolwang. Ctrl+Z le Ctrl+Y di phimola gape le go dira gape phetogo ya gago ya bofelo.
help-card-qr-code-what-it-is-description: Khoutu ya QR e bontsha kgolagano ya karata eno jaaka khoutu e o ka e sekenang, go bula karata mo mogaleng kgotsa thebolete kwantle ga go kwala aterese ya yone. Ga e fetole sepe mo karateng.
help-card-qr-code-how-it-works-descripti: Supa khamera ya mogala kwa khoutung mme o bule kgolagano; aterese e bontshiwa gape jaaka mokwalo ka fa tlase ga yone. Khoutu e thalwa mo sebatling sa gago mme ga go sepe se se romelwang gope. Mongwe le mongwe yo o e sekenang o sa ntse a tshwanetse go tsena mme a nne le tetla ya boto. Kgolagano e e leele thata go nna khoutu ya QR e begwa boemong jwa moo.
help-card-move-what-it-is-description: Sutisa Karata e sutisetsa karata kwa lefelong le lengwe mo botong eno kgotsa kwa botong e nngwe. E dira se go goga go se dirang, gape kwa go goga go sa kgoneng go fitlha teng, jaaka boto e nngwe kgotsa lefelo le le tlhomameng mo lenaaneng le leleele.
help-card-move-how-it-works-description: Tlhopha boto, tsela le lenaane, morago karata le gore a o ya kwa godimo kgotsa kwa tlase ga yone. O ka fetola setlhogo, wa kwala lebaka la go sutisa le le ikgethelwang, mme wa tshwaya Tlogela kgolagano kwa lefelong la ntlha go boloka karata e e golaganeng kwa e neng e le teng. Tobetsa Go Dirilwe fa lefelo la go ya le setse le tsentswe. Shift+M e bula lebokose leno le yone, mme lefelo la go ya le gopolwa ka boto.
help-card-copy-what-it-is-description: Kopolola Karata e dira kopi e ntšha, e e ikemetseng ya karata mo botong eno kgotsa e nngwe, e na le palo ya yone le dikopi tsa yone tsa dikakgelo, manaane a tlhatlhobo, tse di tshwaraganeng le ditiro-potlana.
help-card-copy-how-it-works-description: Fetola setlhogo fa o rata; setlhogo se se se nang sepe ga se kopolole sepe. Tlhopha boto, tsela le lenaane, morago karata le gore a kopi e ya kwa godimo kgotsa kwa tlase ga yone, mme o tobetse Go Dirilwe. Fa kopi e ganwa, lebaka le bontshiwa fano. Shift+C e bula lebokose leno le yone, mme lefelo la go ya le gopolwa ka boto.
help-card-recurrence-what-it-is-descript: Go boelela ga karata go dira gore WeKan e dire kopi e ntšha ya karata eno mo lenaaneng le le tshwanang ka tsamaiso, ya tiro e e boelelang jaaka pego ya seemo ya beke le beke kgotsa inboise ya kgwedi le kgwedi e e neng e tla dirwa gape ka seatla.
help-card-recurrence-how-it-works-descri: Tlhopha Letsatsi le letsatsi, Beke le beke kgotsa Kgwedi le kgwedi, kgotsa Go timilwe go go emisa; Go timilwe ke tlwaelo. Sefatlhego sa tirelo morago se dira dikopi ka bosona, kwantle ga thulaganyo epe e nngwe. Go isa karata kwa polokelong go e emisa gape go dira dikopi tse dingwe, le fa paka e sa ntse e beilwe.
help-card-copy-many-what-it-is-descripti: Kopolola Sekao go Dikarata Tse Dintsi e dira dikopi di le mmalwa tsa karata eno ka nako e le nngwe. Karata e dira jaaka sekao: manaane a yone a tlhatlhobo, tse di tshwaraganeng, ditshwao le masimo a mangwe di ya mo koping nngwe le nngwe, mme ke setlhogo le tlhaloso fela tse di farologanang.
help-card-copy-many-how-it-works-descrip: Mo lebokoseng la mokwalo, kwala tsenyo e le nngwe ka karata nngwe le setlhogo le tlhaloso ya yone, o latela sekao se se setseng se tladitswe. Tlhopha boto, tsela, lenaane le lefelo fa thoko ga karata, morago o tobetse Go Dirilwe. Fa mokwalo o se mo sebopegong se se siameng, ga go sepe se se dirwang mme phoso e bontshiwa fano.
help-card-color-what-it-is-description: Baya mmala e naya karata mmala wa yone wa bokamorago gore e bonale sentle mo botong, sekao khibidu ya tiro e e potlakileng kgotsa mmala wa moreki ka esi. Mokwalo wa karata o dirwa gore o balege mo mmaleng ka bosona.
help-card-color-how-it-works-description: Tobetsa mongwe wa mebala e e nang le maina, mmala o o ikgethileng o o setseng o dirisiwa mo botong eno, kgotsa tlhopha mmala ope ka fa tlase ga Mmala o o ikgethileng, morago o tobetse Boloka. Tlosa e tlosa mmala. Mmala o bontshiwa mo karateng e nnye le mo karateng e e buduleng, fa e se fa o timilwe mo Dipeakanyong tsa Boto / Karata.
help-card-drawing-what-it-is-description: Go thala go go letla go thala kgotsa go kwala ka seatla mo karateng ka mouse, monwana kgotsa pene: setshwantsho se se thadilweng ka bonako, setshwantsho sa tlhaloso, monwana wa go saena kgotsa kaelo e e kwadilweng ka seatla. Setshwantsho se nna se ka fetolwa mme setshwantsho sa sone se bolokwa gape jaaka se se tshwaraganeng le karata.
help-card-drawing-how-it-works-descripti: Tlhopha mmala le bophara jwa mola mme o thale. Boela morago e boela kgato kwa morago, Phimolo e tlosa mela e e e amang mme Phepafatsa e tlosa yotlhe. Boloka e boloka mela mo karateng mme e boloka setshwantsho jaaka se se tshwaraganeng; setshwantsho se sesha se nna setshwantsho sa khabara sa karata. Ditshwantsho tse di bolokilweng di bontshiwa fano go bulwa le go fetolwa gape, mme Folosa jaaka SVG e boloka nngwe jaaka faele.
help-card-more-what-it-is-description: Go Feta e bontsha kgolagano ya karata, dikarata tsa yone tsa batsadi le gore e dirilwe leng. Ke kwa karata e dirwang tiro-potlana ya karata e nngwe teng, le kwa motsamaisi wa boto a phimolang karata ka gale teng.
help-card-more-how-it-works-description: Kopolola kgolagano ya karata go ya kwa lebokoseng la dikopi e kopolola aterese ya karata. Ka fa tlase ga Fetola motsadi wa karata, tlhopha boto ya motswedi le karata ya motsadi, kgotsa ope go e dira karata ya maemo a a kwa godimo gape; Oketsa karata e nngwe ya motsadi e oketsa batsadi ba bangwe, mme sefapano fa thoko ga mongwe se mo tlosa. Phimola, ya batsamaisi ba boto fela, e tlosa karata ka gale morago ga netefatso.
help-card-create-board-what-it-is-descri: Dira boto go tswa mo karateng eno e fetola karata go nna kgolagano ya boto e ntšha. Ke ya karata e e goletseng go nna porojeke ya yone: tiro e ya kwa botong ya yone, mme karata e nna kwa e neng e le teng jaaka tsela ya go tsena mo go yone.
help-card-create-board-how-it-works-desc: Leina la boto e ntšha le tladitswe ka setlhogo sa karata; le fetole fa o rata mme o tobetse Dira boto go tswa mo karateng eno. Boto e dirwa o le motsamaisi wa yone, mme karata morago e bula boto eo. Ga go sepe se sengwe se se fetogang mo karateng. Fa go ganwa, lebaka le bontshiwa mme ga go sepe se se fetogang.
help-card-link-to-board-what-it-is-descr: Golaganya le boto e baya karata e e golaganeng ya karata eno mo botong e nngwe e e leng teng. Karata morago e bonala mo dibotong tse pedi: ya ntlha e nna kwa e leng teng, mme kgolagano e bontsha diteng tsa yone kwa o e beileng teng.
help-card-link-to-board-how-it-works-des: Tlhopha boto, tsela le lenaane, morago karata le gore a kgolagano e ya kwa godimo kgotsa kwa tlase ga yone, mme o tobetse Go Dirilwe. Mo lenaaneng le le se nang sepe kgolagano e ya kwa tlase. Karata ya ntlha ga e fetolwe, mme ditshwao ga di kopololwe. Lefelo la go ya le gopolwa ka boto.
help-card-actions-what-it-is-description: Lenaane la ditlhopho la karata, Ditiro tsa Karata, le kokoanya sengwe le sengwe se o ka se dirang ka karata yotlhe, boemong jwa ka nngwe ya masimo a yone. Gore ke ditsenyo dife tse di bonalang go ikaegile ka seabe sa gago mo botong.
help-card-actions-how-it-works-descripti: Sutisa le kopolola e na le Sutisa Karata, Kopolola Karata, Boloka jaaka Sekao, Kopolola Sekao go Dikarata Tse Dintsi, Go boelela ga karata le go sutisetsa kwa godimo kgotsa kwa tlase ga lenaane. Morago go tla Lebelela le Naledi, le Ponalo e e nang le Baya mmala, Go thala le Dira dikarata go tswa mo dintlheng tsa tiro. Abelana e na le kgolagano ya karata, Golaganya le boto, khoutu ya QR le Hisitori, morago Ntsha le Tsenya mo teng. Polokelo e na le Isa karata kwa polokelong, Go Feta le Dira boto go tswa mo karateng eno.
help-admin-version-what-it-is-descriptio: Karolo ya Phetolelo e bontsha se WeKan eno e se dirisang: phetolelo ya WeKan le ka moo e tsentsweng ka teng, thulaganyo ya tsamaiso, Meteor, polokelo ya data le Node.js. Ke karolo ya ntlha ya Phanele ya motsamaisi / Dipeakanyo mme ke tshedimosetso e o tshwanetseng go e kopolola mo pegong ya phoso fa o kopa thuso.
help-admin-version-how-it-works-descript: Bala tafole, e e kopantsweng go nna Polatefomo, OS, Meteor, Polokelo ya data le Node. Tobetsa Tlhatlhoba Phetolelo go bapisa le diphetolelo tse dintšha tse di gololetsweng tsa WeKan, FerretDB, Meteor, Node le NPM; fa e ntse e dira e bolela gore e a tsenya, mme fa tlhatlhobo e palelwa o bona molaetsa o le mongwe wa go palelwa boemong jwa moo.
help-admin-appearance-what-it-is-descrip: Ponalo e swetsa gore WeKan eno e lebega jang le gore Diboto Tsotlhe di bontsha eng: dikarolo tse di fitlhilweng jaaka diboto tsa botlhe kgotsa ditiragalo tsa boto, gore ke mang yo o ka dirang diboto, sebopego sa letlha, gore dintlha tsa karata di bulega ka bophara bo bo kae, diaterese tsa dikgolagano, kgolagano e e itirang ya setlhatlhobi sa mathata sa kwa ntle, leina la setlhagiswa, mebala le matshwao a kgwebo.
help-admin-appearance-how-it-works-descr: Fetola masimo a setlhopha se le sengwe mme o tobetse Boloka ya setlhopha seo, e e bolokang setlhopha seo fela. Matshwao ka fa tlase ga Diboto Tsotlhe: Fitlha a kaya gore selo se fitlhilwe, kwantle ga diboto tse modirisi mongwe le mongwe yo o tsentseng a ka di fetolang, tse di tshwailweng fa di letleletswe. Fetola mmala e boloka kwantle ga konopo ya Boloka mme ke setlhopha fela se motsamaisi wa mokgatlho ka bolone a se bonang.
help-admin-features-what-it-is-descripti: Ditirelo ke kwa motsamaisi wa saete a tshubang kgotsa a timang dikarolo tse di ikgethelwang tsa WeKan mo tirisong yotlhe: dipono tsa boto, dithuso, didirisiwa tsa Kanban le Scrum, masimo a karata, Morwalo wa tiro le bokgoni, Tekanyetso ya madi le go duelela, SQRL, ActivityPub, Melao ya go bala fela le di-API tse di tsamaisanang tse di ikgethelwang. Ditsela le manaane di nna di le teng ka metlha.
help-admin-features-how-it-works-descrip: Tlosa letshwao mo go se WeKan eno e sa tshwanelang go se neela, go akaretsa masimo a karata a boto epe e sa tshwanelang go a bontsha, mme o tobetse Boloka. Tirelo e e sa tshwaiwang e nyelela mo sebopegong sa mongwe le mongwe mme sefatlhego sa tirelo se e gana le sone, mme data ya yone e a bolokwa. O ka tlhoka tetla ya ditirelo tse ntšhwafatso ya WeKan e di okeditseng, mme wa bitsa badirisi ba teko ba ba sa ntseng ba bona ditirelo tse di timilweng.
help-admin-feature-profiles-what-it-is-d: Porofaele ya ditirelo e naya badirisi, ditlhopha kgotsa mekgatlho e e tlhophilweng WeKan e nnye ka go ba fitlhela ditirelo dingwe tse di ikgethelwang, fa botlhe ba bangwe ba sa ntse ba bona sengwe le sengwe. E ka fitlha ditirelo tse di tshwanang tse karolo ya Ditirelo e ka di timang.
help-admin-feature-profiles-how-it-works: Tobetsa Oketsa porofaele, e neye leina, tshwaya ditirelo tse e di fitlhang mme o kwale badirisi, ditlhopha le mekgatlho ya yone, morago o tobetse Boloka ya karolo. Maina a a sa tshwanang le ope a begwa morago ga go boloka mme ga a bolokwe. Diporofaele di lekwa ka tatelano ya tsebe, mme lenaane la ditlhopho la leloko la modirisi le ba bolelela gore ke porofaele efe e e fitlhang ditirelo di le kae.
help-admin-security-what-it-is-descripti: Tshireletso e tshwara dikonopo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo sotlhe tsa se mokwalo o o humileng o ka se dirang le se se ka tsenngwang kgotsa sa ntshiwa. Di dirise go emisa dikgolagano tse di tobetsegang, go bontsha mokwalo otlhe o o bopilweng jaaka motswedi o o tlwaelegileng, go thibela go tsenya kgotsa go ntsha, go lekanyetsa bogolo jwa go tsenya, go tlogela ditshwantsho tsa badirisi, kgotsa go emisetsa boitshupo jwa mmatota jwa badirisi ka maina a a sa itsiweng.
help-admin-security-how-it-works-descrip: Tshwaya konopo mme e bolokwa ka bonako; bogolo jo bogolo jwa go tsenya bo bolokwa fa o tlogela tshimo, mme boleng jo bo se nang sepe bo kaya gore ga go na moedi. Konopo nngwe le nngwe e timilwe ka tlwaelo mme e diragadiwa ke sefatlhego sa tirelo, ka jalo go tsenya kgotsa go ntsha go go timilweng go a ganwa le fa mongwe a go bitsa ka tlhamalalo.
help-admin-activities-what-it-is-descrip: Dikonopo tse tharo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo sotlhe tsa disaete tse di tshwanetseng go lekanyetsa go latelwa ga ditiragalo: go emisa go kwala gore mang o dirile eng, go emisa go romela dikitsiso ka ditiragalo, kgotsa go thibela badirisi go lebelela diboto, manaane le dikarata.
help-admin-activities-how-it-works-descr: Tshwaya konopo mme e bolokwa ka bonako. Fa ditiragalo di timilwe, ga go sepe se sesha se se kwalwang mme ditsenyo tse di leng teng ga di tlhole di bontshiwa. Fa dikitsiso di timilwe, ga go romelwe dikitsiso tsa mo tirisong, tsa imeile kgotsa tse dingwe. Fa go lebelela go timilwe, ga go na ope yo o ka fetolang seemo sa go lebelela. Tlosa letshwao go go tshuba gape; ditiragalo tse di sa kwalwang ka nako eo ga di boe.
help-admin-delete-what-it-is-description: Go phimola mo WeKan ka tlwaelo go tshwaya fela manaane, dikarata le tse di tshwaraganeng di phimotswe gore di ka busediwa. Karolo eno e tshwara konopo e le nngwe e e letlang motsamaisi wa saete go senya diteng tse di ntseng jalo ka gale.
help-admin-delete-how-it-works-descripti: Tshwaya Tshuba go phimola ka gale ga Motsamaisi wa Lefatshe; e bolokwa ka bonako mme ga e phimole sepe ka boyone. Matshwao a go phimola morago a bonala kwa go phimola ka gale go neelwang teng, jaaka lenaane mo lebokoseng la matlakala kgotsa boto e e mo polokelong mo polokelong ya Diboto Tsotlhe. Phetogo nngwe le nngwe ya peakanyo le teko nngwe le nngwe ya go phimola ka gale di kwalwa mo Tsosoloso. Tlosa letshwao fa o feditse.
help-admin-announcement-what-it-is-descr: Folaga ya saete yotlhe ya go bolelela modirisi mongwe le mongwe yo o tsentseng sengwe ka nako e le nngwe, jaaka go emisa go baakanya, aterese e ntšha kgotsa phetogo ya molawana. E farologane le kitsiso ya boto ka boyone.
help-admin-announcement-how-it-works-des: Tshwaya Kitsiso e e Dirang ya Thulaganyo Yotlhe, kwala molaetsa mme o tobetse Boloka. Folaga e bonala kwa godimo ga Legae, Diboto Tsotlhe le diboto tse badirisi e leng maloko a tsone. Modirisi a ka e tswala, mme e nna e tswetswe mo go ene go fitlha o fetola mokwalo. Tlosa letshwao mo lebokoseng go e tlosa mo go botlhe.
help-admin-accessibility-what-it-is-desc: Tsebe ya phitlhelelo ke kwa WeKan eno e bolelelang badirisi ba yone gore e fitlhelelega go le kae le gore ba ikgolaganye le mang ka kgoreletso. Karolo eno e tshuba tsebe eo mme e baya setlhogo le diteng tsa yone.
help-admin-accessibility-how-it-works-de: Tshwaya Tsebe ya phitlhelelo e tshubilwe, e e bolokwang ka bonako, morago o kwale setlhogo le diteng mme o tobetse Boloka. Diteng di bopiwa jaaka tlhaloso ya karata. Maloko a boto morago a bona kgolagano ya Phitlhelelo mo lethakoreng la moja la boto. Tlosa letshwao go fitlha kgolagano gape.
help-admin-translation-what-it-is-descri: Mafoko a phetolelo a a ikgethileng a feta mekwalo e e agetsweng mo teng ya WeKan mo tirisong eno, ka puo, sekao go dirisa lefoko la mokgatlho wa gago ka bowone la boto kgotsa go baakanya lefoko pele phetolelo e e baakantsweng e goroga.
help-admin-translation-how-it-works-desc: Tobetsa E ntšha, tlhopha puo, tsenya senotlolo sa lefoko le o batlang go le emisetsa (e seng polelo ya Seesemane) le mokwalo o o tshwanetseng go bontshiwa boemong jwa moo, morago Boloka. Ke mokwalo wa phetolelo fela wa mola o o leng teng o o ka fetolwang, mme mola o ka phimolwa go tswa mo lenaaneng la one la ditlhopho. Diphetolelo tseno di dira mo mokwalong o sefatlhego sa tirelo se o dirang, jaaka diimeile; mo sebatling di bontshiwa batsamaisi ba saete fela gone jaanong.
help-admin-pwa-what-it-is-description: Karolo ya PWA e laola se dibatli le megala di se balang ka WeKan ka boyone: matshwao a mangwe a meta le a dikgolagano mo tsebeng nngwe le nngwe, manifesto ya webo e e dirisiwang fa WeKan e tsenngwa jaaka tiriso, le faele ya dikgolagano tsa tiriso ya Android e e letlang tiriso ya Android go bula dikgolagano tsa WeKan.
help-admin-pwa-how-it-works-description: Tshwaya karolo e o batlang go e fetola, e e bolokwang ka bonako, kgomaretsa matshwao a gago kgotsa JSON mme o tobetse Boloka. JSON e e sa siamang e a ganwa mme ga go sepe se se bolokwang. Matshwao a meta a okediwa fela jaaka dikarolo tsa meta, ka jalo dikwalo tsa taolo, ditaelo tsa ponalo le matshwao a a ntšhwafatsang tsebe a a tlosiwa. Fa konopo e timilwe, WeKan e dirisa ditlwaelo tsa yone tse di agetsweng mo teng.
help-admin-global-webhooks-what-it-is-de: Diwebhuku tsa lefatshe di romela molaetsa kwa atereseng e nngwe, jaaka puisano kgotsa sefatlhego sa tirelo sa go itirela, nako nngwe le nngwe fa sengwe se diragala mo botong epe ya WeKan eno. Di dirisa foromo e e tshwanang le diwebhuku tsa boto ka boyone. Karolo e bontsha gape mafelo a ka fa gare a diwebhuku di ka a fitlhelelang le webhuku ya go tsena le ya go ikwadisa.
help-admin-global-webhooks-how-it-works-: Tlatsa foromo e e se nang sepe ka leina, aterese, thokene e e ikgethelwang le mofuta, wa tsela e le nngwe kgotsa wa ditsela tse pedi, mme o tobetse Dira. Mo webhukung e e bolokilweng o ka e tima, wa tlhopha gore e romela ditiragalo dife le gore e di romela jang, morago Boloka. Kwala mafelo a a mo neteweking ya WeKan ka boyone ka fa tlase ga Mafelo a ka fa gare a go ya, nngwe ka mola, gore diwebhuku di letlelelwe go a fitlhelela.
help-admin-shared-labels-what-it-is-desc: Ditshwao tse di abelanwang di naya letshwao leina le le lengwe le mmala o le mongwe mo dibotong di le dintsi ka nako e le nngwe: mo botong nngwe le nngwe, mo dibotong tsa mokgatlho, kgotsa mo dibotong tsa setlhopha. Di dirise mo ditshwaong tse di jaaka Potlako kgotsa Moreki tse di tshwanetseng go lebega di tshwana gongwe le gongwe.
help-admin-shared-labels-how-it-works-de: Oketsa letshwao mo moleng wa bofelo ka leina, mmala le lenaane, morago o tobetse Oketsa letshwao le le abelanwang; mola mongwe le mongwe o a ipoloka kgotsa o a iphimola. Mo ditshwaong tsa karata, maloko a boto a bona ditshwao tse di abelanwang tse boto ya bone e ka di dirisang mme ba tobetsa lengwe go le oketsa. Go fetola leina kgotsa mmala fano go o fetola mo botong nngwe le nngwe, mme go le phimola go le tlogela mo dibotong tseo jaaka letshwao la tsone ka bo tsone.
help-admin-email-what-it-is-description: Karolo ya Imeile e baya ka moo WeKan e romelang makwalo ka teng, kgotsa ka dipeakanyo tsa imeile tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo ka bosone kgotsa ka motlamedi yo o baakantsweng fano, mme e tshwara dipeakanyo tse di amanang: gore ke lefelo lefe la imeile le le ka laletsang batho fa go ikwadisa ka bowena go timilwe, gore a badirisi ba ka fetola aterese ya bone, gore go dirwe eng ka makwalo a a boang, le disekao tsa imeile ya taletso le ya ditiragalo.
help-admin-email-how-it-works-descriptio: Tshwaya Tshuba ka fa tlase ga dipeakanyo tsa imeile, tlhopha SMTP kgotsa motlamedi yo o agetsweng mo teng, tlatsa leina la modirisi, lefoko la sephiri le aterese ya moromedi mme o tobetse Boloka; lefoko la sephiri le le bolokilweng le a bolokwa fa tshimo e tlogelwa e se na sepe. Romela imeile ya teko kwa go wena go tlhatlhoba gore e a dira. Kwantle ga letshwao, dipeakanyo tsa imeile tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo ka bosone di nna di dirisiwa. Masimo a disekao a a se nang sepe a boloka diimeile tse di agetsweng mo teng.
help-admin-notifications-what-it-is-desc: Tlwaelo ya saete yotlhe ya dikitsiso: gore a lebokose la dikitsiso la mo tirisong le imeile di tshubilwe kgotsa di timilwe mo go botlhe, le gore imeile, lebokose le diwebhuku tse di tswang di romela jang ka tlwaelo. Dipeakanyo tsa boto le dipeakanyo tsa leloko lengwe le lengwe ka bolone di ka e feta mo lefelong la tsone.
help-admin-notifications-how-it-works-de: Tlhopha Ee kgotsa Nnyaa mo Lebokoseng la dikitsiso le mo Imeileng; tlhopho e bolokwa ka bonako. Bula kanale go baya thulaganyo ya yone, se e se bontshang, gore dikitsiso di kopanngwa jang le gore di romelwa leng, nngwe le nngwe e bolokwa ka bonako. Batsamaisi ba boto le maloko ba ka tlhopha Tlwaelo go boela kwa go se o se beileng fano. Dipeakanyo tsa imeile go ya karateng di mo karolong e e tshwanang.
help-admin-domains-what-it-is-descriptio: Mafelo a imeile a bontsha lefelo lengwe le lengwe la imeile le le dirisiwang ke diakhaonto mo WeKan eno, le gore lengwe le lengwe le na le badirisi ba le kae. Ke tsela e e bonako ya go bona gore ke mekgatlho efe e e mo tirisong eno le go lemoga lefelo le le sa solofelwang kwantle ga go bala lenaane lotlhe la badirisi.
help-admin-domains-how-it-works-descript: Bala tafole, mola o le mongwe ka lefelo le palo ya lone ya badirisi. Kwala karolo ya lefelo mo lebokoseng la go batla mme o tobetse Enter go le bona, mme o tsamaye magareng ga ditsebe ka dikonopo tsa pele le tsa morago. Ga go sepe se se bolokwang; tafole e balwa sešwa nako nngwe le nngwe fa e bontshiwa.
help-admin-organizations-what-it-is-desc: Mekgatlho e kopanya badirisi ka khampani, lefapha kgotsa moreki gore diboto le diboto tsa disekao di abelanwe le bone botlhe, maloko a bone a ka tsamaisanngwa le tshupetso jaaka LDAP, mme, ka badiri ba bantsi, mokgatlho o ka nna le mafelo a imeile a one, matshwao a kgwebo le batsamaisi.
help-admin-organizations-how-it-works-de: Tobetsa E ntšha mo setlhogong sa kholomo ya ntlha go dira o le mongwe, Fetola go fetola mola, mme lenaane la ditlhopho la mola go o phimola kgotsa go tlhoma batsamaisi ba mokgatlho. Dikonopo tsa mola tsa disekao tse di abelanwang, go oketsa maloko mo dibotong le go tsamaisana ga maloko go tswa mo motlameding wa go tsena di bolokwa ka bonako. Tshwaya Oketsa maloko a boto go tswa mo Mokgatlhong o o tshwanang fela go lekanyetsa gore ke mang yo o ka okediwang mo dibotong.
help-admin-teams-what-it-is-description: Ditlhopha di kopanya badirisi ba ba dirang mmogo gore boto kgotsa diboto tsa disekao di abelanwe le setlhopha sotlhe, maloko a ka tsamaisanngwa le tshupetso jaaka LDAP, mme lenaane la Batho le ka fokodiwa go nna setlhopha se le sengwe. Di dira jaaka mekgatlho kwantle ga karolo ya mohiri.
help-admin-teams-how-it-works-descriptio: Tobetsa E ntšha mo setlhogong sa kholomo ya ntlha go dira setlhopha, Fetola go se fetola, kgotsa lenaane la ditlhopho la mola go se phimola. Dikonopo tsa mola di bolokwa ka bonako. Go tsenya batho mo ditlhopheng, ba tshwaye mo Phaneleng ya motsamaisi / Batho / Batho mme o tobetse Ditlhopha. Tshwaya Oketsa maloko a boto go tswa mo Setlhopheng se se tshwanang fela go lekanyetsa gore ke mang yo o ka okediwang mo dibotong.
help-admin-people-what-it-is-description: Batho e bontsha akhaonto nngwe le nngwe mo WeKan eno le imeile ya yone, seemo sa motsamaisi, porofaele ya ditirelo, seemo sa go dira, dinaga tsa go tsena, seemo sa loko, tiragalo ya bofelo le letlha la go dirwa. Ke kwa o dirang, o fetolang, o timang, o bulang, o itirang jaaka, o fitlhang boitshupo le o phimolang diakhaonto teng.
help-admin-people-how-it-works-descripti: Batla ka leina la modirisi, leina kgotsa imeile mme o tobetse Enter, mme o fokotse ka Bontsha le Setlhopha. Tobetsa E ntšha go dira modirisi mme Fetola go fetola mongwe. Tobetsa letshwao la go dira go tima kgotsa go tshuba, mme loko e khibidu kgotsa Bula Tsotlhe go bula. Lenaane la ditlhopho la mola le na le go itira jaaka, go fitlha boitshupo le go phimola; tshwaya batho ba le mmalwa mme o tobetse Ditlhopha go fetola ditlhopha tsa bone.
help-admin-locked-users-what-it-is-descr: Tshireletso kgatlhanong le go leka ka dikgoka e lotlela akhaonto morago ga go palelwa go tsena go go fetang selekanyo. Karolo eno e baya gore go palelwa go le kae go simolola go lotlelwa, gore go nna lobaka lo lo kae le paka ya nako e go palelwa go balwang mo go yone, ka go farologana mo maineng a badirisi a a leng teng le mo maineng a badirisi a a seyong.
help-admin-locked-users-how-it-works-des: Tlatsa go palelwa, paka ya go lotlelwa le paka ya nako, ka metsotswana, ya badirisi ba ba itsiweng le ba ba sa itsiweng mme o tobetse Boloka; boleng jo bosha bo dira ka bonako kwantle ga go simolola gape. Go bona le go golola diakhaonto tse di lotletsweng, bula Phanele ya motsamaisi / Batho / Batho, tlhopha Badirisi ba ba Lotletsweng Fela mme o tobetse loko e khibidu, kgotsa Bula Tsotlhe.
help-admin-audit-log-what-it-is-descript: Kwalo ya tlhatlhobo ke motlhala wa se batsamaisi ba saete ba se dirileng, se sesha pele: leng, mang, tiro efe, gore a e atlegile, dintlha tsa yone le aterese e e tswang kwa go yone. E araba gore mang o fetotse sengwe le gore leng mo dipeakanyong tsa batho, go tsena, polokelo le polokelo ya tshireletso.
help-admin-audit-log-how-it-works-descri: Bala tafole ya Leng, Motsamaisi, Tiro, Dintlha le IP; tiro e e gannweng e tshwailwe ka phoso ya yone. Kwala mo lebokoseng la go batla go fokotsa mela ka motsamaisi, tiro kgotsa dintlha, mme o dirise metsu ka fa tlase ga tafole go tsamaya magareng ga ditsebe.
help-admin-roles-what-it-is-description: Diseabe di swetsa gore ke diseabe dife tsa boto tse di ka laletsang batho mo botong, di go letla go aga diseabe tse di ikgethileng go tswa mo go se leloko la boto le ka se dirang, mme di bontsha se seabe sengwe le sengwe se ka se dirang. Batsamaisi ba saete ka metlha ba na le ditshwanelo tsotlhe.
help-admin-roles-how-it-works-descriptio: Ka fa tlase ga Letla go Laletsa mo Botong, tshwaya diseabe tse di ka laletsang mme o tobetse Boloka. Ka fa tlase ga Diseabe tse di ikgethileng, kwala leina, tshwaya se seabe se ka se dirang mme o tobetse Oketsa seabe; mola mongwe le mongwe o a ipoloka kgotsa o a iphimola, mme batsamaisi ba boto morago ba ka naya maloko seabe seo. Tafole ya Seemo sa Diseabe e bontsha phitlhelelo ya matshwao a gago, le pele o boloka.
help-admin-shared-templates-what-it-is-d: Disekao tse di abelanwang di go letla go lebelela diboto tsa disekao tsa badirisi tse di ka abelanwang ka mokgatlho, setlhopha kgotsa lefelo la imeile. Matshwao a swetsa gape gore boto ya sekao e ka abelanwa le mefuta efe ya ditlhopha go tswa mo Diboto Tsotlhe / Disekao.
help-admin-shared-templates-how-it-works: Tshwaya Mekgatlho, Ditlhopha kgotsa Mafelo a imeile; letshwao lengwe le lengwe le bolokwa ka bonako mo tirisong yotlhe. Ka fa tlase ga lefelo lengwe le lengwe le le tshwailweng o bona setlhopha sengwe le sengwe, badirisi ba sone le diboto tsa bone tsa disekao, mme go tobetsa boto ya sekao go e bula. Gore a disekao tsa setlhopha se le sengwe di fitlha maloko a sone go beiwa ka mokgatlho le ka setlhopha mo dikarolong tsa tsone.
help-admin-login-what-it-is-description: Go tsena go swetsa se se letleletsweng fa o tsena, jaaka go lebala lefoko la sephiri, go ikwadisa ka bowena, go fetola leina la modirisi, go phimola akhaonto ya gago le setlhophi sa mekgwa. Go go letla gape go feta dipeakanyo tsa go tsena tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo kwantle ga go simolola gape, sekao go tsena ka lefoko la sephiri, mokgwa wa tlwaelo, boleele jwa kopano, go tswa ka bosona, melao ya lefoko la sephiri le netefatso ya dikgato tse pedi e e patelediwang.
help-admin-login-how-it-works-descriptio: Tshwaya kgotsa tlosa letshwao mo mabokoseng a Go tsena: Letla; lengwe le lengwe le bolokwa fa o tobetsa. Fa go ikwadisa ka bowena go timilwe, dirisa Laletsa Batho go laletsa diaterese mo dibotong tse di tlhophilweng. Mo foromong ya dipeakanyo tshimo nngwe le nngwe e bolela gore ke boleng bofe jo bo dirang; kwala kgotsa tlhopha boleng mme o boloke, kgotsa o bo tlogele bo se na sepe kgotsa o tlhophe Tlwaelo go boela kwa dipeakanyong tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo. Mokgwa mongwe le mongwe wa go tsena o na le karolo ya one mo lenaaneng la ditlhopho la Batho.
help-admin-saml-what-it-is-description: Go tsena ka SAML go letla batho go tsena ka motlamedi wa boitshupo wa mokgatlho wa gago boemong jwa lefoko la sephiri la WeKan. Motlamedi o netefatsa gore ke bomang ka molaetsa o o saennweng mme WeKan e ba tsenya, e dira akhaonto fa ba tsena la ntlha.
help-admin-saml-how-it-works-description: Tsenya aterese ya go tsena ya motlamedi wa boitshupo le setifikeiti sa go saena, leina la morulaganyi la WeKan eno le ditlhopho tse dingwe mo karolong eno, kgotsa mo dipeakanyong tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo; boleng jo bo bolokilweng fano bo fenya jwa sefatlhego sa tirelo. Fa e tshubilwe, tsebe ya go tsena e bontsha konopo ya Tsena ka SAML e e isang modirisi kwa motlameding wa boitshupo mme ya mmusetsa.
help-admin-ldap-what-it-is-description: Go tsena ka LDAP go letla batho go tsena ka leina la modirisi le lefoko la sephiri le ba setseng ba na le lone mo tshupetsong ya gago, jaaka Active Directory kgotsa OpenLDAP. WeKan e tlhatlhoba lefoko la sephiri kgatlhanong le tshupetso, e dira akhaonto fa ba tsena la ntlha mme e ka tsamaisanya maina, diimeile, seemo sa motsamaisi, mekgatlho le ditlhopha le tshupetso.
help-admin-ldap-how-it-works-description: Tlatsa aterese ya tshupetso, kou, go fitlha ka khoutu, motheo le ka moo badirisi ba batlwang ka teng, morago o boloke; boleng jo bo bolokilweng bo fenya dipeakanyo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo mme Tlwaelo e busetsa boleng jwa sefatlhego sa tirelo. Tobetsa Leka Kgolagano ya LDAP go leka dipeakanyo tse di dirang, mme Tsamaisanya badirisi ba LDAP jaanong go dira go tsamaisanya ga kwa morago ka bonako. Tlhopha LDAP jaaka mokgwa wa tlwaelo mo karolong ya Go tsena.
help-admin-oauth2-what-it-is-description: Go tsena ka OAuth2 le OpenID Connect go letla batho go tsena ka akhaonto kwa tirelong e nngwe, jaaka Keycloak, Authelia kgotsa GitLab, boemong jwa lefoko la sephiri la WeKan. Go sa tshwane le batlamedi ba ba tlhomameng ba go tsena ka maranyane a loago, o e supela kwa motlameding ope ka go naya diaterese tsa one.
help-admin-oauth2-how-it-works-descripti: Kwadisa WeKan jaaka tiriso kwa motlameding, morago o tsenye id ya moreki, sephiri, aterese ya sefatlhego sa tirelo, dintlha tsa bofelo le ka moo masimo a modirisi a one a tsamaisanang le WeKan ka teng fano; boleng jo bo bolokilweng fano bo fenya dipeakanyo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo mme bo dira fa o tsena gape kwantle ga go simolola gape. Tsebe ya go tsena morago e bontsha konopo ya go tsena e mokwalo wa yone o beiwang mo karolong ya Go tsena.
help-admin-cas-what-it-is-description: CAS ke thulaganyo ya go tsena gangwe: batho ba tsena gangwe mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo sa CAS sa mokgatlho wa gago, mme WeKan e ikanya tekete e se e busetsang, ka jalo WeKan ga e ke e bona lefoko la sephiri.
help-admin-cas-how-it-works-description: Tsenya diaterese tsa motheo, tsa go tsena le tsa netefatso tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo sa CAS fano mme o e tshube; boleng jo bo bolokilweng fano bo fenya dipeakanyo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo. Tlhopha CAS jaaka mokgwa wa tlwaelo mo karolong ya Go tsena, kgotsa o letle badirisi go e tlhopha mo setlhophing sa mekgwa. Go tsena go isa sebatli kwa tsebeng ya go tsena ya CAS mme go se busetsa kwa WeKan, o tsentse.
help-admin-header-login-what-it-is-descr: Go tsena ka setlhogo go letla moemedi wa kwa morago yo o ikanyegang yo o setseng a dirile go tsena gangwe go bolelela WeKan gore modirisi ke mang, ka jalo modirisi o tsena kwantle ga lefoko la sephiri mme akhaonto e dirwa fa a etela la ntlha.
help-admin-header-login-how-it-works-des: Dipeakanyo tseno di bontshiwa fano di le tsa go bala fela mme ga di kgone go bolokwa go tswa mo Phaneleng ya motsamaisi, ka gonne moemedi yo o ikanyegang a ka tsena jaaka mongwe le mongwe; di beiwa mo dipeakanyong tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo ka go simolola gape. Moemedi o tshwanetse go netefatsa modirisi, a romele ditlhogo tsa boitshupo mme a tlose ditlhogo dipe tse di ntseng jalo tse di romelwang ke bareki, mme ke diaterese tsa moemedi tse di kwadilweng fela tse di ikanngwang.
help-admin-oauth-providers-what-it-is-de: Tseno ke dikonopo tse di setseng di dirilwe tsa go tsena ka maranyane a loago: Google, GitHub, Facebook, Twitter, Meteor Developer, Weibo le Meetup. Nngwe le nngwe e tlhoka fela id ya tiriso le sephiri se motlamedi a go se nayang, mme di ka dirisiwa mmogo le go tsena ka OAuth2 ka kakaretso.
help-admin-oauth-providers-how-it-works-: Dira tiriso mo saeteng ya badiri ba motlamedi ka aterese ya go bitsa gape ya WeKan, morago o tsenye id le sephiri sa yone fano mme o tshube motlamedi; boleng jo bo bolokilweng fano bo fenya dipeakanyo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo. Konopo ya Tsena ka ya motlamedi yoo morago e bonala mo tsebeng ya go tsena.
help-admin-passwordless-what-it-is-descr: Go tsena kwantle ga lefoko la sephiri go letla modirisi go tsena ka khoutu ya gangwe fela e WeKan e e mo romelelang ka imeile, boemong jwa lefoko la sephiri. Ke thuso ya batho ba ba lebalang mafoko a sephiri, e seng kgato ya bobedi, mme e babalesegile fela jaaka lebokose la makwalo la modirisi.
help-admin-passwordless-how-it-works-des: Netefatsa gore imeile e e tswang e a dira, morago o e tshube fano; boleng jo bo bolokilweng fano bo fenya dipeakanyo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo. Tsebe ya go tsena morago e neela go romela khoutu ya go tsena ka imeile: modirisi o kwala aterese ya gagwe, o amogela khoutu e e dirang lobaka lo lokhutshwane, o e tsenya mme o a tsena.
help-admin-backup-what-it-is-description: Polokelo ya tshireletso e tsaya polokelo ya WeKan eno jaanong kgotsa ka tsamaiso, le data ya mokwalo, tse di tshwaraganeng le ditshwantsho tsa badirisi jaaka ditlhopho tse di farologaneng, mme e e busetsa. Motsamaisi wa saete o boloka tiriso yotlhe kgotsa mokgatlho o le mongwe; motsamaisi wa mokgatlho ka bolone o boloka diboto tsa one fela. Polokelo ya tshireletso e e tswelelang boemong jwa moo e romela phetogo nngwe le nngwe gore o kgone go busetsa go fitlha nakong epe.
help-admin-backup-how-it-works-descripti: Tlhopha bophara, tshwaya se o batlang go se akaretsa mme o tobetse Boloka jaanong; polokelo e e feletseng e tlhoka tsotlhe tse tharo le tiriso yotlhe. Baya tsamaiso ya letsatsi le letsatsi, ya beke le beke kgotsa ya kgwedi le kgwedi mme o Boloke. Tobetsa Bontsha dipolokelo mme o busetse nngwe, kgotsa o oketsa fela data e e seyong kgotsa o emisetsa sengwe le sengwe. Mo Polokelong ya tshireletso e e tswelelang, baya foroltara ya go ya, diteng le go boloka, morago o tlhophe ntlha ya go busetsa.
help-admin-attachments-what-it-is-descri: Dikarolo tsa Tse di tshwaraganeng di swetsa gore tse di tshwaraganeng le dikarata le ditshwantsho tsa badirisi di bolokwa kae, di ka nna dikgolo go le kae, di bolokwa lobaka lo lo kae le gore di tsamaya jang magareng ga dipolokelo. Difaele di ka bolokwa mo diskeng ya sefatlhego sa tirelo, mo polokelong ya data kgotsa mo polokelong ya leru jaaka S3, MinIO, Azure, Google Cloud Storage kgotsa WebDAV.
help-admin-attachments-how-it-works-desc: Tlhopha karolo go tswa mo lenaaneng la ditlhopho la molema. Baya polokelo e difaele tse dintšha di yang kwa go yone, baakanya polokelo nngwe le nngwe ka dikonopo tsa yone tsa go bala le go kwala, mme o sutise tse di tshwaraganeng kgotsa ditshwantsho tsa badirisi go tswa mo polokelong nngwe go ya go e nngwe. Meedi e baya bogolo jwa go tsenya le jwa go folosa, Go boloka go phimola tse di tshwaraganeng tsa bogologolo morago ga malatsi a le mmalwa, mme Go fudusa polokelo ya data go sutisa data ya mokwalo magareng ga MongoDB le FerretDB.
help-admin-problems-summary-what-it-is-d: Tsebe ya ntlha ya Phanele ya motsamaisi / Mathata le tlhatlhobo ya gago ya letsatsi le letsatsi ya sefatlhego sotlhe sa tirelo. E go bolelela se se dirang gone jaanong, se se phoso gone jaanong, le gore pego nngwe le nngwe e kokoantse mathata a masha a le kae, le dikonopo tsa go a baakanya kgotsa go a amogela.
help-admin-problems-summary-how-it-works: Seemo se bontsha dipalo tsa go fudusa le dipaakanyo tse di tswelelang, tse di ka diegisang go tsena, se latelwa ke bothata bongwe le bongwe le palo le se se tshwanetseng go dirwa, le konopo ya Baakanya dikarata tse di robegileng, Busetsa kgotsa Baakanya kwa e dirang teng. Paakanyo e e phimolang data e go kopa go tobetsa Netefatsa pele. Ka fa tlase ga Boitekanelo jwa data, Simolola e dira tlhatlhobo ya kwa morago. Ka fa tlase ga Mathata, tshwaya dipego tse o di lebeletseng mme o tobetse Amogela go busetsa palo ya tsone e ntšha kwa tshimologong, kgotsa Phepafatsa go phimola mela ya tsone.
help-admin-problems-security-what-it-is-: Teko nngwe le nngwe e molebedi wa tshireletso a e ganneng kgotsa a e lemogileng: e ne e le eng, e masisi go le kae, ke mang yo o e lekileng, go tswa kae le ga kae. E bontsha gore mongwe o lekile, e seng fela gore phatlha e tswetswe. Dikonopo tsa tshireletso ka bo tsone di mo Phaneleng ya motsamaisi / Dipeakanyo / Tshireletso.
help-admin-problems-security-how-it-work: Mela e bontshiwa e e ntšha pele, mme teko e e boeletsweng ke mola o le mongwe o palo ya one ya Diteko e golang, fa Dintlha di bolela se molebedi a se boneng. Kwala leina, legoro, motswedi, leina la modirisi kgotsa aterese mo lebokoseng la go batla go sefa fa o ntse o kwala, mme o tobetse leina la modirisi go bula akhaonto eo. Amogela kgotsa phepafatsa pego mo Mathata / Kakaretso.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-what-i: Motlhala wa tlhatlhobo wa batsamaisi ba ba dirang jaaka badirisi ba bangwe. Go itira jaaka go letla motsamaisi go bona WeKan jaaka modirisi mongwe a e bona, sekao go ntsha boto ya poraefete, mme pego eno e dira gore maatla ao a nne a bonala morago.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-how-it: Mola o kwalwa fa motsamaisi a tlhopha Itira jaaka modirisi mo Phaneleng ya motsamaisi / Batho, a dira thokene ya go tsena ya modirisi yo mongwe ka REST API, kgotsa a ntsha boto, karata kgotsa se se tshwaraganeng fa a ntse a itira jaaka. Mola mongwe le mongwe o bontsha letlha, motsamaisi, modirisi yo go itirilweng jaaka ene, boto le lebaka, tse dintšha pele. Tobetsa leina go bula modirisi yoo, mme o batle ka Enter. Ga go sepe fano se se fetolang kgotsa se se phimolang mola.
help-admin-problems-password-length-what: E bontsha gore ke mang yo o tsenang ka lefoko la sephiri le le khutshwane go feta boleele jo bo kwa tlase, go tswa kae, le gore a o le fetotse fa e sa le jalo. O ka bona gore ke mang yo o tla amegang pele o patelela boleele jo bo kwa tlase jwa mafoko a sephiri a masha.
help-admin-problems-password-length-how-: Baya Boleele jo bo kwa tlase jwa lefoko la sephiri, tshwaya Patelela boleele jo bo kwa tlase go gana mafoko a sephiri a masha a a khutshwane, mme o tobetse Boloka. Go tsena ga go ke go ganwe, mme fa go patelela go tshubilwe, akhaonto e e nang le lefoko la sephiri la bogologolo le le khutshwane e kopiwa go le fetola pele. Tafole e na le mola o le mongwe ka akhaonto le go tsena ga ntlha le ga bofelo, diaterese, palo ya go tsena le gore e baakantswe leng. Sefa ka Lefoko la sephiri le le khutshwane thata, Le baakantswe go nna le le leele go lekana kgotsa Tsotlhe. Diakhaonto tse di tsenang ka LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS kgotsa Sandstorm ga di bontshiwe.
help-admin-problems-performance-what-it-: E tlhalosa ka moo WeKan e tsenyang dikarata tsa boto ka teng, se se swetsang gore go bula boto e kgolo go tura go le kae. Ke tlhaloso fela, go se na sepe sa go tobetsa kgotsa sa go boloka.
help-admin-problems-performance-how-it-w: Go tsenngwa ga dikarata go itirela ka bosona mo botong nngwe le nngwe: boto e e nang le dikarata di feta 500 e tsenya fela dikarata tse di bonalang mo lenaaneng lengwe le lengwe fa o ntse o phuthologa, le dipalo go tswa mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo, mme boto e nnye e tsenya karata nngwe le nngwe. Modiri wa sefatlhego sa tirelo a ka patelela go tsenya tsotlhe kgotsa go tsenya ka bonya, kgotsa a fetola palo ya dikarata, mo dipeakanyong tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo mme morago a simolola gape. Pono ya Dipalopalo ya boto e bontsha gore e dirisa mokgwa ofe.

help-admin-problems-speed-how-it-works-d: Kopo nngwe le nngwe kwantle ga difaele tse di sa fetogeng e lekanyediwa nako, mme e e tsayang metsotswana e mebedi kgotsa go feta ka tlwaelo e a kwalwa. help-admin-problems-tests-what-it-is-des: Ditlhatlhobo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo se se dirang tse di paletsweng. help-admin-problems-tests-how-it-works-d: Ditlhatlhobo di dira gangwe, morago ga metsotswana e ka nna 15 fa sefatlhego sa tirelo se simolola, mme ke go palelwa fela go go dirang mola: Motswedi o bitsa tlhatlhobo mme Dintlha di naya molaetsa wa yone wa phoso. help-admin-problems-cpu-what-it-is-descr: E lebelela morwalo wa porosesara wa motšhine otlhe, ka gonne WeKan le polokelo ya yone ya data mo khomputareng e e tshwanang di ka dirisa CPU e e lekaneng go diegisa dirisiwa tse dingwe. help-admin-problems-cpu-how-it-works-des: Mola wa kwa godimo o bontsha tiriso ya jaanong ya CPU, palo ya dikoko, morwalo o o fa gare, bonnye jo bo sa tswang go nna teng, palogare le bogolo, le se WeKan e se dirang, e ntšhwafadiwa metsotswana e mengwe le e mengwe e le 5. help-admin-problems-ram-what-it-is-descr: E lebelela gore motšhine otlhe o dirisa mohopolo le swap go le kae, mme e kwala fa paka ya tiriso e kgolo ya mohopolo e simolola le fa e fela. help-admin-problems-ram-how-it-works-des: Mola o o kwa godimo o bontsha tiriso ya jaanong ya mohopolo jaaka phesente le jaaka dikikabaete tse di dirisitsweng le palogotlhe, le swap fa motšhine o na le yone, e ntšhwafadiwa metsotswana e mengwe le e mengwe e le 5. help-admin-problems-disk-what-it-is-desc: E lebelela sebaka se se gololesegileng mo disikeng tse di tshwarang polokelo ya data, tse di tshwaraganeng le tse di tsentsweng. help-admin-problems-disk-how-it-works-de: Mola o le mongwe o o tshelang ka disiki nngwe o bontsha phesente e e dirisitsweng, dikikabaete tse di gololesegileng le palogotlhe, lefelo la yone le se WeKan e se bolokang koo, e ntšhwafadiwa metsotswana e mengwe le e mengwe e le 30, mme disiki e e mo pakeng e e kwa godimo e a gatelelwa. help-admin-problems-instrumentation-what: Dipalo tse di tshelang tsa se sefatlhego seno sa tirelo sa WeKan se se dirang: gore dikgolagano di le kae di bulegile, le gore mokgwa mongwe le mongwe le kgatiso nngwe le nngwe di bidiwa ga kae, di palelwa ga kae le gore di tsaya lobaka lo lo kae. help-admin-problems-instrumentation-how-: Mola wa kwa godimo o bontsha dikgolagano tse di dirang, tse di butsweng le tse di tswetsweng le gore go bala go simolotse leng. help-admin-problems-broken-cards-what-it: E bontsha dikarata tse go se nang boto epe e e ka di bontshang, ka gonne boto, tsela kgotsa lenaane le di leng mo go lone le seyo. E akaretsa boto nngwe le nngwe mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo, go sa kgathalesege gore a o leloko kgotsa nnyaa.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-how-it-: Mola mongwe le mongwe o bontsha setlhogo sa karata, id ya yone, ditlhogo tsa boto, tsela le lenaane tse di sa ntseng di le teng, mofuta wa yone le gore e dirilwe leng; sele e e se nang sepe ke karolo e e seyong. help-admin-problems-files-what-it-is-des: E bontsha tse di tshwaraganeng tse di bolokilweng mo sefatlhegong seno sa tirelo, le dikonopo tse di tlhatlhobang se polokelo ya data e se buang ka se se tshwaraganeng sengwe le sengwe le setshwantsho sengwe le sengwe sa modirisi kgatlhanong le se se leng mo polokelong tota. Ditlhatlhobo di bona difaele tse di seyong, tse di sa umakiwang kgotsa tse di neilweng maina a a phoso le hisitori e e ka di tlhalosang.
help-admin-problems-files-how-it-works-d: Tafole e bontsha ponelopele, leina la faele, bogolo, mofuta le di-id tsa se se tshwaraganeng, boto le karata, le lebokose la go batla. Tlhatlhoba difaele le hisitori, Tlhatlhoba mefuta ya difaele le dikoketso tsa maina, kgotsa Tlhatlhoba difaele tse di seyong le tse di sa latelwang e simolola tlhatlhobo; Khansela tlhatlhobo e e emisa. help-admin-problems-rules-what-it-is-des: E bontsha molao mongwe le mongwe wa go itirela mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo le boto ya one, gore o bone mo lefelong le le lengwe se WeKan e se dirang ka bosona mo dibotong tsotlhe, sekao fa o batla molao o o sutisang dikarata ka tsela e e sa solofelwang.
help-admin-problems-rules-how-it-works-d: Tafole e bontsha setlhogo sa molao, boto ya one, mofuta wa tiro ya one le mofuta wa tiragalo wa sesusumetsi sa one, mela e le 10 ka tsebe, e rulagantswe ka boto. Kwala karolo ya setlhogo sa molao mme o tobetse Enter go batla, mme o phimole lebokose mme o tobetse Enter go bona tsotlhe gape. help-admin-problems-webhooks-what-it-is-: Tafole ya webhuku nngwe le nngwe mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo, diwebhuku tsa boto nngwe le nngwe le tsa lefatshe: gore nngwe le nngwe ke ya boto efe, ke mang yo o e okeditseng le gore e romela kae. E thusa pele ga go tima diwebhuku, morago ga tiragalo, kgotsa fa data e ya kwa go se nang ope yo o gopolang go e baakanya.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-how-it-work: Mola o le mongwe ka webhuku, e ntšha pele, o bontsha boto, mong, leina, aterese, mofuta, gore a e tshubilwe kgotsa e timilwe, gore e romela ditiragalo dife, gore a thokene e beilwe, le gore e okeditswe leng. help-admin-problems-boards-what-it-is-de: E bontsha boto nngwe le nngwe mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo le ponagalo ya yone, maloko, mekgatlho le ditlhopha. E araba gore ke diboto dife tse di leng teng, gore ke mang yo o ka bonang nngwe le nngwe le gore ke mang yo o mo go yone, kwantle ga go bula boto nngwe le nngwe.
help-admin-problems-boards-how-it-works-: Mola mongwe le mongwe o bontsha setlhogo, id, tetla, gore a boto e mo polokelong, maloko a a dirang, le mekgatlho le ditlhopha tse e abelanwang le tsone. help-admin-problems-cards-what-it-is-des: E bontsha karata nngwe le nngwe mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo, le kwa e leng teng le gore ke mang yo o mo go yone, mo dibotong tsotlhe go sa kgathalesege gore a o leloko kgotsa nnyaa. help-admin-problems-cards-how-it-works-d: Mola mongwe le mongwe o bontsha setlhogo sa karata, boto ya yone, tsela le lenaane, le maina a badirisi a maloko le badiri ba yone. Ga go sepe se se ka fetolwang fano.
help-admin-problems-recovery-what-it-is-: Kwa o bolokang polokelo ya data e babalesegile teng mme o fetsa tiro e e emeng fa gare. E bontsha hisitori ya ditlhatlhobo tsa polokelo ya data, dipolokelo tsa tshireletso le dibusetso, mme e go letla go swetsa gore go diragala eng ka imeile e e kgomaretseng, dikitsiso, diimeile tsa melao, ditiro tsa go tsamaisanya manaane le go tsenya diboto go go kgaogantsweng.
help-admin-problems-recovery-how-it-work: Go tswa kwa godimo o bona dikonopo tsa go tlhatlhoba difaele, morago dikarolo jaaka mola wa go romela diimeile, dikitsiso tsa ditiragalo tse di emeng, diimeile tsa melao, ditiro tsa go tsamaisanya manaane le go tsenya go go kgaogantsweng, nngwe le nngwe le dikonopo tse di jaaka Emisa, Tswelela, Leka gape, Latlha kgotsa Boloka. Tafole e e kwa tlase e kwala tiragalo nngwe le nngwe ya tsosoloso le tshwetso; bontsha Tsotlhe, Go Dirilwe, Go Paletswe kgotsa Go Phimotswe mme o batle ka Enter.
help-admin-problems-offices-what-it-is-d: E bala go tsena go go atlegileng ka motho le ka aterese, gore o bone gore akhaonto nngwe le nngwe e tsena go tswa kae le gore ke diaterese dife tse diakhaonto di le mmalwa di di abelanang. Aterese e e abelanwang e ka nna kantoro, VPN kgotsa kgolagano ya neteweke e e abelanwang; ga e supe gore diakhaonto ke motho a le mongwe.
help-admin-problems-offices-how-it-works: Batho ba bontshiwa a le mongwe ka nako, mongwe le mongwe le mola ka aterese: IPv4, IPv6, go tsena ga ntlha le ga bofelo, palo ya go tsena, le lefelo fa moemedi yo o fa pele ga WeKan a le naya. Kwala leina la modirisi, leina lotlhe, aterese kgotsa lefelo mme o tobetse Enter go batla, mme o tsamaye ka ditsebe ka dikonopo tsa pele le tsa morago. Ga go sepe se se thibelwang ka ntlha ya pego eno, ka jalo aterese e e abelanwang ga e ke e lotlela batho kwa ntle.
help-admin-problems-api-what-it-is-descr: E bontsha gore ke dintlha dife tsa bofelo tsa REST API tse di dirisiwang, ke mang le ga kae. Dikarolo tse dingwe di bolela se se tsamaileng phoso; eno e bolela se sefatlhego sa tirelo se kopiwang go se dira. Mo sefatlhegong sa tirelo kwa REST API e sa tshubiwang teng, e nna e se na sepe.
help-admin-problems-api-how-it-works-des: Mola mongwe le mongwe ke akhaonto le ntlha ya bofelo, e e tshwaregileng thata pele: palo ya dipitso, gore e biditswe leng la ntlha le la bofelo, le diaterese tsa bofelo tsa IPv4 le IPv6 le lefelo la tsone. Leina la modirisi le le se nang sepe le kaya dipitso go tswa mo go mongwe yo o se nang akhaonto, yo o itsiwang ka diaterese. Kwala ntlha ya bofelo, mokgwa, leina la modirisi kgotsa aterese go sefa fa o ntse o kwala, mme o tsamaye ka mela e le 10 ka nako.
help-admin-problems-database-what-it-is-: E tlhalosa se polokelo ya data e se buileng. Phoso go tswa kwa MongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB kgotsa SAP HANA gantsi e kwaletswe badiri ba yone, ka jalo karolo eno e bitsa polokelo ya data, e rulaganya bothata go nna mofuta o o jaaka disiki, go tsena, popego ya puo kgotsa go fela ga nako, mme e oketsa tlhaloso e e motlhofo le kgato e e latelang.
help-admin-problems-database-how-it-work: Mela e bontshiwa e e ntšha pele. help-admin-problems-integrity-what-it-is: E bontsha gore a sefatlhego seno sa tirelo se emisitse sentle, gore ke eng se se se wisitseng, le gore a polokelo ya tshireletso e e tswelelang e paletswe, mmogo le dikonopo tse di tshwanang tsa go tlhatlhoba difaele jaaka mo Pegong ya Difaele. help-admin-problems-integrity-how-it-wor: Mola o kwalwa fa go simolola gape go diragala kwantle ga go emisa sentle, jaaka go simolola gape ka bonako fa sefatlhego sa tirelo se boile mo metsotsong e le meraro kgotsa go wa fa se ne se sa dire lobaka lo loleele, ka phoso e e sa tshwarwang le molaetsa wa yone, le fa polokelo ya tshireletso e e tswelelang e palelwa. E amogele kgotsa o e phepafatse mo Mathata / Kakaretso.
help-admin-cloud-what-it-is-description: Phanele ya Leru ke tsebe ya modiri wa go tshola ya go tsamaisa mafelo a mantsi a WeKan a bareki go tswa mo lefelong le le lengwe: matlha a one, dipolokelo tsa data, diinboise, ditekete tsa thuso le puisano, dikwalo tsa DNS le ditsela tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo sa webo. E nna teng fela fa dipeakanyo tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo di e tshuba mo lefelong la sone, mme ke batsamaisi ba saete fela koo, Batsamaisi ba Leru, ba ba e bonang.
help-admin-cloud-how-it-works-descriptio: Oketsa mafelo a bareki le matlha a one le gore a lengwe le lengwe le na le WeKan le polokelo ya data ya lone kgotsa le abelana tseno, leka kgolagano ya polokelo ya data, mme o kwale diinboise. Lefelo lengwe le lengwe le bona boto ya thuso ya ditekete le puisano. Tlhatlhoba le go ntšhwafatsa dikwalo tsa DNS, tsenya ditsela tsa sefatlhego sa tirelo sa webo, mme o kwale diaterese tse di letleletsweng go lekanyetsa kwa Batsamaisi ba Leru ba ka tsenang teng. Bareki ba tsena go bona lefelo la bone.
help-all-boards-what-it-is-description: Diboto Tsotlhe ke tsebe e e bontshang diboto tsa gago. Lenaane la ditlhopho la molema le tlhopha gore ke diboto dife tse di bontshiwang, jaaka Tse di Tshwailweng ka Naledi, Tse di Setseng, Legae, Disekao, Polokelo, lefelo la tiro kgotsa mokgatlho kgotsa setlhopha, mme mola wa setlhogo o na le go rulaganya, go batla, go ntsha le Go Tlhopha Tse Dintsi.
help-all-boards-how-it-works-description: Tobetsa karolo mo lenaaneng la ditlhopho la molema mme morago boto go e bula. Dirisa Rulaganya Diboto mo tatelanong e e ikgethileng ya go goga kgotsa ka setlhogo, le lenaane la ditlhopho la pono go fetola magareng ga matshwao a diboto le tafole. Tshuba Go Tlhopha Tse Dintsi mme o tshwaye diboto go di isa kwa polokelong, go di kopolola, go di ntsha kgotsa go baya nngwe jaaka boto ya gago ya Legae, kgotsa goga boto go e isa mo Polokelong.
help-workload-what-it-is-description: Morwalo wa tiro le bokgoni bo bontsha, beke ka beke, gore motho mongwe le mongwe o na le tiro e kae kgatlhanong le diura tse a nang le tsone, mo dibotong tsotlhe tse o dirang mo go tsone. Bo bontsha gore ke mang yo o imelwang thata, ke mang yo o ka tsayang go feta, le gore porojeke e e tlang e tlhoka eng pele ga ope a bidiwa.
help-workload-how-it-works-description: Tlhopha beke ya ntlha, dibeke di le kae le gore a go bontshiwe diura kgotsa dintlha tsa kgang, morago o tobetse beke go bona dikarata tsa yone. Dibeke tse di nang le tiro e ntsi go feta diura ke tse dikhibidu. Baya nako ya gago ya tiro, bokgoni le go tlhoka teng, batsamaisi ba boto ba oketsa dikabo le mafelo a diseabe, mme batsamaisi ba oketsa malatsi a boikhutso a setšhaba.
help-billing-what-it-is-description: Tekanyetso ya madi le go duelela ke kwa batsamaisi ba boto ba rulaganyang le go duelelisa tiro ya boto teng: tekanyetso ya madi ya yone, se tiro e se tureng le se e tla se turang, ditlhwatlhwa tsa ura, ditshenyegelo, dituelo tse di tlhomameng, dikakanyetso tsa ditlhwatlhwa le diinboise, go ya ka nako e e latetsweng mo dikarateng.
help-billing-how-it-works-description: Tlhopha madi le ditlhwatlhwa tsa ura ka leloko le tlwaelo ya boto, baya tekanyetso ya madi, mme o oketse ditshenyegelo le dituelo. Nako e e kwadilweng mo dikarateng morago e bontshiwa jaaka e e dirisitsweng le e e akanyediwang kgatlhanong le tekanyetso ya madi. Fa o rata, amogela nako pele ga go dira inboise. Tlatsa dintlha tsa gago tsa modiri wa inboise gangwe, morago o dire diinboise tsa paka, o di folose, o di tshwaye di romilwe mme o kwale dituelo, kgotsa o dire kakanyetso ya tlhwatlhwa ya tiro e e sa ntseng e tla dirwa.
